Authors: Kairui Hu, Siyuan Hu, Fangzhou Hong, Zhaoxi Chen, Ziwei Liu

PLaW-VLA: Predictive Latent World Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Policies VLA

latent world model vision-language-action long-horizon control Mixture-of-Transformers future state prediction

简要说明：PLaW-VLA 为视觉-语言-动作策略引入了预测性潜在世界模型，通过预测任务相关的未来状态来提升长期控制和泛化能力，同时降低推理延迟。

TLDR: PLaW-VLA introduces a predictive latent world model for VLA policies, predicting task-relevant future states in a pretrained representation space to improve long-horizon control and generalization with reduced latency.

Abstract: Learning to predict how the world evolves can provide vision-language-action (VLA) policies with predictive context for long-horizon control, but its effectiveness depends on what future representation is modeled and how it conditions action generation. We introduce PLaW-VLA, which models task-relevant future states in a pretrained prediction-oriented representation space, reducing the need to predict control-irrelevant visual details. Built on a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture, PLaW-VLA conditions action generation on observation history, current task semantics, and predicted future states through structured causal attention. Experiments show a +11.8 percentage-point (pp) gain over reactive policies on RoboTwin Hard Horizon III and a +1.77 pp gain over reconstruction-oriented latent prediction on zero-shot LIBERO-Plus, supporting improved long-horizon control and generalization under distribution shift, respectively. By avoiding low-level visual reconstruction, PLaW-VLA lowers the burden of future prediction, enabling a lightweight latent world model with parallel future prediction and about 1/19 the inference latency of generative world-action modeling at comparable policy performance.

摘要（中文）：学习预测世界如何演变能够为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略提供面向长时程控制的预测性上下文，但其效果取决于建模何种未来表征以及该表征如何调控动作生成。我们提出PLaW-VLA，在预训练的面向预测的表征空间中建模与任务相关的未来状态，从而减少对与控制无关的视觉细节的预测需求。基于混合Transformer架构，PLaW-VLA通过结构化因果注意力机制，将动作生成条件建立在观测历史、当前任务语义及预测未来状态之上。实验表明，在RoboTwin Hard Horizon III任务上，PLaW-VLA相较于反应式策略提升了11.8个百分点（pp）；在零样本LIBERO-Plus任务上，相较于面向重建的潜在预测方法提升了1.77个百分点（pp），分别验证了其在长时程控制改善和分布偏移下泛化能力方面的优势。通过避免底层视觉重建，PLaW-VLA降低了未来预测的负担，使得轻量级潜在世界模型能够实现并行未来预测，并在策略性能相当的情况下，推理延迟约为生成式世界-动作建模方法的1/19。

Authors: Yu Liu, Hetian Guo, Tianlv Huang, Ziyi Cai, Wudi Chen, Hantang Wang, Qiutong Liu, Yingzhi Peng, Wei Han, Peijun Tang, Jianan Wang, Zipei Fan, Zhiyuan Zha, Xuan Song

MiniWAM: Learning Compact Future Targets for Efficient World-Action Modeling WorldModel

world-action model future representation inverse dynamics robot policy efficient training

简要说明：MiniWAM 通过逆动力学和特征重建学习紧凑的未来表示，从而更高效、更有效地进行机器人策略的世界-动作建模。

TLDR: MiniWAM introduces compact future representations learned via inverse-dynamics and feature reconstruction, enabling more efficient and effective world-action modeling for robot policies.

Abstract: World modeling has emerged as an effective co-training objective for robot policies, giving rise to World Action Models (WAMs) that jointly predict actions and future states. However, most WAMs predict future states in the native representation space of pretrained visual backbones, resulting in high-dimensional targets with substantial training cost. We introduce MiniWAM, which instead predicts compact future representations learned from privileged current-future transitions. To construct these targets, we propose Predictive Representations via Inverse Spatiotemporal Modeling (PRISM), which combines inverse-dynamics supervision with feature reconstruction to emphasize control-relevant transition information while preserving useful future-state information. With the learned PRISM encoder frozen, MiniWAM is trained to jointly predict the resulting targets and robot actions from current observations. With 65$\times$ fewer native future feature tokens, MiniWAM consistently outperforms native future-feature prediction with both DINOv3 and WAN2.1 VAE features, while achieving up to an 8$\times$ speedup in world-action training. At 0.25B parameters, MiniWAM is already competitive with substantially larger WAMs on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0 simulation benchmarks. Representation analyses further show that PRISM contributes behavioral structure beyond feature reconstruction alone. These results demonstrate that effective world-action modeling does not require predicting native visual futures, and that compact predictive representations provide a strong and substantially more efficient target for policy learning. The project page is available at: https://j1dan.github.io/MiniWAM.

摘要（中文）：世界建模已成为机器人策略的一种有效协同训练目标，催生了能够联合预测动作与未来状态的“世界动作模型”（WAMs）。然而，大多数WAMs在预训练视觉骨干网络的原始表示空间中预测未来状态，导致高维目标及高昂的训练成本。我们提出了MiniWAM，它转而预测从特权当前-未来转移中学习到的紧凑未来表示。为构建这些目标，我们提出了“基于逆时空建模的预测表示”（PRISM），该方法将逆动力学监督与特征重建相结合，以强调与控制相关的转移信息，同时保留有用的未来状态信息。在冻结学习到的PRISM编码器后，MiniWAM被训练为从当前观测联合预测所得目标与机器人动作。凭借比原生未来特征令牌少65倍的规模，MiniWAM在使用DINOv3和WAN2.1 VAE特征时均持续优于原生未来特征预测，同时在世界动作训练中实现了最高8倍的加速。在0.25B参数规模下，MiniWAM在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0仿真基准上已能与规模大得多的WAMs相抗衡。表示分析进一步表明，PRISM带来了超越单纯特征重建的行为结构。这些结果表明，有效的世界动作建模并不需要预测原生视觉未来，紧凑的预测表示为策略学习提供了强有力且效率显著更高的目标。项目页面见：https://j1dan.github.io/MiniWAM。

Authors: Jie Chen, Ruofei Bai, Yuxin Cai, Yifeng Zhang, Chengyang He, Jun Li, Wei-Yun Yau, Guillaume Sartoretti

RESETTLE: Robotic Recovery through Disagreement-Triggered Retrieval and Efficient Corrective Control VLA

robot recovery disagreement-triggered corrective control V-JEPA encoder base policy

简要说明：RESETTLE 是一个模型无关的框架，通过采样动作提案之间的分歧触发恢复，使用 V-JEPA 编码器检索演示参考，并结合状态伺服先验与受保护的视觉残差执行一次纠正动作，无需在线优化即可在多个基准和真实任务中提升成功率。

TLDR: RESETTLE is a model-agnostic framework that triggers recovery in frozen robot policies via disagreement between sampled action proposals, retrieves a demonstration reference with a V-JEPA encoder, and executes one corrective action using a state-servo prior with a guarded visual residual, improving success rates across multiple benchmarks and real-world tasks without online optimization.

Abstract: Reliable robotic manipulation requires timely intervention to correct emerging deviations and restore progress after execution errors. However, recovery methods based on repeated vision-language reasoning or iterative online optimization can incur substantial latency, delaying intervention. To address these challenges, we introduce RESETTLE(Robotic rEcovery through diSagrEement-Triggered reTrievaL and Efficient Corrective Control), a model-agnostic framework that provides computationally efficient recovery at the action-execution interface of frozen robot policies. RESETTLE triggers recovery when two action proposals independently sampled under identical conditioning persistently disagree. It retrieves a same-task demonstration reference using an adapted V-JEPA encoder and combines a state-servo prior with a guarded visual residual to execute one corrective action without online trajectory optimization or additional vision-language reasoning, then returns control to the base policy. Across six base policies in simulation, RESETTLE achieves up to 8.70%, 6.28%, and 6.83% absolute success-rate gains on LIBERO-Plus, Meta-World, and RoboCasa Tabletop, respectively, with further improvements on four real-world tasks using two policies. In QwenPI-based comparisons, its monitoring-and-recovery computation latency is 74.04%--93.57% lower than VoLoAgent's monitoring-and-planning latency for grasp and place tool calls. It also raises Harness VLA's LIBERO-Pro Swap success from 42% to 50%, demonstrating compatibility with high-level agentic planning. Code available at: https://github.com/JIA-Lab-research/RESETTLE

摘要（中文）：可靠的机器人操作需要及时干预，以纠正出现的偏差并在执行错误后恢复进度。然而，基于重复的视觉-语言推理或迭代在线优化的恢复方法可能产生显著的延迟，从而推迟干预。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了RESETTLE（通过分歧触发检索与高效纠正控制的机器人恢复框架），这是一个模型无关的框架，在冻结机器人策略的动作执行接口处提供计算高效的恢复。当两个在相同条件下独立采样的动作提案持续出现分歧时，RESETTLE会触发恢复。它利用适配的V-JEPA编码器检索同任务演示参考，并将状态伺服先验与受保护的视觉残差相结合，执行一次纠正动作，无需在线轨迹优化或额外的视觉-语言推理，随后将控制权交还给基础策略。在仿真环境中，跨六种基础策略，RESETTLE在LIBERO-Plus、Meta-World和RoboCasa Tabletop上分别实现了最高8.70%、6.28%和6.83%的绝对成功率提升，并在四个真实世界任务中借助两种策略获得了进一步改进。在与QwenPI的对比中，其监控与恢复计算延迟比VoLoAgent的监控与规划延迟低74.04%--93.57%，适用于抓取和放置工具调用。此外，RESETTLE将Harness VLA在LIBERO-Pro Swap上的成功率从42%提升至50%，展示了其与高层智能体规划的兼容性。代码已开源：https://github.com/JIA-Lab-research/RESETTLE

Authors: Yuxin Chen, Senqiao Yang, Zixuan Wang, Jinhui Ye, Changsheng Lu, Pengguang Chen, Shu Liu, Zhuotao Tian, Jiaya Jia

Unifying Policy Learning and State Prediction through Spatial Language Modeling Manipulation

spatial language modeling action-conditioned state prediction autoregressive Transformer random-play pretraining robotic manipulation

简要说明：本文提出空间语言建模，通过将场景几何、目标和动作表示为离散 token 序列，并使用单一自回归 Transformer 统一学习动作生成与状态预测，在仿真和真实机器人上提升了操作性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces Spatial Language Modeling, which unifies policy learning and action-conditioned state prediction by representing scene geometry, goals, and actions as discrete token sequences trained with a single autoregressive Transformer, demonstrating improved manipulation performance in simulation (Push-T) and on a real robot.

Abstract: Learning how actions change scene geometry can provide complementary supervision for goal-directed manipulation. We introduce Spatial Language Modeling, which represents scene contours, goals, action targets, and future states with a shared vocabulary of discrete coordinates and semantic tokens. A task-specific grammar organizes these elements into spatial sequences, allowing one autoregressive Transformer to learn action generation and action-conditioned state prediction through a common next-token objective. We train the model from scratch using random-play transition pretraining followed by joint action and state training on expert demonstrations. During pretraining, recorded action coordinates condition subsequent state predictions and are excluded from the prediction loss. During control, the model decodes only executable action targets and updates its history with newly observed states. We evaluate the approach on Push-T in simulation and on a real robot. The model achieves competitive simulation performance and higher task success and target coverage than the evaluated real-robot policy baselines. Training ablations show improved control with joint action and state sequences, with further gains from random-play pretraining. Given supplied action trajectories, the same model also predicts successive scene states, capturing the geometric effects of pushing.

摘要（中文）：学习动作如何改变场景几何结构，能够为目标导向的操作提供互补的监督信号。我们引入了空间语言建模方法，该方法利用离散坐标与语义标记的共享词汇表，对场景轮廓、目标、动作目标及未来状态进行统一表征。一种任务特定的语法将这些元素组织为空间序列，使得单一的自回归Transformer能够通过共同的下一词元目标，同时学习动作生成与动作条件下的状态预测。我们从零开始训练该模型，首先使用随机交互转移预训练，随后在专家示范数据上进行动作与状态的联合训练。在预训练阶段，记录的动作坐标作为后续状态预测的条件，并被排除在预测损失之外。在控制阶段，模型仅解码可执行的动作目标，并根据新观测到的状态更新其历史信息。我们在仿真环境中的Push-T任务以及真实机器人上对该方法进行了评估。实验结果表明，该模型在仿真中取得了具有竞争力的性能，并在真实机器人任务成功率和目标覆盖率上优于所评估的基线策略。训练消融实验显示，联合动作与状态序列训练可提升控制性能，而随机交互预训练则带来进一步增益。在给定动作轨迹的条件下，同一模型还能够预测后续场景状态，从而捕捉推动动作的几何效应。

Authors: Minye Wu, Zehao Wang, Tinne Tuytelaars

Leveraging Human-In-The-Loop Demonstrations in Reinforcement Learning for Digital Twin-Driven Robot Flexibility RLRobot

digital twin human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning imitation learning collaborative robot

简要说明：本文提出了一种人在回路在线训练框架，结合实时同步数字孪生、强化学习和双演员模仿学习，使协作机器人能够适应工作空间的变化。

TLDR: The paper proposes a human-in-the-loop online training framework that combines a real-time synchronized digital twin, reinforcement learning, and a dual actor with imitation learning to enable a collaborative robot to adapt to workspace changes.

Abstract: Growing automation makes collaborative robots work in more variable environments, increasing the need for adaptation. We propose a human-in-the-loop online training framework combining a digital twin (DT), reinforcement learning (RL), and human demonstrations. Unlike DTs used mainly to generate synthetic data before task execution, our DT is synchronized with the physical system in real time through camera feeds, allowing the virtual robot to update its observations and policy from real-world feedback. A dual actor framework integrates imitation learning (IL) without adding a direct imitation loss to the RL actor, so demonstrations can guide adaptation instead of manual reprogramming. The proposed framework is demonstrated on the Ufactory Xarm5 collaborative robot, where the robot's end-effector aims to reach the target position while avoiding obstacles. The experiments show that the framework can resume training after a change in the physical workspace and that, with a fixed set of non-optimal demonstrations, the dual actor framework achieves a much higher final success rate than two methods that add an imitation loss to the actor. The same pattern holds with real human demonstrations collected in virtual reality (VR): with demonstrations that never reach the goal, the dual actor framework reached 83-100% mean deterministic evaluation success, against 0-17% for the two imitation-loss methods.

摘要（中文）：自动化程度的提升使得协作机器人能够在更加多变的环境中工作，这也加大了对适应能力的需求。我们提出了一种结合数字孪生（DT）、强化学习（RL）和人类示教的人机协同在线训练框架。与主要用于任务执行前生成合成数据的数字孪生不同，我们的数字孪生通过摄像头实时流与物理系统同步，使虚拟机器人能够从真实世界反馈中更新其观测和策略。一种双演员框架将模仿学习（IL）整合进来，而无需在强化学习演员上添加直接的模仿损失，从而使示教可以指导适应过程，而非依赖人工重新编程。所提出的框架在Ufactory Xarm5协作机器人上进行了验证，该机器人末端的执行器旨在避开障碍物并到达目标位置。实验表明，该框架能够在物理工作空间发生变化后恢复训练，并且在给定一组固定的非最优示教的情况下，双演员框架的最终成功率远高于两种在演员上添加模仿损失的方法。在虚拟现实（VR）中收集的真实人类示教中也呈现相同规律：在示教从未到达目标的情况下，双演员框架的平均确定性评估成功率达到83-100%，而两种模仿损失方法分别仅为0-17%。

Authors: Yuzhu Sun, Mien Van, Nguyen Minh Nhat, Stephen McIlvanna, Sean McLoone

SuperNav: An Agentic Navigation System for Any Task in Any Scene VLN

agentic navigation multimodal large language model visual-point interface navigation skills quadruped robot

简要说明：SuperNav 提出了一种智能体导航系统，为预训练的 MLLM 配备智能体框架和导航技能，通过统一的视觉点接口实现无需导航微调的任务与场景泛化导航，在室内导航任务中优于基线，并在真实四足机器人上完成部署。

TLDR: SuperNav introduces an agentic navigation system that equips a pretrained MLLM with an agent harness and navigation skills, using a unified visual-point interface to enable task- and scene-general navigation without navigation-specific fine-tuning. It outperforms baselines on indoor navigation tasks and demonstrates deployment on a real quadruped robot.

Abstract: General-purpose service robots need navigation systems that can handle diverse human requests in unfamiliar environments, combining task generality with scene generality. Some existing methods fine-tune multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to predict navigation actions, making their behavior dependent on the coverage of navigation training data and potentially limiting generalization to new requests and environments. Our key insight is to let the MLLM focus on interpreting requests, understanding scenes, and making decisions while preserving its general-purpose capabilities and delegating motion execution to navigation tools. To realize this idea, we introduce SuperNav, which equips a pretrained MLLM with a specialized agent harness without navigation-specific fine-tuning of the MLLM. Our harness supports these decisions with Navigation Skills, agent-oriented Tools for physical interaction, and task-progress and context management. A unified visual-point interface connects decision-making to motion by allowing the model to specify destinations directly in images and revise its decisions from execution feedback. Together, these components support sustained navigation across different task requirements and environments. SuperNav outperforms four evaluated baselines on instance-level, multi-object, and demand-driven tasks. Category-level evaluation on HM3D and deployment on a real quadruped robot further demonstrate its applicability across environments. Project Page: https://zju3dv.github.io/SuperNav/

摘要（中文）：通用型服务机器人需要具备能够在陌生环境中处理多样化人类请求的导航系统，这要求其同时具备任务泛化能力和场景泛化能力。现有的一些方法通过微调多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）来预测导航动作，这使得模型的行为依赖于导航训练数据的覆盖范围，并可能限制其对新请求和新环境的泛化能力。我们的核心见解在于，让多模态大语言模型专注于解读请求、理解场景和做出决策，同时保留其通用能力，并将运动执行委托给导航工具。为实现这一构想，我们提出了SuperNav，该方法为预训练的多模态大语言模型配备了一个专门的智能体框架，而无需对多模态大语言模型进行导航特定的微调。该框架通过导航技能、面向智能体的物理交互工具，以及任务进度与上下文管理来支持上述决策。一个统一的视觉点接口将决策与运动连接起来，允许模型直接在图像中指定目的地，并根据执行反馈修正其决策。这些组件共同支持模型在不同任务需求和环境下进行持续导航。SuperNav在实例级、多目标以及需求驱动任务上均优于四个评估基线。在HM3D上的类别级评估以及在真实四足机器人上的部署进一步证明了其跨环境的适用性。项目页面：https://zju3dv.github.io/SuperNav/

Authors: Jinkai Zhang, Jingyi Xu, Yuanhong Yu, Jiarui Guo, Ruizhen Hu, Hujun Bao, Xiaowei Zhou, Sida Peng

ManiUnit: A Manipulation Skill Dataset and Benchmark for Long-Horizon Tasks VLA

long-horizon manipulation VLA evaluation skill-level benchmark state perturbation BEHAVIOR-1K

简要说明：提出了ManiUnit，一个基于BEHAVIOR-1K的操控技能数据集和基准，用于评估长时程移动操控，通过状态恢复实现技能级性能评估与扰动下的鲁棒性测试。实验表明VLA策略在关节扰动下性能下降，技能训练策略优于任务训练策略。

TLDR: Introduces ManiUnit, a manipulation skill dataset and benchmark from BEHAVIOR-1K for evaluating long-horizon mobile manipulation, isolating skill-level performance under perturbation and enabling local success evaluation via state restoration. Tests show VLA policies degrade under joint perturbations and skill-trained policies outperform task-trained policies.

Abstract: Long-horizon mobile manipulation requires a robot to navigate multi-room environments and execute a sequence of manipulation skills under a single natural language instruction. Learning and evaluating these skills present three challenges: similar observations under a fixed task instruction may make skill selection ambiguous; even when a preceding skill succeeds, the robot state inherited by the next skill may deviate from its demonstrated starting states and affect execution; and task-level metrics hinder skill-specific diagnosis, while early failures leave later skills untested. We therefore introduce ManiUnit, a manipulation skill dataset and benchmark built from 50 BEHAVIOR-1K activities. Its dataset contains 137,899 segments across 21 skill types and 417 subtasks, and its benchmark contains 1,260 test instances. Correspondingly, ManiUnit pairs each segment with an explicit subtask instruction; measures sensitivity to perturbations of the robot's starting base position or joint configuration; and restores intermediate simulator states and defines local success conditions so that each skill can be evaluated without executing preceding stages. Evaluations of representative vision-language-action (VLA) policies show that similar aggregate scores can hide substantial per-skill differences. The tested starting-state perturbations also degrade execution: on the full benchmark, joint perturbations reduce success rates by approximately 56% relative to those from demonstrated starting states. On two long-horizon activities, a skill policy trained on ManiUnit segments achieves 78.7% local manipulation success, compared with 49.3% for a task policy trained on complete demonstrations. The trained skills further support complete-task execution on these activities, as coordinating the task and skill policies through a planner raises full-task success from 4.0% to 18.0%.

摘要（中文）：长视野移动操作要求机器人在单一自然语言指令下，在多房间环境中导航并执行一系列操作技能。学习与评估这些技能面临三大挑战：固定任务指令下的相似观测可能使技能选择产生歧义；即使前序技能执行成功，下一技能继承的机器人状态也可能偏离其演示起始状态，从而影响执行效果；此外，任务级指标阻碍了针对具体技能的诊断，而早期失败会使后续技能无法被测试。为此，我们推出了ManiUnit——一个基于50项BEHAVIOR-1K活动构建的操作技能数据集与基准。该数据集包含21种技能类型、417个子任务下的137,899个片段，基准则包含1,260个测试实例。相应地，ManiUnit为每个片段配对了明确的子任务指令；衡量了机器人起始基座位置或关节配置扰动对执行的影响；并恢复了中间模拟器状态、定义了局部成功条件，从而使每个技能无需执行前序阶段即可被独立评估。对代表性视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的评估显示，相近的总体得分可能掩盖显著的技能间差异。所测试的起始状态扰动同样会降低执行效果：在全基准上，与演示起始状态相比，关节扰动使成功率相对下降约56%。在两项长视野活动中，基于ManiUnit片段训练的技能策略取得了78.7%的局部操作成功率，而基于完整演示训练的任务策略仅为49.3%。所训练的技能进一步支持了这些活动中的完整任务执行——通过规划器协调任务策略与技能策略，完整任务成功率从4.0%提升至18.0%。

Authors: Guoting Wei, Dawei Yan, Xia Yuan, Gengming Zhang, Yelin He, Guodong Du, Jiaquan Ye, Heng Zhang, Xinming Wei, Xianbiao Qi, Chunxia Zhao, Haokui Zhang, Rong Xiao

SkillWeave: Weaving Heterogeneous Demonstrations into Long-Horizon Manipulation Skills Manipulation

heterogeneous demonstrations diffusion policy long-horizon manipulation object-mask conditioning policy composition

简要说明：SkillWeave提出了一种用于长时程灵巧操作的异构示范框架，结合遥操作和动觉教学，并通过掩码条件扩散策略和后续感知终端转向来提高真实世界的任务成功率。

TLDR: SkillWeave introduces a heterogeneous demonstration framework for long-horizon dexterous manipulation, combining teleoperation and kinesthetic teaching with a mask-conditioned diffusion policy and successor-aware terminal steering to improve real-world task success.

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation requires both large-scale task progression and precise contact-rich interaction, making it challenging to collect demonstrations that effectively support both regimes. We present SkillWeave, a heterogeneous demonstration framework for long-horizon dexterous manipulation that combines teleoperation for coarse reaching and transport with kinesthetic teaching for precise, contact-rich skills. To address the visual mismatch introduced by the demonstrator's presence during kinesthetic data collection, we propose an object-mask-conditioned diffusion policy that uses offline object segmentation for training supervision and a lightweight learned mask predictor at deployment, avoiding online segmentation and image inpainting. To mitigate distribution shift between independently trained sub-task policies, we introduce successor-aware terminal steering, which selects among actions sampled from the predecessor policy to guide the system toward states supported by the successor's demonstrated initial-state distribution. Across three real-world long-horizon tasks, SkillWeave achieves 27% average end-to-end success. Mask-conditioned kinesthetic policies improve dexterous sub-task success to an average of 65%, while successor-aware handoffs achieve an average composition efficiency of 87%. These results show that matching demonstration modality to interaction regime, explicitly addressing kinesthetic visual mismatch, and steering policy handoffs toward successor-supported states substantially improves long-horizon dexterous manipulation. Videos and code are available at skillweave-authors.github.io .

摘要（中文）：灵巧操作既需要大规模的任务推进，又需要精细的接触丰富交互，这使得收集能够有效支持这两种模式的操作演示变得极具挑战性。本文提出SkillWeave，一种用于长时程灵巧操作的异构演示框架，其结合了遥操作以完成粗略的到达与搬运，以及动觉示教以实现精细且接触丰富的技能。为解决动觉数据采集过程中示范者出现所引入的视觉不匹配问题，我们提出一种基于物体掩码条件化的扩散策略，该策略利用离线物体分割进行训练监督，并在部署时采用轻量级学习掩码预测器，从而避免在线分割与图像修复。为缓解独立训练的子任务策略之间的分布偏移，我们引入后继感知的末端引导机制，该机制从前序策略采样的动作中进行筛选，以引导系统进入后继策略所演示初始状态分布所支持的状态。在三个真实世界长时程任务中，SkillWeave实现了平均27%的端到端成功率。掩码条件化的动觉策略将灵巧子任务成功率提升至平均65%，而后继感知的交接机制则实现了平均87%的组合效率。上述结果表明，将演示模态与交互机制相匹配、显式解决动觉视觉不匹配问题，并引导策略交接走向后继策略所支持的状态，能够显著提升长时程灵巧操作性能。视频与代码已发布于skillweave-authors.github.io。

Authors: Ryosei Tamura, Xiaoxiang Dong, Uksang Yoo, Yuemin Mao, Romina Mir, Jonathan Francis, Jeffrey Ichnowski

Traceable World State: A Provenance-Aware State Representation and Deterministic Replay Framework for Robotic Systems Other

provenance-aware deterministic replay tamper-evident world state robotic systems

简要说明：本文介绍了可追溯世界状态（TWS），一种用于机器人系统的来源感知语义状态表示和确定性重放框架，能够实现防篡改日志、故障检测，并在多种仿真和机器人轨迹上实现精确重放。

TLDR: This paper introduces Traceable World State (TWS), a provenance-aware semantic state representation and deterministic replay framework for robotic systems, which ensures tamper-evident logging, fault detection, and exact replay across diverse simulations and robot trajectories.

Abstract: Robotic systems operating over extended tasks must maintain a world state assembled from observations arriving at different times, with varying confidence and potential revisions. Conventional representations emphasize latest estimates, hindering fact provenance, decision reproduction, or execution auditing. We present Traceable World State (TWS), a middleware-neutral semantic representation and reference runtime for provenance-aware robot world state. A TWS snapshot captures entities, relations, observations, confidence, and revision metadata. Validated update operations transform snapshots immutably, ordered updates support deterministic replay, and a canonical SHA-256 hash chain ensures tamper-evident logs. We evaluate TWS through schema conformance, complete state lifecycles, deterministic replay, and fault injection. Passing 38 tests across Python 3.10-3.14, the framework detects record corruptions, broken hash links, sequence discontinuities, and world mismatches. Across ten public BEHAVIOR-1K task definitions, TWS imported 153 entities and 146 relations with successful validation. On 103 NVIDIA Unitree G1 simulated trajectories containing 78,369 frames, TWS achieved exact terminal-state replay in all episodes and detected 412/412 injected corruptions with a 1.72% storage overhead over Plain JSONL.

摘要（中文）：面向长时间任务运行的机器人系统，必须维护一个由不同时刻到达、置信度各异且可能发生修订的观测所构建的世界状态。传统表示方法侧重于最新估计，这不利于事实溯源、决策复现或执行审计。我们提出了可溯源世界状态（Traceable World State, TWS），一种面向具备溯源能力的机器人世界状态的中立中间件语义表示及参考运行时。TWS快照捕获实体、关系、观测、置信度及修订元数据。经过验证的更新操作以不可变方式转换快照，有序更新支持确定性回放，规范化的SHA-256哈希链确保日志防篡改。我们通过模式一致性、完整状态生命周期、确定性回放及故障注入对TWS进行评估。在Python 3.10至3.14环境中通过38项测试，该框架能够检测记录损坏、哈希链断裂、序列不连续及世界状态不匹配等问题。在十个公开的BEHAVIOR-1K任务定义中，TWS成功导入153个实体和146条关系并通过验证。在包含78,369帧的103条NVIDIA Unitree G1模拟轨迹上，TWS在所有场景中实现了精确的终端状态回放，并检测出全部412/412次注入损坏，存储开销相比Plain JSONL仅增加1.72%。

Authors: Zoe Li

REACT: Rolling Denoising and Dual Decoupling for Reactive Robot Control with VLA Models VLA

flow-based VLA rolling denoising reactive control dual decoupling action buffer

简要说明：REACT 提出了一种用于基于流的 VLA 模型的滚动去噪框架，通过维持具有交错流时间步长的持久动作缓冲区，在保留长期上下文的同时实现反应式重规划，并利用双重解耦分离感知、编码、去噪和执行以实现实时控制。在仿真和真实操作任务中，它展示了更高的成功率、更低的延迟和更平滑的轨迹。

TLDR: REACT introduces a rolling-denoising framework for flow-based VLA models, maintaining a persistent action buffer with staggered flow timesteps to enable reactive replanning while preserving long-horizon context, and uses dual decoupling to separate sensing, encoding, denoising, and execution for real-time control. It demonstrates improved success rates, reduced latency, and smoother trajectories in simulation and real-world manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models generate action chunks for temporally coherent robot motion, but chunked control creates a fundamental closed-loop trade-off: long chunks provide smooth execution, whereas frequent replanning improves reactivity at the cost of action discontinuities. We introduce REACT, a rolling-denoising framework that makes flow-based VLAs more reactive while preserving long-horizon context. Instead of regenerating entire action chunks from scratch, REACT maintains a persistent action buffer with staggered flow timesteps. At each control step, the full horizon is denoised using the latest observation, the cleanest action block is executed, partially refined future blocks are shifted forward, and fresh noise is appended to the tail. As a result, each executed action block is refined across multiple recent observations before deployment. To support real-time control, we further introduce dual decoupling, which separates sensing, VLM encoding, DiT denoising, and action execution, enabling high-frequency observation updates and action streaming under practical compute constraints. Across the RoboTwin 2.0 simulation benchmark and real-world tasks spanning bimanual manipulation and dynamic control on multiple robot platforms, REACT improves task success and reduces reaction latency while producing smoother trajectories than frequent-replanning and asynchronous baselines.

摘要（中文）：基于流的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过生成动作块以实现时间上连贯的机器人运动，然而分块控制带来了一个基本的闭环权衡：长动作块提供平滑的执行过程，而频繁重新规划虽然提高了响应性，却以动作不连续为代价。我们提出了REACT，一种滚动去噪框架，使基于流的VLA模型在保持长时程上下文的同时更具响应性。REACT不再从头重新生成整个动作块，而是维护一个具有交错流时间步长的持久动作缓冲区。在每个控制步中，利用最新观测对整个规划时域进行去噪，执行最干净的动作块，将部分精化的未来块向前平移，并在尾部追加新的噪声。由此，每个被执行的动作块在部署前都经过多次近期观测的精化。为支持实时控制，我们进一步引入了双重解耦机制，将感知、视觉-语言模型编码、扩散变换器去噪和动作执行分离，从而在实际计算约束下实现高频观测更新和动作流式输出。在RoboTwin 2.0仿真基准以及覆盖双臂操作和多种机器人平台动态控制的真实世界任务中，REACT相比频繁重规划和异步基线方法，在提高任务成功率、降低反应延迟的同时，生成了更平滑的轨迹。

Authors: Houlong Xiong, Zhenqi Qiu, Zechen Wang, Suohang Zhang, Yiyu Ren, Wanting Xu, Hongfei Niu, Chengyang He, Ge Sun, Ran Cheng, Qian Zhu

TACROSS: An Efficient and Low-Cost Scalable Human Touch System Across Heterogeneous Tactile Sensors for Dexterous Robot Learning Manipulation

tactile sensing human-to-robot transfer contact event alignment dexterous manipulation data collection

简要说明：TACROSS 提出了一种低成本触觉手套系统及学习流程，通过将人类与机器人触觉信号在接触事件层面进行对齐，利用规范化器和残差适配器，高效地为异构传感器的灵巧机器人操作收集演示数据。

TLDR: TACROSS presents a low-cost tactile glove system and a learning pipeline that aligns human and robot tactile signals at the level of contact events, using canonicalizers and residual adapters, to efficiently collect demonstrations for dexterous robot manipulation across heterogeneous sensors.

Abstract: Collecting tactile demonstrations on robots is costly and slow, motivating the use of lower-cost human tactile gloves for scalable data collection. However, human capacitive/piezoresistive gloves and robotic tactile sensors differ fundamentally in transduction principle, sensor layout, spatial resolution, and dynamic response, making alignment of raw sensor channels ill-posed. To address this problem, we present TACROSS, a scalable system for learning from human touch and transferring it to robots that bridges this heterogeneity by aligning tactile streams at the level of contact events rather than raw sensor values. The hardware component of TACROSS integrates a piezoresistive glove with five layers and a cost of USD 10.86 with 285 sensing points. To align contact semantics, we design canonicalizers and residual adapters that map heterogeneous signals into a shared tactile latent with 256 dimensions via a temporal Transformer with attention across fingers. We further introduce a robot-grounded policy learning scheme in which robot demonstrations provide the sole source of ground-truth action supervision, while human demonstrations support tactile representation learning and provide confidence-weighted auxiliary supervision through valid retargeted hand targets. We evaluate our system on four contact-rich manipulation tasks. Compared to conventional teleoperation, our proposed system achieves a 3.5-fold efficiency improvement while reducing demonstration acquisition equipment cost by 95.7%. We will open-source the TACROSS hardware and software system and publicly release a tactile dataset comprising over 150 hours of recordings. Project page: https://tacross-touch-project.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：在机器人上收集触觉演示数据成本高昂且耗时，这促使研究者利用成本更低的人类触觉手套进行可扩展的数据采集。然而，人体电容式/压阻式手套与机器人触觉传感器在换能原理、传感器布局、空间分辨率和动态响应等方面存在根本性差异，使得原始传感器通道的对应问题难以有效求解。针对这一问题，我们提出了TACROSS——一个从人类触觉中学习并将其迁移至机器人的可扩展系统，该系统通过在对齐触觉流时以接触事件而非原始传感器数值为对齐层级，从而弥合上述异质性差异。TACROSS的硬件组件集成了一款五层压阻式手套，成本为10.86美元，包含285个传感点。为实现接触语义的对齐，我们设计了规范化器和残差适配器，通过一个跨手指注意力机制的时间Transformer将异构信号映射到256维的共享触觉潜空间。我们进一步引入了一种以机器人示教为锚定的策略学习方案，其中机器人示教提供唯一的地面真值动作监督来源，而人类示教则支撑触觉表征学习，并通过有效的重定向手部目标提供置信度加权的辅助监督。我们在四个接触密集型操作任务上评估了该系统。与传统遥操作相比，我们所提出的系统实现了3.5倍的效率提升，同时将演示采集设备成本降低了95.7%。我们将开源TACROSS硬件和软件系统，并公开发布一个包含超过150小时记录数据的触觉数据集。项目页面：https://tacross-touch-project.github.io/。

Authors: Bo Chen, Huanzhang Hu, Junyang Ma, Bo Yue, Fangdi Yu, Haijier Chen, Xianxin Lai, Shuyu Pan, Zhen Yang, Xiaoquan Sun, Wenze Cui, Zhongliang Jiang, Shaopeng Liu, Jiayu Chen

WAND: Learning Robust Navigation under Complex Wind Disturbances and Dense Obstacles for Quadrotors RLRobot

quadrotor navigation wind disturbance estimation reinforcement learning temporal convolutional network dense obstacle fields

简要说明：WAND 提出了一种在风扰动下进行四旋翼导航的强化学习框架，利用时间卷积网络估计风引起的加速度，并通过 WindAdapter 残差模块将估计集成到策略中，从而提高了在杂乱环境中的导航成功率。

TLDR: WAND introduces a reinforcement learning framework for quadrotor navigation under wind disturbances, using a Temporal Convolutional Network to estimate wind-induced acceleration and a WindAdapter residual module to integrate this estimate, improving navigation success in cluttered environments.

Abstract: Robust navigation in cluttered environments remains a fundamental challenge for quadrotors, particularly when strong wind disturbances arise, which perturb vehicle dynamics, limit control authority, and substantially increase collision risk. Existing learning-based navigation policies typically rely on obstacle perception and proprioceptive observations, requiring the policy to infer time-varying disturbance effects implicitly and thereby limiting robustness under partial observability. This paper proposes WAND (Wind-Aware Navigation with Disturbance Estimation), a reinforcement learning framework for navigation under time-varying wind disturbances in dense obstacle fields. Specifically, WAND estimates wind-induced disturbance acceleration from historical proprioceptive states using a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN). This estimation is integrated into the policy via a zero-initialized residual module, \emph{WindAdapter}, while simultaneously providing feedforward compensation for low-level control. The dual use of the estimate couples disturbance-conditioned navigation with feedforward disturbance rejection. Across 12 wind-disturbed simulation settings, WAND improved the observed success rate by 8.3 percentage points on average relative to feedforward compensation alone. Controlled opposite-crosswind experiments further showed wind-direction-dependent trajectory adaptation. In indoor fan-induced flight tests, WAND succeeded in 18 of 20 trials, demonstrating the feasibility of real-time onboard navigation.

摘要（中文）：在杂乱环境中进行鲁棒导航仍然是四旋翼飞行器面临的一项基本挑战，尤其是在强风扰动出现时，风扰会干扰飞行器动力学、限制控制权限，并显著增加碰撞风险。现有的基于学习的导航策略通常依赖障碍物感知和本体感受观测，要求策略隐式推断时变扰动效应，从而在部分可观测条件下限制了其鲁棒性。本文提出WAND（风感知与扰动估计导航），一种在密集障碍物区域中、时变风扰动下进行导航的强化学习框架。具体而言，WAND利用时间卷积网络（TCN）从历史本体感受状态中估计风致扰动加速度。该估计通过一个零初始化的残差模块——\emph{WindAdapter}——集成到策略中，同时为底层控制提供前馈补偿。估计的双重使用将扰动条件导航与前馈扰动抑制相结合。在12种风扰动仿真设置中，WAND相较于仅使用前馈补偿的方案，平均将观测成功率提升了8.3个百分点。受控的对向侧风实验进一步展示了依赖风向的轨迹自适应能力。在室内风扇诱导的飞行测试中，WAND在20次试验中成功完成18次，验证了实时机载导航的可行性。

Authors: Zhonghan Tang, Chenhui Li, Shuai Liang, Zhongrui You, Jianan Li, Bin Zhao, Zhigang Wang, Xuelong Li

Learning Language-Conditioned Traversability Representations for Adaptive Visual Navigation VLN

language-conditioned traversability visual navigation vision-language model flow-matching planner asynchronous architecture

简要说明：LaTraNav 提出了一种异步导航框架，将慢速 VLM 用于语言条件可通行性和目标表示，与快速流匹配规划器结合，提高了路径更新率和规划性能。

TLDR: LaTraNav introduces an asynchronous navigation framework combining a slow VLM for language-conditioned traversability/goal representations with a fast flow-matching planner, improving path update rates and planning performance.

Abstract: Traversability is essential for visual navigation but varies with robot capabilities and user preferences. Conventional pipelines often rely on explicit costmaps or segmentation masks with predefined criteria, requiring hand-crafted rules and careful tuning. Moreover, viewpoint-dependent segmentation masks complicate asynchronous planning under perception latency. We present LaTraNav, a framework that learns language-conditioned traversability representations for adaptive visual navigation. Its asynchronous architecture combines a slow vision-language model that produces latent representations of traversability and navigation goals, with a fast flow-matching planner conditioned on these representations. To train the system, we develop a simulation-based data generation pipeline with controllable trajectories, producing observations paired with language instructions, traversability maps, goal locations, and diverse trajectories. Photorealistic image translation further enhances visual realism. Evaluations on datasets from multiple sources demonstrate effective language-guided traversability segmentation and goal localization by the slow VLM, alongside adaptive pixel-space path planning by the fast planner. Latent conditioning improves planning performance over explicit segmentation masks, while asynchronous scheduling increases the path-update rate by $6.05\times$ at the same semantic-update rate.

摘要（中文）：可穿越性对于视觉导航至关重要，但其含义会随机器人能力与用户偏好而动态变化。传统方案通常依赖带有预定义准则的显式代价地图或分割掩码，这需要人工设计规则并精心调参。此外，视点相关的分割掩码使得在感知延迟条件下进行异步规划变得复杂。我们提出LaTraNav，一个学习语言条件化可穿越性表示以支持自适应视觉导航的框架。其异步架构将生成可穿越性与导航目标潜在表示的慢速视觉语言模型，与以这些表示作为条件的快速流匹配规划器相结合。为训练该系统，我们开发了基于仿真、具有可控轨迹的数据生成流水线，生成与语言指令、可穿越性地图、目标位置及多样轨迹配对的观测数据。逼真图像转换进一步增强了视觉真实感。在多来源数据集上的评估表明，慢速VLM可实现有效的语言引导可穿越性分割与目标定位，同时快速规划器能进行自适应像素级路径规划。与显式分割掩码相比，潜在条件化提高了规划性能，而在相同语义更新率下，异步调度使路径更新率提升了$6.05\times$。

Authors: Senda Chen, Changxu Cheng, Fangdi Li, Tao Wang, Wuyue Zhao

Acting from Belief, Looking When Needed: A Bayesian Spatial World Model for Navigation under Intermittent Perception WorldModel

Bayesian spatial world model intermittent perception navigation belief propagation selective observation

简要说明：本文提出ALONE，一种贝叶斯空间世界模型，通过维护环境信念并仅在需要时请求观测，实现间歇感知下的机器人导航，在仿真和真实无人机飞行中均以极低的观测频率取得了高成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces ALONE, a Bayesian spatial world model that enables robot navigation under intermittent perception by maintaining a belief over the environment and selectively requesting observations only when needed, achieving high success rates with dramatically reduced sensor usage in both simulation and real-world drone flight.

Abstract: Robot navigation commonly uses wide-coverage, high-frequency sensing to reduce partial observability; this reliance becomes restrictive when another task temporarily redirects a shared sensor from navigation, interrupting navigation-relevant observations. We study navigation under intermittent perception: acting from an internal spatial belief and looking again only when execution needs a new observation, potentially freeing the shared sensor for other tasks between navigation observations. ALONE, a Bayesian spatial world model, propagates a structured spatial belief using executed actions and corrects it with selectively acquired observations; learned priors over common geometric structures infer unobserved structure from available observation history. It decodes the belief into a spatial estimate for the motion-planning module and predicts a reliability map expressing confidence in the estimate's accuracy. ALONE requests an observation only if insufficient reliability hinders navigation and new evidence should make relevant-region spatial information more reliable; otherwise, it continues acting from the propagated belief. We instantiate ALONE for drone navigation with intermittent single-camera depth images. Across two simulated scene families, it achieves 98% and 97% closed-loop success at a 10 Hz decision rate. Among successful trials, median fractions of decision steps requiring a new depth observation are only 0.9% and 1.3%, respectively, demonstrating high navigation success with substantially reduced observation demand. Real-world indoor flight experiments further validate navigation under intermittent depth observations, with all 10 trials successful.

摘要（中文）：机器人导航通常采用大范围、高频率的感知来降低部分可观测性；当另一项任务暂时将共享传感器从导航中移开，中断与导航相关的观测时，这种依赖便成为限制。我们研究间歇性感知下的导航问题：基于内部空间信念执行动作，仅在执行需要新观测时才重新感知，从而在导航观测之间释放共享传感器以供其他任务使用。ALONE——一种贝叶斯空间世界模型——利用已执行的动作传播结构化的空间信念，并通过选择性获取的观测对其进行校正；对常见几何结构的学习先验可从已有观测历史中推断未观测到的结构。它将信念解码为供运动规划模块使用的空间估计，并预测一幅可靠性图，表达对估计精度的置信度。仅当可靠性不足而阻碍导航、且新证据应能使相关区域的空间信息更可靠时，ALONE才请求一次观测；否则，它继续基于传播后的信念执行动作。我们将ALONE实例化用于间歇性单相机深度图像下的无人机导航。在两个模拟场景族中，该方法在10 Hz决策频率下分别实现了98%和97%的闭环成功率。在成功试验中，需要新深度观测的决策步数比例中位数分别仅为0.9%和1.3%，表明在显著降低观测需求的情况下仍能保持较高的导航成功率。真实室内飞行实验进一步验证了间歇性深度观测下的导航性能，全部10次试验均成功。

Authors: Feihong Yang, Xiang Long, Jincheng Yu, Jianfei Zhang, Guangjun Ge, Chao Wang, Yu Wang

CoCam4D: Geometry-Aware Cooperative 4D Perception for Camera-Only Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

collaborative perception camera-only 3D Gaussian uncertainty estimation C-V2X

简要说明：CoCam4D提出了一种用于纯相机自动驾驶的贝叶斯协同感知框架，通过VGGT-based 3D高斯场景表示建模几何不确定性，使车辆共享紧凑的高斯原语以减少深度不确定性，无需激光雷达，在基准数据集上取得了显著改进。

TLDR: CoCam4D introduces a Bayesian collaborative perception framework for camera-only autonomous driving that models geometric uncertainty using VGGT-based 3D Gaussian scene representations, enabling vehicles to share compact Gaussian primitives to reduce depth uncertainty without LiDAR, achieving significant improvements on benchmark datasets.

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles often suffer from limited perception due to occlusions, blind spots, limited sensor range, and the complex nature of surrounding environments. Multi-agent collaborative perception (CP) addresses these challenges by allowing vehicles to share sensory information and reconstruct the scene cooperatively. However, camera-only perception remains fundamentally limited by the uncertainty of distance-dependent monocular depth estimation. We propose CoCam4D, a Bayesian framework for collaborative perception that explicitly models geometric uncertainty. It uses a VGGT-based feedforward network to generate 3D Gaussian scene representations with associated uncertainty estimates, enabling multiple vehicles or agents to efficiently combine their observations. By sharing compact Gaussian primitives, reliable observations from one agent can reduce the depth uncertainty of another without requiring LiDAR sensors. To support real-world deployment, we introduce Dynamic Object Primitives (DOPs), a compact 35-byte representation designed for efficient C-V2X communication. Extensive experiments show that our proposed method consistently outperforms recent vision-only methods, achieving improvements of 11.48% on OPV2V+ and 10.62% on DAIR-V2X-C, demonstrating the potential of geometrically grounded collaborative perception for LiDAR-free autonomous driving.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶汽车常常因遮挡、盲区、传感器探测范围有限以及周围环境的复杂性而面临感知能力受限的问题。多智能体协同感知（CP）通过允许车辆共享传感信息并协同重建场景来应对这些挑战。然而，纯视觉感知在根本上仍受限于与距离相关的单目深度估计的不确定性。我们提出了CoCam4D，一种显式建模几何不确定性的贝叶斯协同感知框架。该框架利用基于VGGT的前馈网络生成带有相关不确定性估计的3D高斯场景表示，使多辆车或多智能体能够高效地融合各自的观测信息。通过共享紧凑的高斯基元，一个智能体的可靠观测能够降低另一个智能体的深度不确定性，而无需依赖激光雷达传感器。为支持实际部署，我们引入了动态对象基元（DOPs），一种专为高效C-V2X通信设计的35字节紧凑表示。大量实验表明，我们提出的方法持续优于近期纯视觉方法，在OPV2V+和DAIR-V2X-C数据集上分别实现了11.48%和10.62%的性能提升，展现了基于几何约束的协同感知在无激光雷达自动驾驶中的潜力。

Authors: Soham Pahari, Sudip Das, Arindam Das, Ujjwal Bhattacharya

RAGNAROK: Radar-Aided Gravity-Normalized Alignment for Robust Open Keyframe-based Radar-Visual-Kinematic-Inertial SLAM Locomotion

legged robot state estimation radar-visual-inertial SLAM slip-aware leg velocity kinematics-aware radar factor online extrinsic calibration

简要说明：RAGNAROK 提出了一种针对腿式机器人的雷达-视觉-运动学-惯性 SLAM 系统，集成了打滑感知的腿部速度估计、运动学感知的雷达因子、退化感知的图像增强以及在线外参标定，在复杂地形中实现了鲁棒的状态估计。

TLDR: RAGNAROK presents a radar-visual-kinematic-inertial SLAM system for legged robots, integrating slip-aware leg velocity estimation, a kinematics-aware radar factor, degradation-aware image enhancement, and online extrinsic calibration, achieving robust state estimation in challenging terrains.

Abstract: Legged robots offer superior mobility in unstructured environments, but reliable operation in such conditions requires robust state estimation. To address the vulnerability of proprioceptive estimators in rough terrain, recent methods have incorporated radar to provide velocity measurements. However, their limited yaw observability still leads to drift, and failure-aware fusion for adverse environments remains underexplored. In this letter, we present RAGNAROK, the first radar-visual-kinematic-inertial SLAM designed for robust operation in challenging environments. It integrates slip- and rolling-contact-aware leg velocity estimation, a kinematics-aware radar factor, and degradation-aware image enhancement. We further incorporate a B-spline-based radar-aided proprioceptive backbone, adaptive weighting, and online extrinsic calibration. Extensive experiments on public and self-collected datasets demonstrate that RAGNAROK achieves robust performance under challenging conditions and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. The source code and dataset are available at https://github.com/hanjun815/RAGNAROK.

摘要（中文）：腿式机器人在非结构化环境中展现出卓越的机动性，但在此类条件下实现可靠运行需依赖鲁棒的状态估计。为应对足式内传感器估计器在崎岖地形中的脆弱性，近期方法引入雷达以提供速度测量。然而，其有限的偏航可观测性仍会导致漂移，且针对恶劣环境的故障感知融合技术尚未得到充分探索。本文提出RAGNAROK，这是首个专为挑战性环境鲁棒运行设计的雷达-视觉-运动学-惯性SLAM系统。该系统集成了滑动与滚动接触感知的腿部速度估计、运动学感知的雷达因子以及退化感知的图像增强。我们进一步引入基于B样条的雷达辅助足式内传感器骨干网络、自适应加权及在线外参标定。在公开数据集与自采数据集上的大量实验表明，RAGNAROK在挑战性条件下实现了鲁棒性能，并优于现有最优基线方法。源代码与数据集可在https://github.com/hanjun815/RAGNAROK获取。

Authors: Hanjun Kim, Chiyun Noh, Sangwoo Jung, Jaehyung Jung, Simon Boche, Cedric Le Gentil, Stefan Leutenegger, Ayoung Kim

WARP-VLA: Wrist-Camera Adaptation for View-Robust Policy Execution in Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

Vision-Language-Action Models Wrist-Camera Robustness Mixture-of-Experts View Adaptation Robotic Manipulation

简要说明：本文提出WARP-VLA，一种基于混合专家架构的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过学习视角特定特征变换来增强对腕部相机位姿变化的鲁棒性，在LIBERO基准和真实机器人上显著提升了成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces WARP-VLA, a Mixture-of-Experts-based VLA model that learns view-specific feature transformations to become robust to wrist-camera pose variations, significantly improving success rates on LIBERO and transferring to real robots.

Abstract: Despite recent advances in Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) for robotic manipulation, their performance remains sensitive to changes in camera configuration. The problem becomes more evident in cross-setup deployment, as reproducing the exact camera pose used for training is nearly impossible. Unlike fixed external views, wrist views are more challenging because the camera moves with the robot, causing even small mounting variations to alter fine-grained geometric cues. To address this, we propose WARP-VLA, a camera-view robust VLA for diverse wrist camera configurations. WARP-VLA adopts a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture where individual experts learn view-specific feature transformations, and a router combines them based on implicit view information. This allows the policy to be deployed without requiring camera extrinsic parameters as additional input. Through experiments on the LIBERO benchmark, WARP-VLA improves the average success rate of pi-0.5 from 39.2% to 78.3% under wrist-view perturbations. The real-robot experiments further show that the feature-level adaptation learned in simulation successfully transfers to diverse deployment settings. To facilitate reproducibility and future research, we release our wrist viewpoint robustness benchmark and a plug-and-play implementation.

摘要（中文）：尽管近期视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在机器人操作领域取得了进展，但其性能仍对相机配置的变化高度敏感。这一问题在跨场景部署中尤为突出，因为几乎不可能精确复现训练时使用的相机位姿。与固定的外部视角不同，腕部视角更具挑战性，因为相机随机器人运动，即便微小的安装差异也会改变细粒度的几何线索。为解决这一问题，我们提出了WARP-VLA，一种适应多种腕部相机配置的视角鲁棒VLA模型。WARP-VLA采用专家混合（MoE）架构，各专家学习视角特定的特征变换，路由器基于隐式视角信息对其输出进行组合。这使得策略在部署时无需额外输入相机外参。在LIBERO基准上的实验表明，在腕部视角扰动下，WARP-VLA将pi-0.5的平均成功率从39.2%提升至78.3%。真实机器人实验进一步验证了仿真中学习的特征级自适应能够成功迁移至多种部署场景。为促进可复现性和后续研究，我们公开了腕部视点鲁棒性基准及即插即用的实现代码。

Authors: Junmyeong Lee, Dongmin Shin, Min-Gyu Park, Wooseok Jeon, Inho Chang, Hae-Gon Jeon

DAMP: Humanoid Locomotion via Denoised Belief Learning and Adversarial Motion Priors HumanoidEmbodied

reinforcement learning humanoid locomotion adversarial motion priors recurrent neural networks sim-to-real transfer

简要说明：DAMP 提出了一种无需感知信息、基于强化学习的人形机器人运动框架，利用循环神经网络推断潜在信息并采用对抗式运动先验，实现了从仿真到真实世界的迁移。

TLDR: DAMP presents a reinforcement learning framework for humanoid locomotion over challenging terrains without perception, using recurrent networks to infer latent information and adversarial motion priors, with successful sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: Humanoid robots possess the structural capability to traverse complex terrains. However, achieving stable t raversal without relying on perceived information remains challenging, particularly in complex environments. This paper introduces DAMP, a reinforcement learning framework aimed at achieving robust and naturalistic humanoid locomotion over challenging terrains, with the assumption that no perceived information is available. The framework leverages recurrent neural networks to capture temporal dependencies and implicitly infer privileged and other task-relevant latent information. By aligning the learned representations with the task objective, the method enables robust and goal-consistent policy learning. This end-to-end framework achieves transfer learning from simulation to real-world environments, demonstrating the proposed method's robustness and generalization capabilities. The video of the real-world demonstration can be found at the following link: https://youtu.be/AkI7TZB2DDM.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人具备穿越复杂地形的结构能力。然而，在不依赖感知信息的情况下实现稳定穿越仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在复杂环境中。本文介绍了DAMP，一种强化学习框架，旨在实现人形机器人在挑战性地形上的鲁棒且自然的运动，并假设无法获得感知信息。该框架利用递归神经网络捕捉时间依赖性，并隐式推断特权信息及其他与任务相关的潜在信息。通过将学习到的表征与任务目标对齐，该方法实现了鲁棒且与目标一致的政策学习。这一端到端框架实现了从仿真到真实环境的迁移学习，展示了所提方法的鲁棒性和泛化能力。真实世界演示视频可通过以下链接查看：https://youtu.be/AkI7TZB2DDM。

Authors: Puying Shen, Wenhao Cui, Huaxing Huang, Bangyu Qin, Shengtao Li, Ziyang Dong, Guoteng Zhang

RoboAware: Learning to Coordinate Embodied Skills from Counterfactual Outcomes Manipulation

skill orchestration counterfactual outcomes hierarchical MDP Monte Carlo tree search embodied coding agents

简要说明：RoboAware通过反事实结果学习状态条件协调器，在编码代理中选择具身技能族，在操作基准上取得了高成功率。

TLDR: RoboAware learns a state-conditioned coordinator that selects among embodied skill families in coding agents using counterfactual outcomes, achieving high success rates on manipulation benchmarks.

Abstract: Embodied coding agents can combine modular robot skills with frozen end-to-end policies, yet effective composition requires anticipating which policy family will succeed in the current physical state. We present RoboAware, which builds on coding agents' skill orchestration by learning only a state-conditioned responsibility coordinator from counterfactual outcomes. Inspired by the success of REPL, we propose the $P^5$ schema and formulate a hierarchical MDP based on it. $P^5$ organizes skills uniformly into five semantic stages, defining where responsibility can be compared. To address the lack of counterfactual branch outcomes in existing work, we introduce State-Locked Counterfactual Branching (SCB), which restores the same training state to generate and execute a code block from each admissible family, exposing outcomes that selected-branch experience leaves unobserved. Building on this, we propose Execution-Aware Learning (EAL), which combines Monte Carlo tree search with Q-learning to distill these outcomes into family-conditioned values. At deployment, the coordinator selects the policy family according to observable context, and the frozen coding agent generates the next local code block. Comprehensive single-episode evaluations on 100 tasks show that RoboAware reaches a 77.0% overall success rate, with SOTA averages of 90.0% on RoboSuite, 73.8% on diverse LIBERO-Pro task clusters, and 90.0% on challenging RoboTwin bimanual tasks, outperforming existing code-as-policy and VLA-harness baselines.

摘要（中文）：具身编码智能体能够将模块化机器人技能与冻结的端到端策略相结合，然而，有效的组合需要预判在当前物理状态下哪一类策略族能够成功。我们提出了RoboAware，它仅通过从反事实结果中学习一个状态条件化的责任协调器，来增强编码智能体的技能编排能力。受REPL成功经验的启发，我们提出了$P^5$模式，并基于该模式构建了一个层次化马尔可夫决策过程。$P^5$将技能统一组织为五个语义阶段，明确了在何处可以进行责任比较。为解决现有工作中缺乏反事实分支结果的问题，我们引入了状态锁定反事实分支（SCB），该方法通过恢复相同的训练状态，从每个可行策略族中生成并执行一段代码块，从而暴露出仅靠所选分支经验无法观测的结果。在此基础上，我们提出了执行感知学习（EAL），该方法将蒙特卡洛树搜索与Q学习相结合，将这些结果提炼为基于策略族条件的状态价值。在部署阶段，协调器根据可观测的上下文选择策略族，冻结的编码智能体则生成下一局部代码块。在100项任务上的全面单回合评估显示，RoboAware的整体成功率达到77.0%，其中在RoboSuite上平均成功率达90.0%，在多样化的LIBERO-Pro任务簇上达73.8%，在具有挑战性的RoboTwin双臂任务上达90.0%，均优于现有的代码即策略和VLA增强基线方法。

Authors: Bohan Zhou, Xingbei Chen, Emily Huang, Weilin Ruan, Haojian Huang, Yehang Zhang, Zexi Li, Wenqian Li, Qize Yu, Zetian Song, Leyi Wu, Jinghao Li, Mingxuan Song, Xinrun Xu, Zongyang Qiu, Yangkai Wei, Tianyi Zhang, Kaiwen Zhou, Yinchuan Li, James Cheng

USDCraft: Geometrically Grounded Programmatic Modeling of Articulated 3D Assets for Simulation Manipulation

articulated assets LLM simulation programmatic modeling real-to-sim

简要说明：USDCraft 提出了一种框架，利用预训练的LLM根据部分几何证据迭代编写和修改可执行程序，以重建铰接式3D资产，生成可直接用于机器人操作模拟的资产。

TLDR: USDCraft presents a framework that uses a pretrained LLM to iteratively write and revise executable programs for articulated 3D asset reconstruction from partial geometric evidence, producing simulation-ready assets for robot manipulation.

Abstract: Geometrically faithful and functional articulated 3D assets are essential for real-to-sim robot manipulation, where policies trained in simulation must transfer to physical objects. Recent mesh-based methods learn to infer articulation from annotated 3D assets, but deployment remains challenging when real-world objects fall outside the training distribution or their meshes are incomplete or corrupted. To address these limitations, we formulate articulated asset reconstruction as programmatic modeling grounded in partial geometric evidence and introduce USDCraft, a framework in which a pretrained LLM writes and revises executable programs for simulation-ready articulated assets without task-specific training. We propose source geometry analysis, which converts the source mesh into a metric textual description that distinguishes observed surface from unknown space, and iterative geometric rechecking, which re-encodes each candidate in the same representation so that discrepancies point to program edits while unobserved regions remain open to completion. Visual feedback and physical authoring guidance complete the modeling process, which produces articulated USD assets with explicit physical properties that load into Isaac Sim without manual adjustment. Experiments demonstrate leading articulation recovery on two benchmarks and validate USDCraft's effectiveness for real-to-sim-to-real robot manipulation.

摘要（中文）：几何保真且功能完整的关节式三维资产对于真实到仿真的机器人操作至关重要，因为在这种场景下，在仿真中训练的策略必须迁移到物理对象上。近期基于网格的方法尝试从带标注的三维资产中推断关节结构，但当现实世界中的物体超出训练分布或网格不完整、受损时，部署仍面临挑战。为应对这些局限，本文将关节式资产重建形式化为基于部分几何证据的程序化建模问题，并提出USDCraft框架——该框架利用预训练的大语言模型编写并修订可执行的程序，以生成可直接用于仿真的关节式资产，而无需任务特定的训练。我们提出源几何分析方法，将源网格转换为度量化的文本描述，用以区分已观测表面与未知空间；同时提出迭代几何复核方法，以相同表示重新编码每个候选结果，使差异指向程序编辑，而未被观测的区域则保持补全的开放性。视觉反馈与物理建模指导完善了整个建模流程，最终生成具有显式物理属性且无需人工调整即可加载至Isaac Sim的关节式USD资产。实验表明，该方法在两个基准上取得了领先的关节恢复性能，并验证了USDCraft在真实到仿真再到真实机器人操作中的有效性。

Authors: Chuanrui Zhang, Zaijia Yang, Duomin Wang, Lu Shi, Daquan Zhou, Ruihua Zhang, Ziwei Wang

OmniDex: Scaling Dexterous Hand Grasping to Diverse Cluttered Scenes Manipulation

dexterous grasping sim-to-real generative model soft winner-takes-all physics-driven ranking

简要说明：OmniDex 提出了一个包含260万个杂乱场景和4亿个抓取标注的大规模仿真基准，并采用软胜者全取和物理驱动排序的生成模型，实现了无需后续优化的稳健实时灵巧抓取。

TLDR: OmniDex introduces a large-scale simulation benchmark of 2.6 million cluttered scenes with 0.4B grasp annotations for dexterous hand grasping, and proposes a generative model with Soft Winner-Takes-All and physics-driven ranking to achieve robust, real-time performance.

Abstract: Dexterous grasping is the foundational primitive in embodied AI, demanding massive data to train robust models. As real-world data collection is expensive, simulation has become the mainstream paradigm. Yet, while cluttered scenes best reflect real-world applications, learning to grasp within them is bottlenecked by a critical scarcity of large-scale data. To resolve this, we curate high-quality 3D objects and supporting bases, proposing a scalable seed-and-filter strategy that bypasses sluggish scene-level optimization. This yields an unprecedented benchmark comprising over 2.6 million scenes and 0.4B scene-specific grasp ground truths, featuring diverse realistic layouts paired with rich semantic and geometric observations. Furthermore, we introduce the OmniDex model to overcome the grasp multimodality and last-millimeter precision errors plaguing current generative models. By coupling Soft Winner-Takes-All learning with human-inspired physical constraints during training, and utilizing physics-driven ranking, our approach achieves robust dexterous grasping without the latency of post-optimization. Experimental results show that OmniDex model achieves state-of-the-art performance and strong generalization across diverse scenes, views, and unseen objects.

摘要（中文）：灵巧抓取是具身智能的基础操作，需要海量数据来训练稳健的模型。由于真实世界的数据采集成本高昂，仿真已成为主流范式。然而，尽管杂乱场景最能反映实际应用需求，在此类场景中学习抓取却受限于大规模数据的严重匮乏。为解决这一问题，我们精选高质量的三维物体及支撑基座，提出一种可扩展的“筛选-生成”策略，绕开低效的场景级优化过程。由此构建了一个前所未有的基准数据集，包含超过260万个场景及4亿个场景相关的抓取真值，兼具多样化的真实布局及丰富的语义与几何观测信息。此外，我们提出了OmniDex模型，以克服当前生成模型在抓取多模态性和末毫米精度误差方面的不足。通过在训练过程中将软胜者全取学习与受人类启发的物理约束相结合，并借助物理驱动的排序机制，我们的方法实现了稳健的灵巧抓取，且无需后优化的额外延迟。实验结果表明，OmniDex模型在多样场景、视角及未见物体上均达到了最先进的性能，并展现出强大的泛化能力。

Authors: Naiyu Fang, Zhongjin Luo, Yuxin Mo, Siyuan Huang, Jianbo Liu, Yufei Liu, Zheyuan Zhou, Chenkai Jin, Xiaogang Wang, Hongsheng Li

PMTRM: Pseudo-Memory Temporal Re-encoding Module for Embodied Policy Learning Manipulation

phase ambiguity temporal re-encoding embodied policy learning history encoding robotic manipulation

简要说明：PMTRM是一个轻量级插件模块，将机器人状态和动作的有界历史编码为潜在序列，以解决机器人操作策略中的相位模糊问题，在极少增加计算量的情况下提高任务成功率。

TLDR: PMTRM is a lightweight plug-in module that encodes a bounded history of robot states and actions into a latent sequence to resolve phase ambiguity in robotic manipulation policies, improving task success with minimal added computation.

Abstract: Robotic manipulation often contains repeated motions whose local observations look similar at different phases. When these phases require different actions, a policy that relies mainly on the current observation may repeat completed motions or switch phases at the wrong time. To address this phase ambiguity, we present the Pseudo-Memory Temporal Re-encoding Module (PMTRM), a lightweight plug-in module with only 7.61M parameters that encodes a bounded history of executed states and actions into a latent sequence for existing policies. To help distinguish phases, a temporal heterogeneity objective penalizes positive similarity between distant positions in this sequence, while anchor and reconstruction losses preserve information needed for action prediction. The reconstruction decoder is used only during training, leaving the temporal re-encoder to supply history to the policy at inference. We train the module progressively on synthetic sequences and robot data, then jointly with the policy, using temporal masking to accommodate partial histories. This integration retains the original action head and action space and adds auxiliary losses to the original policy loss. Experiments with multiple policy backbones in simulation and on a real robot show improved task success on tasks with phase ambiguity, with little additional computation.

摘要（中文）：机器人操作中常常包含重复运动，这些运动在不同阶段对应的局部观测看起来十分相似。当这些阶段需要不同的动作时，仅仅依赖当前观测的策略可能会重复已完成的动作，或在错误的时机切换阶段。为了解决这种阶段模糊性问题，我们提出了伪记忆时间重编码模块（PMTRM），这是一种轻量级插件模块，仅含7.61M参数，可将已执行状态和动作的有界历史编码为潜在序列，供现有策略使用。为帮助区分不同阶段，时间异质性目标对该序列中相距较远的位置之间的正相似性施加惩罚，而锚点损失和重构损失则保留动作预测所需的信息。重构解码器仅在训练期间使用，推理时由时间重编码器向策略提供历史信息。我们首先在合成序列和机器人数据上逐步训练该模块，随后与策略联合训练，并利用时间掩码来适应不完整的历史信息。这种集成方式保留了原始动作头和动作空间，并在原始策略损失的基础上增加了辅助损失。在仿真环境和真实机器人上使用多种策略主干进行的实验表明，该方法在存在阶段模糊性的任务中成功率和任务完成度均有提升，且额外计算开销很小。

Authors: Changchuan Yang, Haoxuan Xu, Wenbo Chen, Shuai Ren, Jianlong Zheng, Huarui Zhang, Tianfu Li, Guanzhong Tian

VGGTWorld-VLA: Intent-Conditioned 3D World Evolution for Autonomous Driving WorldModel

3D world prediction action-semantic conditioning geometry-language-action bridge autonomous driving intention-conditioned

简要说明：本文提出VGGTWorld-VLA，一种基于意图条件的世界模型扩展，通过注入动作-语义条件和几何-语言-动作桥接，实现自动驾驶中可控的3D未来几何预测，并在NAVSIM上展示了竞争性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes VGGTWorld-VLA, an intention-conditioned extension of VGGT-World that injects action-semantic conditioning and a geometry-language-action bridge to enable controllable 3D future geometry prediction for autonomous driving, demonstrating competitive performance on NAVSIM.

Abstract: VGGT provides a strong foundation for geometry-centric world models by recovering unified 3D scene geometry from visual observations. Although recent extensions enable temporal 3D prediction, their future evolution remains weakly conditioned on driving intentions and actions, limiting their ability to model alternative action-dependent futures. We propose VGGTWorld-VLA, an intention-conditioned extension of VGGT-World for controllable 3D world evolution in autonomous driving. First, we introduce an action--semantic conditioning mechanism that injects complementary driving semantics and ego-motion representations into the future-token stream, enabling different future geometry predictions for the same observed scene under alternative ego actions. Second, we develop a geometry--language--action bridge that adapts historical geometry, VLA semantic features, and maneuver and trajectory representations for joint conditioning of future geometry prediction. We evaluate future geometry prediction on NAVSIM, while conditioning ablations further examine the contributions of semantic and action information. Compared with the baseline, our method demonstrates competitive geometry prediction performance. Ablation studies further support the effectiveness of semantic and action conditioning. These results demonstrate the potential of semantic and action conditioning for controllable VGGT-based world prediction in autonomous driving.

摘要（中文）：VGGT通过从视觉观测中恢复统一的3D场景几何，为以几何为中心的世界模型提供了坚实基础。尽管最近的扩展实现了时间维度的3D预测，但其未来的演化仍缺乏对驾驶意图和动作的有效条件约束，限制了其建模依赖于不同动作的多种未来情景的能力。我们提出VGGTWorld-VLA，一种面向自动驾驶中可控3D世界演化的VGGT-World意图条件扩展方法。首先，我们引入一种动作-语义条件机制，将互补的驾驶语义和自车运动表示注入未来令牌流中，使得在相同观测场景下、不同自车动作条件下能够生成不同的未来几何预测。其次，我们构建一个几何-语言-动作桥接模块，将历史几何信息、VLA语义特征以及操控和轨迹表示适配为联合条件，以指导未来几何预测。我们在NAVSIM上评估未来几何预测性能，并通过条件消融实验进一步考察语义和动作信息的贡献。与基线方法相比，我们的方法在几何预测性能上表现出竞争力。消融研究进一步验证了语义和动作条件化的有效性。这些结果证明了语义和动作条件化在自动驾驶中基于VGGT的可控世界预测方面的潜力。

Authors: Zhaoyang Liu, Kun Jiang, Ziying Song, Diange Yang

FOCUS: From Privileged States to RGB-D with Controlled Modality Switching and Representation Alignment RLRobot

privileged state modality switching representation alignment RGB-D robotic manipulation

简要说明：FOCUS 是一个用于基于视觉的机器人操作的单阶段 PPO 框架，它利用特权状态训练评论家，并通过 KL 散度驱动的模态切换和表示对齐，逐步将演员的 rollout 从特权状态潜在表示过渡到 RGB-D 输入，从而在五个操作任务中显著提高了样本效率和测试成功率。

TLDR: FOCUS is a single-stage PPO framework for vision-based robotic manipulation that trains the critic on privileged states while using KL-divergence-driven modality switching and representation alignment to gradually shift actor rollouts from privileged-state latents to RGB-D inputs, significantly improving sample efficiency and test-time success across five manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Vision-based reinforcement learning for robotic manipulation is sample-inefficient because RGB-D observations are high-dimensional and noisy. Privileged state information available in simulation can accelerate training, but its absence at test time creates a train-test modality gap. We propose FOCUS, a single-stage PPO framework that trains the critic on privileged state while automatically regulating whether the actor collects rollouts from RGB-D or privileged-state latents. Regulation is driven by the KL divergence between the action distributions induced by the two modalities, while representation alignment encourages consistent action selection across them. Together, these mechanisms limit RGB-D rollouts when the actor's action distributions from RGB-D and privileged-state latents disagree. As they align, RGB-D exposure increases, shifting on-policy training toward the RGB-D inputs used at test time. Across five manipulation tasks, FOCUS raises average test success from 0.71 to 0.93 relative to the strongest RGB-D-at-test baseline on each task. When accounting for each method's complete training pipeline, budget-normalized training-success AUC increases from 0.47 to 0.65. On Pick-and-Place, test success rises from 0.47 to 0.86, while AUC increases from 0.12 to 0.61, a 5.0x improvement in learning efficiency over the fixed interaction budget.

摘要（中文）：基于视觉的强化学习在机器人操作任务中因RGB-D观测的高维性和噪声而样本效率低下。仿真环境中可获取的特权状态信息能够加速训练，但其在测试阶段不可用，导致训练与测试之间存在模态差异。我们提出FOCUS，一种单阶段PPO框架，该框架在特权状态上训练评论家网络，同时自动调节演员网络从RGB-D或特权状态隐变量中采集轨迹数据。该调节机制由两种模态诱导的动作分布之间的KL散度驱动，而表示对齐则促进跨模态的一致动作选择。当演员网络从RGB-D和特权状态隐变量得到的动作分布不一致时，这些机制共同限制RGB-D轨迹采集；当两者逐渐对齐时，RGB-D暴露增加，使在线策略训练向测试阶段所使用的RGB-D输入转移。在五项操作任务中，相对于各任务中最强的RGB-D测试基线，FOCUS将平均测试成功率从0.71提升至0.93。在考虑各方法完整训练流程的情况下，预算归一化的训练成功AUC从0.47提升至0.65。在抓取-放置任务中，测试成功率从0.47提升至0.86，而AUC从0.12提升至0.61，在固定交互预算下学习效率提升了5.0倍。

Authors: Filip Grigorov, Kourosh Darvish, Nandita Vijaykumar

Rendering-Free Lookahead for Question-Guided Active Vision VLA

question-guided active vision camera motion selection vision-language models privileged lookahead 3D Gaussian Splatting

简要说明：RFL通过从3DGS场景中的VLM特权前瞻进行蒸馏，学习相机控制策略，无需渲染未来视图即可部署，从而提高了问题引导主动视觉的性能。

TLDR: RFL learns a camera-control policy for question-guided active vision by distilling privileged lookahead from a VLM in 3DGS scenes, enabling deployment without rendering future views and improving question-answering performance.

Abstract: Active robot vision requires controlling the camera to reveal task-relevant information that is hidden from the current viewpoint. For example, determining what is inside a box may require raising the camera and looking down into it. For viewpoint-dependent question answering, the challenge is to select camera motions that expose the visual evidence needed to answer the question. Although vision-language models (VLMs) can interpret observed images, selecting such motions requires anticipating the usefulness of unseen views. We quantify this usefulness as answerability, a VLM's estimate that a view suffices to answer the question, and present Rendering-Free Lookahead (RFL), a viewpoint-selection policy that ranks candidate camera motions by predicted future answerability. RFL transfers visual lookahead from deployment to offline training. At training, a privileged teacher renders candidate future views in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes and uses a frozen VLM to compute one- and two-step answerability targets. Through two-stage distillation, a student learns to predict these action values from the question, recent visual observations, and a candidate camera motion. At deployment, RFL uses these predicted values to select camera motions without rendering future views. On 377 E3VS-Bench test episodes in unseen environments, RFL improves the mean judge score by 43\% over a direct-action baseline using the same VLM. These results support learning camera-control policies from privileged visual lookahead for viewpoint-dependent question answering.

摘要（中文）：主动式机器人视觉要求控制摄像头以获取当前视角下不可见但与任务相关的信息。例如，判断盒子内的物品可能需要抬高摄像头并俯视盒内。对于依赖视角的问答任务，其挑战在于选择能够暴露回答问题所需视觉证据的摄像头运动。尽管视觉-语言模型（VLMs）能够理解观测到的图像，但选择此类运动需要对尚未观察到的视角的有用性进行预判。我们将这种有用性量化为“可回答性”，即VLM对某一视角是否足以回答该问题的估计，并提出无渲染前瞻（RFL）策略，该策略根据预测的未来可回答性对候选摄像头运动进行排序。RFL将视觉前瞻从部署阶段迁移至离线训练阶段。在训练时，特权教师模型在3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景中渲染候选未来视角，并使用冻结的VLM计算一步及两步可回答性目标。通过两阶段蒸馏，学生模型学会根据问题、近期视觉观测及候选摄像头运动预测这些动作值。在部署阶段，RFL利用这些预测值选择摄像头运动，而无需渲染未来视角。在未见环境中377个E3VS-Bench测试片段上，RFL相比使用相同VLM的直接动作基线，将平均裁判得分提升了43%。这些结果支持了从特权视觉前瞻中学习摄像头控制策略以应对依赖视角的问答任务。

Authors: Koya Sakamoto, Daichi Azuma, Shuhei Kurita, Naoya Chiba, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo, Taiki Miyanishi

Informationally Decoupled Trajectory Design for Sim-to-Real System Identification HumanoidEmbodied

system identification sim-to-real trajectory design Fisher information active exploration

简要说明：本文提出了IDTD，一种用于系统辨识的轨迹设计框架，利用Fisher信息矩阵的Schur补得分生成解耦参数影响的轨迹，提高了多种机器人的sim-to-real迁移效果，并在真实人形机器人上得到验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces IDTD, a trajectory design framework for system identification that uses a Schur complement score from the Fisher information matrix to generate trajectories that decouple parameter influences, improving sim-to-real transfer across various robots and validated on a real humanoid.

Abstract: Sampling-based system identification estimates physically meaningful parameters by tuning a simulator to reproduce the target system dynamics, providing an interpretable approach to improving sim-to-real transfer. Yet when the collected trajectories do not distinguish the effects of different parameters, multiple parameter combinations can reproduce those trajectories, leading to unreliable parameter estimates. To address this challenge, we introduce an Informationally Decoupled Trajectory Design framework (IDTD), which formulates the objective for the exploration policy built on the Schur complement score derived from the Fisher information matrix. To faithfully reflect parameter separability in the exploration objective, IDTD normalizes the score against the per-parameter information, selects the most favorable trajectory segment for each parameter, and aggregates the resulting scores logarithmically. The optimized trajectory is therefore composed of complementary intervals, each exposing a distinct subset of parameters whose contribution to the motion over that interval can be attributed unambiguously. Across diverse simulation environments, ranging from a linear-dynamics system to the Go2 quadruped, G1 humanoid, and Crazyflie quadrotor, IDTD reduces the parameter identification error by 39.6% on average relative to the strongest prior active-exploration baseline and attains improved downstream policy transfer. Furthermore, we validate the proposed trajectory design on a real K1 humanoid, demonstrating that the resulting identified parameters accurately capture the real-system dynamics.

摘要（中文）：基于采样的系统辨识通过调整仿真器以复现目标系统动力学，从而估计具有物理意义的参数，为提升仿真到现实迁移提供了一种可解释的方法。然而，当采集到的轨迹无法区分不同参数的影响时，多种参数组合均能复现这些轨迹，导致参数估计不可靠。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种信息解耦轨迹设计框架（IDTD），该框架基于费舍尔信息矩阵导出的舒尔补得分，构建探索策略的优化目标。为了在探索目标中真实反映参数的可分离性，IDTD将该得分按各参数信息进行归一化，为每个参数选取最有利的轨迹片段，并以对数方式聚合所得得分。因此，优化后的轨迹由互补的区间组成，每个区间暴露一组不同的参数，且这些参数在该区间内对运动的贡献可以被明确归因。在从线性动力学系统到Go2四足机器人、G1人形机器人和Crazyflie四旋翼等多种仿真环境中，IDTD相较此前最强的主动探索基线，平均参数辨识误差降低了39.6%，并实现了更优的下游策略迁移。此外，我们在真实的K1人形机器人上验证了所提出的轨迹设计方法，结果表明辨识所得参数能够准确捕捉真实系统的动力学特性。

Authors: Sangwoo Shin, Ashvin Anilkumar, Ryan Gao, Josiah P. Hanna

Self-Supervised Keyframe Discovery for Horizon-Invariant Behavior Cloning Manipulation

behavior cloning self-supervised keyframe discovery long-horizon robot manipulation memory

简要说明：本文提出了一种自监督的关键帧记忆方法，通过发现关键观测来条件化行为克隆策略，从而在非马尔可夫环境中实现有效的长时程控制。在合成记忆任务和真实机器人操作中均显著优于基线，即使延长视野仍保持高成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces Keyframe Mnemonics, a self-supervised method that discovers key observations (mnemonics) to condition behavior cloning policies, enabling effective long-horizon control in non-Markovian environments. It demonstrates significant improvements over baselines in synthetic memory tasks and real robot manipulation, achieving high success rates even at extended horizons.

Abstract: Behavior cloning (BC) in non-Markovian environments is a challenging problem because policies have to reason over contextual information over long horizons. Existing policy architectures rely on recurrent or attention-based mechanisms to capture long-term dependencies. However, recurrent models suffer from hidden-state collapse and gradient instability under backpropagation through time, while attention-based models are fundamentally limited by context length. To address these issues, we propose Keyframe Mnemonics, a novel self-supervised method that $\textit{discovers}$ a set of information-critical observations ($\textit{mnemonics}$) by learning an objective from randomly sampled past observations and using it as a reward for keyframe selection. We then train a BC policy that conditions on the discovered keyframes to model the action distribution. Under certain task-structure assumptions, our formulation provides context retention guarantees over an infinite horizon, while maintaining a small set of decision-relevant keyframes in the policy's working memory. We evaluate our method on synthetic memory domains, where mnemonic-conditioned BC policies achieve $100$% success rates (SR) and generalize to horizons orders of magnitude beyond training without performance degradation. Additionally, we evaluate on memory-intensive robot manipulation benchmark, achieving a $13.9$% average absolute SR improvement over the strongest baseline across $23$ tasks and retaining $80$% SR at $20\times$ longer horizons on a real robot. Code and videos are available at https://keyframe-mnemonics.github.io.

摘要（中文）：行为克隆（BC）在非马尔可夫环境中的策略学习是一项具有挑战性的问题，因为策略需要跨越长时域对上下文信息进行推理。现有的策略架构依赖循环机制或注意力机制来捕捉长期依赖关系。然而，循环模型在通过时间反向传播时存在隐状态坍缩和梯度不稳定的问题，而基于注意力的模型则在根本上受限于上下文长度。为解决这些问题，我们提出了关键帧助记符（Keyframe Mnemonics），一种新颖的自监督方法，通过从随机采样的历史观测中学习一个目标函数，并将其作为关键帧选择的奖励，从而$\textit{发现}$一组信息关键的观测（$\textit{助记符}$）。随后，我们训练一个以发现的关键帧为条件的BC策略来建模动作分布。在一定的任务结构假设下，我们的方法能够在无限时域上提供上下文保持的保证，同时在策略的工作记忆中仅保留少量与决策相关的关键帧。我们在合成记忆域上评估了该方法，基于助记符条件的BC策略实现了$100$%的成功率（SR），并且能够在超出训练时域数个数量级的更长时域上泛化而性能不下降。此外，我们在记忆密集型的机器人操作基准上进行了评估，在$23$个任务上平均绝对SR相比最强基线提升了$13.9$%，并在真实机器人上实现了$20$倍更长时域下保持$80$%的SR。代码和视频可在 https://keyframe-mnemonics.github.io 获取。

Authors: Prabin Kumar Rath, Omkar Patil, Nakul Gopalan

OmniHOI: Dexterous Hand-Object Interaction from Monocular Human Video Manipulation

monocular video hand-object interaction dexterous manipulation retargeting physics-in-the-loop

简要说明：OmniHOI 是一个从单目人体视频中重建灵巧手-物体交互轨迹并将其重定向到机器人手的流程，通过逐阶段物理一致性约束，在仿真和真实双臂机器人上实现了高成功率。

TLDR: OmniHOI is a pipeline that reconstructs dexterous hand-object interaction trajectories from monocular human videos and retargets them to robot hands using stage-wise physical consistency, achieving high success on simulated and real bimanual robots across diverse tasks.

Abstract: Monocular videos of human manipulation provide abundant dexterous demonstrations, yet reconstructing hand-object interaction from a single view and transferring it to robot hands remain difficult, limiting their direct use for robot execution. Prior methods either require task-specific RL training, limiting scalability, or assume clean motion-capture trajectories and thus cannot operate directly on video. We present OmniHOI, a pipeline that turns an RGB video of hand-object interaction into an interaction-faithful trajectory on dexterous hands. The key idea is to enforce physical consistency using the evidence available at each stage: image evidence during reconstruction, contact geometry during retargeting, and dynamics during physics-in-the-loop refinement. Each stage optimizes the corresponding representation directly, correcting errors before they propagate downstream or must be absorbed by a learned policy. Across 150 motion-capture trajectories transferred to each of five dexterous hands with 6 to 22 DoF, we achieve 39-89% success, compared with at most 31% for prior transfer methods. On 60 monocular video clips, we achieve 53% success, compared with 28% for the best prior video-to-robot pipeline. Its trajectories also execute on a real bimanual robot across diverse tasks.

摘要（中文）：摘要：单目视频中的人手操作提供了大量灵巧演示，然而从单一视角重建手-物交互并将其迁移至机器手仍具挑战，限制了其在机器人执行中的直接应用。现有方法要么需要针对特定任务的强化学习训练，限制了可扩展性，要么假设使用干净的动捕轨迹，因而无法直接处理视频。我们提出了OmniHOI，一种将手-物交互的RGB视频转化为灵巧手上交互保真轨迹的流程。关键思想是利用各阶段可获得的证据强制物理一致性：重建阶段利用图像证据，重定向阶段利用接触几何，物理在环优化阶段利用动力学。每个阶段直接优化对应表示，在错误传播至下游或被学习策略吸收之前加以纠正。在将150条动捕轨迹迁移至五只自由度从6到22不等的灵巧手的实验中，我们实现了39%-89%的成功率，而现有迁移方法最高仅为31%。在60个单目视频片段上，我们实现了53%的成功率，而现有最优视频到机器人流程仅为28%。其轨迹还能在真实双臂机器人上执行多种任务。

Authors: Ting Mao, Yanming Shao, Ziheng Wang, Haoyu Liu, Yiqun Wang, Xuanye Wu, Yao Mu

Diagnosing and Recovering from Observation-Space Shift at Long-Horizon Skill Seams Manipulation

Observation-Space Shift long-horizon manipulation skill chaining task-progress monitor scene restoration

简要说明：本文指出长时程操作技能衔接处的观测空间偏移主要由场景状态错位引起，并提出检测-恢复-继续系统，在BOSS-44基准及真实Franka机械臂上提升了完整链式任务成功率。

TLDR: This paper identifies Observation-Space Shift (OSS) at skill seams in long-horizon manipulation as primarily due to displaced scene state, and proposes a detect-restore-resume system that significantly improves full-chain success on the BOSS-44 benchmark and partially on a real Franka arm.

Abstract: Long-horizon robotic manipulation is often built by chaining independently trained skills. Although each skill can be reliable in isolation, performance degrades sharply when skills are chained: each downstream skill must start from the state its predecessor leaves behind rather than from its training distribution. We study this failure mode, Observation-Space Shift (OSS), and ask what causes these skill-seam failures. Using privileged simulator resets, we find that the dominant shift comes from displaced scene state (e.g., an open drawer or secondary objects left behind by earlier skills), not from the robot's joint configuration or the object the downstream skill manipulates. To test this diagnosis, we build a fully learned detect-restore-resume system: a task-progress monitor detects the stall, a learned policy restores the displaced scene components, and seam-robust fine-tuning lets the skill resume. It recovers the seam where every tested alternative fails, which we treat as evidence for the diagnosis rather than as a general-purpose method. On the BOSS-44 benchmark, the system improves full-chain success from 7.6% to 26.5%, a 3.5x improvement over the base policy and 51% of a privileged restoration oracle, whereas best-of-K resampling, a Diffusion Policy, and world-model baselines fail to recover from the evaluated seam states. On a real Franka arm running a fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ policy, the same monitor is limited by exterior-camera observability, yet closing the loop still recovers some otherwise-terminal failures, motivating wrist and gripper sensing. These results suggest that some long-horizon composition failures are better addressed by restoring the scene before resuming the policy than by retrying from an off-support state.

摘要（中文）：长期 horizon 的机器人操作通常通过串联独立训练的技能来实现。尽管每个技能在单独执行时可能可靠，但当技能被串联起来时，性能会急剧下降：每个下游技能必须从上游技能遗留的状态开始，而非其训练分布状态。我们研究了这一失败模式，即观测空间偏移（OSS），并探讨了导致这些技能衔接处失败的原因。利用特权模拟器重置，我们发现主要的偏移来源于场景状态的变动（例如，抽屉被打开或早期技能留下的次要物体），而非机器人的关节配置或下游技能所操作的物体。为验证这一诊断，我们构建了一个完全学习的“检测-恢复-继续”系统：任务进度监视器检测停滞，学习策略恢复变动的场景组件，衔接鲁棒微调使技能得以继续执行。该系统在所有测试的替代方案均失败的衔接处实现了恢复，我们将此视为对诊断的支持而非通用方法。在BOSS-44基准测试中，该系统将完整链路成功率从7.6%提升至26.5%，相对于基础策略提升了3.5倍，并达到了特权恢复预言机效果的51%，而K次重采样最佳法、扩散策略和世界模型基线均未能从评估的衔接状态中恢复。在运行微调后的$π_{0.5}$策略的真实Franka机械臂上，同样的监视器受限于外部相机可观测性，但闭环控制仍能恢复一些原本会终止的失败，这表明腕部及夹爪传感的必要性。这些结果表明，某些长 horizon 组合失败更适合通过恢复场景后再继续策略来解决，而非从失稳状态重新尝试。

Authors: Pranav Wagh, Yu Fang, Yue Yang, Mingyu Ding

TAPNAV: Humanoid Navigation through Tactile Active Perception HumanoidEmbodied

tactile active perception humanoid navigation uncertainty-aware planning information-gain whole-body control

简要说明：TAPNAV提出一种触觉主动感知框架，用于在无视觉环境中的人形导航，通过不确定性感知的全局规划和信息增益驱动的局部探测维持定位，实现无需视觉的可靠导航。

TLDR: TAPNAV presents a tactile active-perception framework for humanoid navigation in vision-denied environments, using uncertainty-aware global planning and information-gain-driven local probing to maintain localization and achieve reliable goal-reaching without vision.

Abstract: Navigation in vision-denied environments is challenging for humanoid robots because proprioceptive odometry drifts and localization uncertainty accumulates rapidly. We present TAPNAV, a tactile active-perception framework that enables humanoid navigation toward a goal by actively probing surrounding structures without relying on vision. TAPNAV maintains a pose belief from odometry, IMU, and tactile contact observations, and couples uncertainty-aware global route planning with information-gain-driven local probing. The global planner searches for routes that keep predicted localization uncertainty bounded by exploiting opportunities for tactile correction, while the local planner selects probe actions that maximize expected information gain. A whole-body controller coordinates the humanoid's locomotion and end-effector contact to execute the planned navigation and probe motions. We evaluate TAPNAV in simulation and on a Unitree G1 across different floor plans and obstacle geometries. TAPNAV achieves lower state estimation error and a higher task completion rate than baselines. These results demonstrate that actively planning physical interactions with the environment can provide localization cues for reliable humanoid navigation without vision.

摘要（中文）：在视觉受限环境中，仿人机器人的导航具有挑战性，因为本体感觉里程计漂移和定位不确定性会迅速累积。我们提出了TAPNAV，一种触觉主动感知框架，通过主动探测周围结构，使仿人机器人无需依赖视觉即可实现向目标导航。TAPNAV利用里程计、惯性测量单元和触觉接触观测来维持位姿置信度，并将考虑不确定性的全局路径规划与信息增益驱动的局部探测相结合。全局规划器搜索能够通过利用触觉校正机会将预测定位不确定性保持在有界范围内的路径，而局部规划器则选择能够最大化期望信息增益的探测动作。一个全身控制器协调仿人机器人的运动与末端执行器接触，以执行规划的导航和探测动作。我们在仿真环境和Unitree G1机器人上，针对不同的平面布局和障碍物几何形状对TAPNAV进行了评估。与基线方法相比，TAPNAV实现了更低的状态估计误差和更高的任务完成率。这些结果表明，主动规划与环境之间的物理交互能够为无视觉条件下可靠的仿人机器人导航提供定位线索。
