Authors: Huaze Liu, Zhenyu Wu, Jaehwi Jang, Junjie Sheng, Andrew Collins, Aaron Xie, Zhaoyuan Gu, Kaijie Zhu, Ding Jiang, Kevin Cai, Ye Zhao

Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction WorldModel

multi-agent ego-centric world model fine-grained embodied interaction shared-environment consistency action-conditioned generation

简要说明：本文提出ME-World，一种多智能体自我中心世界模型，通过共享环境记忆和跨视角一致性约束，联合生成多个智能体的同步第一人称视频流，在真实和合成数据上提高了环境一致性和动作控制能力。

TLDR: This paper introduces ME-World, a multi-agent egocentric world model that jointly generates synchronized first-person video streams for multiple agents interacting via fine-grained actions, using shared environment memory and cross-view consistency constraints, and demonstrates improved consistency and control on real and synthetic data.

Abstract: Egocentric world models predict first-person observations conditioned on an agent's actions, but most focus on a single agent. Real embodied settings often involve multiple agents that act and interact within a shared environment. Existing multi-agent world models rely on coarse actions like locomotion, camera control, or discrete commands, leaving fine-grained embodied interactions underexplored. We formulate multi-agent egocentric world modeling as synchronized ego-stream generation for multiple agents interacting through fine-grained actions in a shared world. This requires cross-view action consistency, shared-environment consistency, and consistent propagation of interaction-induced state updates. We propose Multi-agent Egocentric World Model (ME-World), which jointly denoises multiple ego streams in a shared token sequence, conditions each stream on all agents' target-view poses, and grounds generation with shared environment memory. We train and evaluate on real and synthetic multi-agent data and introduce shared-world consistency metrics for environment, update, and identity consistency. Experiments show ME-World improves shared-world consistency, action control, identity preservation, and video quality over existing methods.

摘要（中文）：以自我为中心的世界模型根据智能体的动作来预测第一人称观察，但大多数模型仅关注单一智能体。现实中的具身环境往往涉及多个在共享环境中行动和交互的智能体。现有的多智能体世界模型依赖于粗略动作（如移动、相机控制或离散指令），而精细的具身交互仍未得到充分探索。我们将多智能体自我中心世界建模定义为：多个智能体在共享世界中通过精细动作进行交互时，同步生成各自的第一人称观察流。这要求跨视角动作一致性、共享环境一致性，以及由交互引发的状态更新的持续传播。为此，我们提出了多智能体自我中心世界模型（ME-World），该模型在共享令牌序列中对多个自我中心观察流进行联合去噪，将每条观察流以所有智能体的目标视角位姿为条件，并借助共享环境记忆来支撑生成过程。我们在真实和合成的多智能体数据上进行了训练与评估，并引入了面向共享世界一致性的度量指标，涵盖环境一致性、更新一致性和身份一致性。实验结果表明，ME-World 在共享世界一致性、动作控制、身份保持和视频质量方面均优于现有方法。

Authors: Dahyun Chung, Siyoon Jin, Hyunwook Choi, Honggyu An, Junyoung Seo, Hyunsung Kim, Seung Wook Kim, Seungryong Kim

Recompose and Refine Latent Reasoning Flows for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

latent reasoning memory vision-language-action models closed-loop control robotic manipulation

简要说明：FLOWMEM 是一种VLA模型，通过检索并重组过去成功计算中的潜在推理片段来条件化动作生成，在RoboMME和LIBERO-Plus基准上提升了闭环控制成功率。

TLDR: FLOWMEM is a VLA model that retrieves and recomposes latent reasoning fragments from past successful computations to condition action generation, improving closed-loop control success on RoboMME and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks.

Abstract: Latent reasoning enables vision-language-action (VLA) models to transform multimodal observations into task-relevant internal states before generating continuous robot actions. While existing methods learn to generate or refine such states for each policy query, they discard successful reasoning after execution and therefore reconstruct similar computation from scratch. We present Reasoning and Flow Memory (FLOWMEM), a unified VLA model that turns successful latent computation into reusable reasoning experience. Rather than appending a fixed retrieved context, FLOWMEM dynamically retrieves and recomposes compatible latent fragments as the embodied context evolves, forming a reasoning route that follows the temporal structure and progress of successful computation. The route is then refined using current visual and proprioceptive evidence before it conditions action generation. Experiments on RoboMME and LIBERO-Plus show that FLOWMEM attains 48.0% and 77.3% success, outperforming memory-free policies by 1.7 and 4.1 percentage points, respectively. These results demonstrate the value of reusing successful latent computation for closed-loop VLA control.

摘要（中文）：潜在推理使视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够在生成连续机器人动作之前，将多模态观测转化为与任务相关的内部状态。尽管现有方法针对每次策略查询学习生成或优化此类状态，但它们在执行后会丢弃成功的推理结果，因此需要从头重新构建相似的计算。我们提出了推理与流记忆（FLOWMEM），这是一个统一的VLA模型，将成功的潜在计算转化为可复用的推理经验。FLOWMEM并非附加固定的检索上下文，而是在具身上下文演化过程中动态检索并重组兼容的潜在片段，形成一条遵循成功计算时间结构与进度的推理路径。该路径在影响动作生成之前，会利用当前的视觉和本体感觉证据进行细化。在RoboMME和LIBERO-Plus上的实验表明，FLOWMEM分别取得了48.0%和77.3%的成功率，相比无记忆策略分别提升了1.7和4.1个百分点。这些结果验证了在闭环VLA控制中复用成功潜在计算的价值。

Authors: Hongyu Shi, Sen Zhao, Zuyu Zhang, Lifeng Shen, Ding Zou, Xinyu He, Xu Zhang, Qinghua Zhang

Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks WorldModel

recursive self-improvement world models external memory rulebook compilation LLM agents

简要说明：Memento 3 提出了一种基于模型的递归自我改进框架，通过外部记忆让冻结的 LLM 智能体维护和修正显式自然语言世界模型，在 ARC-AGI-3 上达到完美表现，并在无需进一步 LLM 调用的 Atari Pong 中获胜。

TLDR: Memento 3 introduces a model-based recursive self-improvement framework where frozen LLM agents maintain and refine explicit natural-language world models via external memory, achieving perfect performance on ARC-AGI-3 and winning Atari Pong games without further LLM calls.

Abstract: Learning to act in unfamiliar environments requires agents to infer how the world works and revise that understanding as new evidence arrives. Yet limited observations can support multiple world models that explain past interactions but predict different outcomes in unseen states. We introduce Memento 3, building on the Memento series to enable frozen LLM agents to continually learn explicit world models through external memory. The agent maintains a natural-language rulebook as persistent semantic memory, recording revisable hypotheses about environment dynamics while leaving unknown aspects underspecified. It compiles this rulebook into executable code for prediction and planning. Through a continual loop of observation, reflection, rule revision, compilation, and verification, the agent uses prediction errors to refine both the rulebook and its code. Updated code is accepted only when the LLM judges it faithful to the rulebook and cell-exact replay reproduces the observed transitions. We investigate this process as a model-based route to recursive self-improvement (RSI): the agent autonomously explores the environment, revises its world model, and uses verified updates to guide subsequent interaction and learning, while the underlying LLM remains fixed. A population extension maintains multiple world models in parallel, sharing interaction evidence and using their predictions to guide exploration. On ARC-AGI-3, the single-model agent clears every level of all 25 public games, achieves a mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) of 100.0, and uses 44% of the human action count. In an Atari Pong case study, a learned feedback controller wins 21:0 in each of three evaluated episodes with different openings, without further LLM calls.

摘要（中文）：学习在陌生环境中采取行动，要求智能体推断世界的运作方式，并在新证据出现时修正这一理解。然而，有限的观察可能支持多种世界模型，这些模型虽能解释过去的交互，却在对未见状态的预测上产生不同结果。我们引入Memento 3，在Memento系列的基础上，使冻结的大语言模型智能体能够通过外部记忆持续学习显式的世界模型。该智能体维护一本自然语言规则手册作为持久语义记忆，记录关于环境动态的可修正假设，同时对未知方面保持未明确状态。它将该规则手册编译为可执行代码，用于预测和规划。通过观察、反思、规则修正、编译和验证的持续循环，智能体利用预测误差来改进规则手册及其代码。仅当大语言模型判定更新后的代码忠实于规则手册，且单元精确回放能够复现所观察到的状态转换时，更新后的代码才被接受。我们将这一过程视为一种基于模型的自递归自我改进（RSI）路径：智能体自主探索环境、修正其世界模型，并利用经验证的更新来指导后续交互与学习，而底层大语言模型始终保持固定。种群扩展并行维护多个世界模型，共享交互证据，并利用其预测来引导探索。在ARC-AGI-3上，单模型智能体清除了全部25个公开游戏的每一关，平均相对人类行动效率（RHAE）达到100.0，且仅使用了人类行动次数的44%。在Atari Pong案例研究中，一个学习到的反馈控制器在三个不同开局的评估回合中均以21:0获胜，且无需进一步调用大语言模型。

Authors: Haoyu Zhao, Zhengxu Yu, Zhiyuan He, Meng Fang, Rasul Tutunov, Haitham Bou-Ammar, Weilin Luo, Jun Wang

MultiWorldBench: Do Independently Controlled Views Describe One Shared World? WorldModel

multiplayer world models Minecraft benchmark multi-agent consistency world coherence independent control

简要说明：本文提出了MultiWorldBench，这是一个用于评估多智能体世界模型中独立控制视角是否与共享世界保持一致的Minecraft基准，并发现现有模型无法保持连贯性。它提供了跨七个任务套件和十种能力的自动评估，并与人类偏好高度一致。

TLDR: This paper introduces MultiWorldBench, a Minecraft benchmark for evaluating whether independently controlled views in multi-agent world models remain consistent with a shared world, finding that current models fail to maintain coherence. It provides an automatic and human-aligned evaluation across seven task suites and ten capabilities.

Abstract: Multiplayer world models must ensure that independently controlled views remain consistent with one shared and persistent world. We introduce MultiWorldBench, a diagnostic Minecraft benchmark containing 495 case configurations across seven task suites and ten capabilities, including independent control, cross-view motion, shared-state synchronization, persistence, structural reasoning, concurrent interaction, and delayed revisit. We evaluate Solaris, Gamma-World, and MineWorld, using Engine GT as a reference. Gamma-World achieves the highest ten-capability average among the generated systems at 21.39, followed by Solaris at 20.88 and MineWorld at 1.89, while Engine GT reaches 91.69. Gamma-World performs better on several control, shared-state, and revisit capabilities, whereas Solaris leads in cross-view motion and race-condition consistency. Nevertheless, all generated systems score at most 8.00 on state persistence and 1.33 on structural consistency, and none succeeds in spatial reasoning or building-identity preservation. Human preferences produce the same overall ranking and show strong alignment with the automatic evaluation, with a mean dimension-level Spearman correlation of 0.96. These results show that plausible individual views do not yet constitute a coherent multiplayer world.

摘要（中文）：多人世界模型必须确保独立控制的视角与一个共享且持久的世界保持一致。我们提出了MultiWorldBench，一个诊断性的Minecraft基准测试，包含七个任务套件和十种能力下的495个案例配置，涵盖独立控制、跨视角运动、共享状态同步、持久性、结构推理、并发交互和延迟重访。我们使用Engine GT作为参考，评估了Solaris、Gamma-World和MineWorld。在生成系统中，Gamma-World的十能力平均值最高，达到21.39，其次是Solaris（20.88）和MineWorld（1.89），而Engine GT达到91.69。Gamma-World在多项控制、共享状态和重访能力上表现更优，而Solaris在跨视角运动和竞态条件一致性方面领先。尽管如此，所有生成系统在状态持久性上的得分最高仅为8.00，在结构一致性上的得分最高仅为1.33，且没有一个系统在空间推理或建筑身份保持方面取得成功。人类偏好产生了相同的总体排名，并与自动评估结果高度一致，平均维度级Spearman相关系数为0.96。这些结果表明，看似合理的个体视角尚不足以构成一个连贯的多人在线世界。

Authors: Zhangbo Xu, Ruoxi Zhang, Rui Hu, Yisong Wang

The Operator Mismatch Problem: Deploying BEV Perception with Portable GPU Compute AutonomousDriving

BEV perception operator mismatch GPU compute deployment sparse convolutions

简要说明：BEVPIPE 是一个框架，通过将 BEV 感知模型划分为运行时管理的密集子图和外部算子扩展，实现在便携式 GPU 上的部署，获得 19.5 倍加速并支持跨后端移植。

TLDR: BEVPIPE is a framework that enables deploying BEV perception models on portable GPU compute by partitioning into runtime-managed dense subgraphs and external operator extensions, achieving 19.5x speedup and cross-backend portability.

Abstract: Modern autonomous driving systems rely on bird's-eye-view (BEV) perception models that fuse camera and LiDAR inputs to detect objects in 3D space. These models are accurate, but they cannot be deployed through standard inference runtimes. The reason is an operator mismatch between dense convolutions (which runtimes handle well), sparse 3D convolutions (which runtimes cannot represent), and geometric scatter operations (which runtimes have no vocabulary for). Today, every sparse convolution library is CUDA-only and PyTorch-coupled, locking BEV deployment to a single vendor's hardware and a single execution framework. We present BEVPIPE, a framework for deploying multimodal BEV perception pipelines using portable GPU compute APIs and integrating them with production inference runtimes. BEVPIPE partitions the model into runtime-managed dense subgraphs and three external operator extensions (voxelizer, sparse encoder, BEV projector), connected through a shared GPU memory space. BEVPIPE achieves a 19.5x end-to-end speedup over conventional deployments while retaining 98.5% of reference mAP. We also showcase that BEVPIPE is portable across different GPU backends.

摘要（中文）：现代自动驾驶系统依赖于鸟瞰视角（BEV）感知模型，该模型融合摄像头与激光雷达输入以在三维空间中检测物体。这些模型精度较高，但无法通过标准推理运行时进行部署，原因在于密集卷积（运行时能够良好处理）、稀疏三维卷积（运行时无法表示）以及几何散射操作（运行时缺乏相应表达）之间存在算子不匹配。目前，所有稀疏卷积库均仅支持CUDA且与PyTorch紧密耦合，这使BEV部署受限于单一厂商的硬件和单一执行框架。 我们提出了BEVPIPE，这是一种利用可移植GPU计算API部署多模态BEV感知流水线，并将其集成到生产级推理运行时中的框架。BEVPIPE将模型划分为由运行时管理的密集子图，以及三个外部算子扩展（体素化器、稀疏编码器、BEV投影器），这些部分通过共享GPU内存空间相互连接。相比传统部署方式，BEVPIPE实现了19.5倍的端到端加速，同时保持了参考平均精度（mAP）的98.5%。我们还展示了BEVPIPE在不同GPU后端之间的可移植性。

Authors: Rohit Verma, Anand V Bodas

A Balanced Data Diet: Addressing the Exploration Bottleneck in Mega-Scale RL for Robot Control RLRobot

sim-to-real RL adaptive sampling massively parallel simulation quadruped locomotion contact-rich assembly

简要说明：本文提出成功引导采样（SGS），一种自适应采样器，将RL训练集中在策略能力边界附近的任务配置上，使大规模并行sim-to-real RL能够解决具有挑战性的运动和装配任务，并迁移到真实硬件。

TLDR: This paper proposes Success Guided Sampling (SGS), an adaptive sampler that focuses RL training on task configurations near the policy's capability frontier, enabling massively parallel sim-to-real RL to solve challenging locomotion and assembly tasks and transfer to real hardware.

Abstract: General-purpose robots must perform a wide range of tasks from agile locomotion to dexterous manipulation. While sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) has proven to be a useful tool for this goal, current RL pipelines depend on engineering-heavy, per-task structural priors such as shaped rewards and demonstrations. Recent work has shown that diverse simulator resets, combined with massively parallel simulation, can alleviate much of this engineering burden on several manipulation problems. However, we find that naively scaling this paradigm to more precise or dynamic problems remains non-trivial. While simulator resets can help with exploration, uniformly sampling over this distribution wastes a growing fraction of learning experience on task configurations the policy has already mastered or cannot yet attempt. This makes it challenging to see the expected benefits of scaling parallel environments for RL, since much of the learning signal in a batch is wasted during learning. To mitigate this, we introduce Success Guided Sampling (SGS), a simple adaptive sampler that concentrates RL training on task configurations around the frontier of the policy's capabilities. Doing so allows large-scale simulated RL to make the most out of the experience in a batch, enabling much more effective scaling to large-scale parallel simulation. Across experiments using up to $2^{20}$ (over one million) parallel environments, SGS enables RL to solve challenging multi-terrain quadruped locomotion and contact-rich assembly tasks that prior methods fail to solve. Finally, we distill the learned manipulation policies into RGB-based policies and demonstrate zero-shot transfer to several challenging assembly tasks on real hardware. Project website: https://sgs-rl.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：通用型机器人必须能够执行从灵活运动到灵巧操作的各种任务。尽管仿真到现实的强化学习（RL）已被证明是实现这一目标的有效工具，但当前的强化学习流程依赖于工程繁重且针对特定任务的结构性先验，如塑形奖励和示范。近期研究表明，多样化的仿真器重置结合大规模并行仿真，可以在若干操作问题上显著减轻这种工程负担。然而，我们发现将这一范式直接扩展到更精密或更动态的任务仍然具有挑战性。尽管仿真器重置有助于探索，但对这一分布进行均匀采样会将越来越多的学习经验浪费在策略已经掌握或尚无法尝试的任务配置上。这使得在扩大并行环境规模时难以观察到强化学习应有的收益，因为批次中的大量学习信号在学习过程中被浪费了。为解决这一问题，我们引入了成功引导采样（SGS），一种简单的自适应采样方法，将强化学习训练集中在策略能力边界附近的任务配置上。这样做使得大规模仿真强化学习能够充分利用批次中的经验，从而显著提升其向大规模并行仿真的有效扩展能力。在使用多达$2^{20}$（超过一百万）个并行环境的实验中，SGS使强化学习能够解决此前方法无法解决的具有挑战性的多地形四足运动任务和接触密集型装配任务。最后，我们将学习到的操作策略蒸馏为基于RGB图像的策略，并在真实硬件上展示了多个具有挑战性装配任务的零样本迁移。项目网站：https://sgs-rl.github.io/。

Authors: Octi Zhang, Mateo Guaman Castro, Patrick Yin, Ignacio Dagnino, Abhishek Gupta, Rosario Scalise, Byron Boots

Control-Ready Uncertainty for Trajectory Diffusion Manipulation

trajectory diffusion uncertainty estimation robot control Gaussian tubes closed-loop performance

简要说明：本文介绍了SCOPE，一种轻量级模块，通过将评分曲率信息提取为校准的高斯管，为轨迹扩散模型提供控制就绪的不确定性估计，从而实现快速风险评估并提高机器人控制和预测任务中的闭环性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces SCOPE, a lightweight module that provides control-ready uncertainty estimates for trajectory diffusion models by distilling score-curvature information into calibrated Gaussian tubes, enabling fast risk assessment and improved closed-loop performance in robot control and forecasting tasks.

Abstract: Diffusion models can represent complex, multimodal trajectory distributions, but extracting uncertainty from them typically requires costly Monte Carlo sampling. This limits their use in real-time control, where robots must rapidly assess risk and maintain safety margins. We introduce Score-Curvature for Online Precision Estimation (SCOPE), a lightweight module that augments diffusion trajectory models with control-ready uncertainty. SCOPE learns a structured precision matrix around each nominal trajectory by distilling score-curvature information and producing calibrated Gaussian tubes with low overhead and without repeated Monte Carlo sampling. These tubes provide per-timestep covariance estimates that can be used both as predicted occupancy for moving agents and as adaptive exploration guides for robot control. We evaluate SCOPE with mode-conditioned multimodal diffusion backbones in pedestrian forecasting, crowd navigation, Maze2D control, and real-world Franka Panda manipulation. Across these settings, SCOPE provides fast uncertainty estimation, which leads to better closed-loop performance. Project page: https://zackaxue.github.io/SCOPE-project-page/

摘要（中文）：扩散模型能够表示复杂且多模态的轨迹分布，但从中提取不确定性通常需要昂贵的蒙特卡洛采样，这限制了它们在实时控制中的应用——在实时控制中，机器人必须快速评估风险并维持安全裕度。我们提出了基于分数曲率的在线精度估计方法（SCOPE），这是一种轻量级模块，可为扩散轨迹模型补充可直接用于控制的不确定性信息。SCOPE通过蒸馏分数曲率信息，围绕每个名义轨迹学习结构化精度矩阵，从而以低开销生成校准的高斯管，无需重复进行蒙特卡洛采样。这些高斯管提供每个时间步的协方差估计，既可用作移动代理的预测占用，也可用作机器人控制的自适应探索指引。我们在行人预测、人群导航、Maze2D控制以及真实Franka Panda操作任务中，结合模式条件下的多模态扩散主干网络对SCOPE进行了评估。在这些场景下，SCOPE提供了快速的不确定性估计，从而带来了更优的闭环性能。项目主页：https://zackaxue.github.io/SCOPE-project-page/

Authors: Zhiwei Xue, Jia Yue Kam, Jinhang Qiu, Yifeng Cheng, Ege Gursoy, Jiaming Wang, Vincent Bonnet, Harold Soh

A Physics-Informed Collision Learning Framework for Collaborative Robot Motion Generation Manipulation

differentiable collision distance physics-informed model predictive control dual-arm manipulation collision avoidance

简要说明：本文提出PI-UDF，一种物理信息统一的关节机器人间碰撞距离可微预测框架，集成到非线性MPC中实现实时避碰协作运动生成，并在双Franka平台上验证。

TLDR: This paper presents PI-UDF, a physics-informed unified differentiable framework for predicting collision distances between articulated robots, integrated into nonlinear MPC for real-time collision-aware collaborative robot motion generation, validated on a dual-Franka platform.

Abstract: Close-proximity multi-arm manipulation requires collision models that are both geometrically accurate and differentiable enough for real-time optimization. Classical geometry checkers provide reliable distances but are difficult to use inside gradient-based model predictive control, while conservative proxy models can restrict tightly coupled motion. We present PI-UDF, a physics-informed unified differentiable framework for body-to-body collision distance prediction between articulated robots. PI-UDF combines analytical forward kinematics with learnable link-geometry embeddings and a shared residual network to predict pairwise inter-arm distances directly from robot configurations. To improve safety-critical fidelity, we combine quota-driven boundary mining with an asymmetric boundary-crossing penalty that emphasizes false-safe sign errors near the collision boundary. The learned distance field is integrated into nonlinear MPC as a differentiable inter-arm clearance term. We validate the framework on a real dual-Franka platform through high-speed close-proximity 14-DoF dual-arm swapping, sustained single-arm dynamic evasion, and dynamic-evasion planning configurations with frozen, predicted, and target-switching treatments of the moving arm. Hardware experiments and offline Drake/FCL replay show that PI-UDF provides a differentiable inter-arm clearance estimate suitable for closed-loop collision-aware collaborative robot motion generation.

摘要（中文）：近距离多臂操控要求碰撞模型既具备几何精度，又足够可微以支持实时优化。经典几何检测器能够提供可靠的距离信息，但难以在基于梯度的模型预测控制中使用，而保守的代理模型则会限制紧耦合运动。我们提出PI-UDF，一种面向关节型机器人身体间碰撞距离预测的物理信息统一可微框架。PI-UDF将解析正运动学与可学习的连杆几何嵌入及共享残差网络相结合，直接从机器人构型预测各臂之间的成对距离。为提高安全关键的保真度，我们结合配额驱动的边界挖掘与非对称边界穿越惩罚，该惩罚着重强调碰撞边界附近的假安全符号错误。学习得到的距离场作为可微的臂间净空项集成到非线性MPC中。我们在真实双Franka平台上通过高速近距离14自由度双臂交换任务、持续单臂动态规避，以及针对运动臂采用冻结、预测和目标切换处理的动态规避规划配置，对该框架进行了验证。硬件实验和离线Drake/FCL回放表明，PI-UDF提供的可微臂间净空估计适用于闭环碰撞感知的协作机器人运动生成。

Authors: Chen Cai, Steven Liu

Toward Lunar Legged Robots: Field Deployment Lessons at LUNA Locomotion

legged robots lunar exploration regolith simulant field deployment perception robustness

简要说明：本文报告了2025年LUNA模拟场地部署的经验教训，ANYmal-D和Magnecko四足机器人在模拟月壤中通行，揭示了地形交互、扬尘和光照感知挑战，为未来月面足式机器人研究提供了方向。

TLDR: This paper reports field deployment lessons from the 2025 LUNA analogue campaign, where ANYmal-D and Magnecko quadrupeds traversed lunar regolith simulant, revealing challenges in terrain interaction, dust, and perception under difficult lighting, and motivating future regolith-aware locomotion and robust perception.

Abstract: Legged robots are promising candidates for future lunar surface missions because they can traverse steep, loose, and obstacle-rich terrain that challenges conventional wheeled rovers. However, readiness for lunar deployment is limited by uncertainties in foot-regolith interaction, dust generation, illumination-driven perception degradation, and operational constraints. This paper reports lessons from the 2025 LUNA analogue campaign, where ANYmal-D and Magnecko traversed loose regolith simulant and crater-like terrain and collected long-horizon navigation and visual-inertial data under challenging lighting. We show that quadrupedal robots can traverse regolith simulant, but performance is affected by sinkage and slip, dust-generating contacts, and perception failures caused by overexposure, shadows, and low-texture regions. These results motivate tighter integration of regolith-aware locomotion policies, illumination-robust perception, repeatable analogue testing, and mission-level operational validation for future lunar legged robots.

摘要（中文）：腿式机器人有望成为未来月球表面任务的重要候选方案，因为它们能够穿越陡坡、松软土壤及障碍密集的地形，而这些区域对传统轮式巡视器构成挑战。然而，脚部与月壤相互作用的不可确定性、尘埃产生、光照引起的感知退化以及操作限制等因素，制约了其在月球部署的成熟度。本文报告了2025年LUNA模拟活动的经验教训，在该活动中，ANYmal-D与Magnecko在松软月壤模拟物及类陨石坑地形上行走，并在具有挑战性的光照条件下采集了长周期导航及视觉-惯性数据。研究表明，四足机器人能够穿越月壤模拟物，但其性能受到下陷与滑移、产生尘埃的接触，以及由过度曝光、阴影和低纹理区域导致的感知失效的影响。这些结果促使未来月球腿式机器人需要更紧密地集成月壤感知运动策略、抗光照鲁棒感知、可重复的模拟测试以及任务级操作验证。

Authors: Adrian Fuhrer, Joseph Church, Oliver Fischer, William Talbot, Nicolas Faesch, Yannic Hofmann, Hendrik Kolvenbach, Yusuke Tanaka, Marco Hutter

Walking on Roofs: Exploring the Potential of Walking Robots for Construction Work on Roofs Locomotion

quadruped locomotion roof environments Unitree Go2 slippage reinforcement learning

简要说明：本文评估了商用四足机器人 Unitree Go2 在屋顶施工任务中的表现，发现标准球形脚在斜坡上失效，并为未来研究提供了基线。

TLDR: This paper evaluates a commercial quadruped robot, the Unitree Go2, for roof construction tasks, finding that standard ball feet fail on sloped surfaces and providing a baseline for future research.

Abstract: This paper investigates the feasibility of deploying quadruped walking robots for the automation of work in roof environments. While quadrupeds have demonstrated versatility across various domains, their large-scale deployment remains limited, partly due to lack of application-specific designs. Roof environments represent a novel and unexplored use case, combining high safety risks for human workers with repetitive, strenuous tasks that could benefit from robotic assistance. A dedicated test rig of a roof's surface was designed to evaluate the baseline performance of a commercial quadruped, the \emph{Unitree Go2}, in this new environment. Experiments revealed that standard ball feet are inherently inadequate for locomotion on sloped roofs: slippage increased quadratically with incline angle, get-up and lie-down sequences were only possible on small inclines, and critical failures already occurred regularly on moderate inclines of 25°. This work provides the first systematic assessment of quadruped locomotion in roof environments, highlighting both the potential and the current limitations of this application and establishes a baseline for future research. Effective solutions will require a combination of task-oriented foot designs, advanced contact mechanics and environment-specific control strategies, such as reinforcement learning for roof-adapted gaits.

摘要（中文）：本文探讨了在屋顶环境中部署四足行走机器人以实现工作自动化的可行性。尽管四足机器人在多个领域展现了多样化的应用能力，但其大规模部署仍受到限制，部分原因在于缺乏针对特定应用场景的设计。屋顶环境代表了一个新颖且尚未被探索的应用场景，该环境既给人类工人带来了较高的安全风险，又包含了重复且繁重的劳动，这些工作有望从机器人辅助中获益。为此，设计了一套专用的屋顶表面测试平台，以评估商业四足机器人——Unitree Go2——在该新环境中的基准性能。实验结果表明，标准的球形足本质上无法适应坡面屋顶上的移动：打滑程度随倾斜角度呈二次方增加，起立和卧倒动作仅在较小坡度下可行，而在25°的中等坡度下，严重故障已频繁发生。本研究首次对屋顶环境中的四足移动进行了系统性评估，既揭示了该应用场景的潜力，也指出了当前存在的局限性，并为未来研究建立了基准。有效的解决方案需要结合面向任务的足部设计、先进的接触力学以及针对特定环境的控制策略，例如用于适配屋顶步态的强化学习方法。

Authors: Bjoern-Felix Dettmar, Arne Roennau

Residual Modeling Closes the Regression and Generative Policy Gap in Robot Learning Manipulation

residual modeling heteroscedastic Student-t regression flow-matching policies robot learning from demonstration efficient action regression

简要说明：本文重新审视了机器人学习中回归策略与生成策略的性能差距，提出异方差Student-t动作回归（HT-Policies），在训练和推理更快的情况下达到与生成策略相当的成功率。

TLDR: This paper re-examines the performance gap between regression and generative policies in robot learning, proposing heteroscedastic Student-t action regression (HT-Policies) that matches generative policy success rates with faster training and inference.

Abstract: Learning from demonstration has enabled impressive robot behaviors. A common choice for policy learning is to use diffusion or flow matching (Flow-Policies), which often outperforms direct action regression trained with mean squared error (MSE-Policies). This gap is commonly attributed to multimodal demonstrations. We revisit this gap from the perspective of statistical modeling: how action-prediction residuals shape policy optimization. Our analysis of real-world robot demonstration data reveals substantial state-dependent variation in residual scales and heavier-than-Gaussian tails. While both MSE-Policies and Flow-Policies exhibit heavy-tailed action residuals, their training gradients behave differently: MSE allocates more gradient magnitude to observations with large action residuals, which hurts optimization. Motivated by these findings, we introduce heteroscedastic Student-t action regression (HT-Policies), which learns input-dependent residual scales and reduces the influence of heavy tails. HT-Policies predict action chunks with a single feed-forward pass and can reuse pretrained flow-matching-based policy networks as the backbone. Across four simulation benchmarks and real-robot evaluations, HT-Policies achieves success rates competitive with generative policy baselines, both when trained from scratch and from pretrained vision-language-action and world-action models, despite being faster in training and inference. Together, these findings shed light on the practical advantages of generative objectives in robot learning from demonstrations and offer an efficient direct-regression alternative for a range of architectures and tasks. Project page: https://the-labone.github.io/regression-policy-project/

摘要（中文）：从示范中学习已使机器人展现出令人印象深刻的行为能力。在策略学习中，一种常见选择是使用扩散模型或流匹配（Flow-Policies），其性能通常优于使用均方误差（MSE）训练的直接动作回归方法（MSE-Policies）。这一差距通常被归因于多模态示范数据。我们从统计建模的角度重新审视这一差距：即动作预测残差如何影响策略优化。对真实机器人示范数据的分析揭示了残差尺度存在显著的状态依赖变化，并且其分布具有比高斯分布更重的尾部特征。尽管MSE-Policies和Flow-Policies都表现出重尾的动作残差，但它们的训练梯度行为有所不同：MSE将更大的梯度幅度分配给具有较大动作残差的观测样本，这不利于优化。基于这些发现，我们提出了异方差学生t分布动作回归（HT-Policies），该方法学习与输入相关的残差尺度，并降低重尾的影响。HT-Policies通过单次前向传播预测动作块，并可重用预训练的基于流匹配的策略网络作为骨干架构。在四个仿真基准测试和真实机器人评估中，HT-Policies在从零训练和从预训练视觉-语言-动作及世界-动作模型微调两种情况下，均取得了与生成式策略基线相当的成功率，同时在训练和推理速度上更具优势。综上所述，这些发现揭示了生成式目标在机器人示范学习中的实际优势，并为多种架构和任务提供了一种高效的直接回归替代方案。项目主页：https://the-labone.github.io/regression-policy-project/

Authors: Yuchen Zhou, Jiacheng You, Weikang Wan, Weijun Dong, Yang Gao, Jiayuan Mao

MAP2: Model- and Acceleration-Based Pursuit with MPC and Gaussian Process Residual Learning for Autonomous Racing AutonomousDriving

autonomous racing model predictive control Gaussian process residual learning trajectory tracking

简要说明：MAP2 结合运动学 MPC 与高斯过程残差学习用于自动驾驶赛车，在实车实验中降低了横向误差和圈速。

TLDR: MAP2 combines kinematic MPC with Gaussian process residual learning for autonomous racing, reducing lateral error and lap time in real-world experiments.

Abstract: Autonomous racing requires accurate trajectory tracking near the handling limits of a vehicle while maintaining low computational latency. Geometric controllers are computationally efficient, but the Ackermann steering geometry becomes invalid under limit-handling conditions. Model- and Acceleration-based Pursuit (MAP) preserves the simplicity of geometric approaches while leveraging tire dynamics. Yet MAP remains fundamentally a geometric controller that relies on Ackermann steering geometry, and its tire model may not fully capture the vehicle's actual dynamic response. This paper presents MAP2, a model-based pursuit controller that combines a curvature-based kinematic MPC and a Sparse Gaussian Process (SGP) residual correction. The proposed algorithm uses MPC to optimize kinematic control inputs over a prediction horizon and maps them to steering commands through a tire dynamics model augmented with SGP residual correction. Real-world vehicle experiments demonstrate substantial reductions in lateral tracking error and lap time. Compared with MAP and Pure Pursuit (PP), MAP2 reduces the average lateral tracking error by 37.99% and 44.65%, respectively, while reducing average lap time by at least 1.5%.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶竞速要求在接近车辆操控极限的情况下实现精确的轨迹跟踪，同时保持较低的计算延迟。几何控制器计算效率高，但在极限操控工况下，阿克曼转向几何关系不再成立。基于模型和加速度的追踪方法（MAP）在保留几何方法简洁性的同时，利用了轮胎动力学特性。然而，MAP本质上仍是一种依赖阿克曼转向几何关系的几何控制器，其轮胎模型可能无法完全反映车辆的真实动态响应。本文提出MAP2，一种基于模型的追踪控制器，结合了基于曲率的运动学模型预测控制（MPC）和稀疏高斯过程（SGP）残差修正。所提算法利用MPC在预测时域内优化运动学控制输入，并通过融合SGP残差修正的轮胎动力学模型将其映射为转向指令。实车实验表明，该方法显著降低了横向跟踪误差和单圈时间。与MAP和纯追踪（PP）相比，MAP2的平均横向跟踪误差分别降低了37.99%和44.65%，平均单圈时间至少减少了1.5%。

Authors: Weizhan Huang, Cheng Hu, Edoardo Ghignone, Nicolas Baumann, Yiqin Wang, Hongye Su, Lei Xie, Michele Magno

Instance-anchored interaction evidence: Grounding robot plans in human pointing and handling VLN

instance-anchored interaction evidence backward mask propagation grammar-constrained dynamic program symbolic programs implicit-intent tasks

简要说明：本文提出了基于实例锚定的交互证据 (IAE) 方法，通过在视频中注册并跟踪对象，将机器人的规划建立在人类指向和操作的基础上，在 WatchAct 基准上显著优于 32B VLM，且无需针对任务的训练。

TLDR: The paper introduces IAE, an instance-anchored interaction evidence method that registers and tracks objects in video to ground robot plans in human pointing and handling, significantly outperforming a 32B VLM on the WatchAct benchmark without task-specific training.

Abstract: A robot that assists people must often act on what a person has shown rather than said: which of several identical cartons was pointed at, or which box was handled. The plan is executed from the final scene, whereas the evidence occurs earlier, possibly on objects that have since moved. We propose instance-anchored interaction evidence (IAE), which registers every object of the final scene to its public identifier, keeps each identity through the video by backward mask propagation, and describes every frame by the geometry between hands, forearms and these instances. An evidence network trained only from task outcomes scores the instances. For pointing tasks, a grammar-constrained dynamic program trained with a structured loss decodes object-destination programs; symbolic programs handle reference disambiguation and, without learning, episodic tasks. On 1,255 WatchAct benchmark requests, scored by symbolic execution, IAE reaches 64.2% plan success on implicit-intent tasks against 27.5% for a 32B vision-language model (strict success 49.7% against 15.4%), and 46.4% against 27.0% on restoration, reversal and imitation without task-specific training. Controls with the same perception overlays, the same 32 frames, forward tracking, or a relation model trained on the same labels do not explain the gain. Given IAE's evidence as text with its meaning explained, the same language model reaches 57.4%: most of the gain comes from the instance-anchored evidence, and the explicit programs add 6.8 points at a fraction of the cost. Pointing remains the hardest case, with 16.9% strict success. The code is available at https://github.com/WeiZhou96/iae-watchact.

摘要（中文）：摘要：辅助人类的机器人往往必须依据人类所做的动作而非言语来采取行动：例如，在多个相同的纸箱中，哪个被指向，或是哪个箱子被拿起。计划是根据最终场景执行的，而证据则出现在更早的时刻，可能涉及那些之后已经移动的物体。我们提出实例锚定交互证据（IAE），该方法将最终场景中的每个物体注册到其公共标识符，通过反向掩码传播在视频中保持每个身份的连贯性，并利用手部、前臂与这些实例之间的几何关系描述每一帧。仅依据任务结果训练的证据网络对各实例进行评分。对于指向任务，采用结构化损失训练的语法约束动态规划算法可解码物体-目的地程序；符号程序则处理指代消解，并无需学习即可应对情节性任务。在WatchAct基准的1,255个请求中，通过符号执行评分，IAE在隐式意图任务上达到64.2%的计划成功率，而一个32B视觉语言模型仅为27.5%（严格成功率为49.7%对15.4%）；在恢复、反转和模仿任务上，无需特定任务训练，IAE达到46.4%，而对比模型为27.0%。使用相同感知叠加层、相同32帧、前向跟踪或基于相同标签训练的关系模型的对照实验，无法解释这一性能提升。将IAE的证据作为带有意义说明的文本提供给同一语言模型时，其达到57.4%的成功率：大部分增益来自实例锚定证据，而显式程序以极低的成本额外贡献了6.8个百分点。指向任务仍是最具挑战性的情况，严格成功率为16.9%。代码可在 https://github.com/WeiZhou96/iae-watchact 获取。

Authors: Xinliang Xiao, Bowen Yang, Wenjing Zhang, Li Yang, Wei Zhou

PIER: An Evidence-Gated Execution Interface for Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

execution-authorization evidence-gated re-observation manipulation safe execution

简要说明：PIER是一种用于机器人操作的执行授权接口，将证据检查、决策来源和阶段范围内的重新观察与硬件控制分离，通过确定性门控在重新观察预算内验证视觉和触觉输入。

TLDR: PIER is an execution-authorization interface for robotic manipulation that separates evidence checks, decision provenance, and stage-scoped re-observation from hardware control, using a deterministic gate to validate visual and tactile inputs under a re-observation budget.

Abstract: Generating a plausible robot action does not establish that current observations justify its execution. Motivated by exploratory observations of high-confidence visual outputs under severe occlusion, we present PIER, an execution-authorization interface that separates evidence checks, decision provenance, and stage-scoped re-observation from hardware control. The deterministic gate evaluates declared visual and tactile inputs, while its caller maintains a budget of at most one re-observation per stage. We evaluate the implementation using 1,600 threshold-grid cases and 1,200 paired synthetic traces spanning score noise, missing tactile inputs, stale observations, and falsely reassuring scores. The finite grid yields zero declared invariant violations, and a matched Boolean baseline reproduces all non-recovery decisions. Under synthetic score noise, re-observation reduces valid-state denials from 57/120 to 18/120 while increasing invalid-state proceeds from 5/120 to 7/120. Stale and falsely reassuring inputs expose limitations that threshold checks alone cannot resolve. Exploratory visual, tactile, and robot setup records provide context but do not establish physical task performance. These results characterize an inspectable authorization interface and its input-contract limitations, without claiming superiority over equivalent rule logic, calibrated tactile accuracy, or certified physical safety.

摘要（中文）：生成一个看似合理的机器人动作，并不能证明当前的观测结果足以支持其执行。受高置信度视觉输出在严重遮挡下仍可能出现这一探索性观察的启发，我们提出了PIER——一种执行授权接口，它将证据检查、决策溯源和分阶段重新观测从硬件控制中分离出来。确定性门控机制对已声明的视觉和触觉输入进行评估，而其调用方则维持每个阶段至多一次重新观测的预算。我们使用1600个阈值网格案例和1200条配对合成轨迹对实现进行了评估，覆盖了分数噪声、触觉输入缺失、观测信息过期以及虚假的令人安心的分数等情况。有限网格未产生任何已声明的不变式违反，且匹配的布尔基线复现了所有非恢复决策。在合成分数噪声下，重新观测将有效状态拒绝率从57/120降至18/120，同时将无效状态放行率从5/120升至7/120。过期观测量和虚假的令人安心的输入暴露了仅靠阈值检查无法解决的局限性。探索性的视觉、触觉和机器人设置记录提供了背景信息，但并不能确证物理任务执行效果。这些结果刻画了一种可检查的授权接口及其输入契约局限性，而并未声称其优于等效规则逻辑、经过校准的触觉准确性或经认证的物理安全性。

Authors: Zoe Li, Anze Wang, Zhongyu Chen, Jingran Hu

A Minimal Optical-Flow Representation for Vision-Based Tactile Rotation Classification in Robotic Manipulation Across Gravity Domains Manipulation

optical flow tactile sensing robotic manipulation gravity domain shift GelSight

简要说明：本文提出一种紧凑的光流表示，用于从视触觉传感器分类物体旋转，并验证了在不同重力域（地球、火星、月球、轨道）下的鲁棒性，为太空机器人操作提供支持。结果表明，使用多重力数据训练比仅用地球数据训练更准确且更具泛化性。

TLDR: This paper proposes a compact optical-flow representation for classifying object rotation from vision-based tactile sensors, demonstrating robustness across different gravity domains (Earth, Mars, Moon, orbit) for space robotic manipulation. It shows that training on multi-gravity data improves accuracy and transferability compared to Earth-only training.

Abstract: Vision-based tactile sensors provide rich contact information, but processing high-resolution images can be costly for resource-constrained platforms such as space robots. This work investigates whether a compact representation of tactile motion can classify object rotation across different gravity conditions. Dense optical flow from a simulated GelSight Mini is aggregated over a 7x9 grid into 126 features and used to classify the direction of load-induced rotation under Earth, Mars, Moon, and orbital gravity. Gravity causes a small but significant shift in these features, accounting for 1.6% of their variance (R2 = 0.016). Despite its small magnitude, this shift affects models trained only on Earth data: XGBoost accuracy decreases from 94.4% on Earth to 75.9% in orbit. In contrast, a single model trained across all four gravity domains achieves 96.3% overall accuracy and 95.1%-97.0% across individual domains, without using gravity as an input. The representation can also be reduced to 40 features while retaining 95.7% accuracy, with XGBoost requiring only 0.14 ms per inference. These findings show that Earth-gravity performance alone is insufficient to establish the transferability of tactile perception for space robotic manipulation, highlighting the need to account for gravity-induced domain shifts during training and validation.

摘要（中文）：基于视觉的触觉传感器能够提供丰富的接触信息，但对于空间机器人等资源受限平台而言，处理高分辨率图像的代价较高。本研究探讨了一种紧凑的触觉运动表示是否能够在不同重力条件下对物体旋转进行分类。将来自模拟GelSight Mini的密集光流在7×9网格上聚合为126个特征，并用于分类地球、火星、月球及轨道重力下负载诱导旋转的方向。重力在该特征空间中引起微小但显著的偏移，约占其方差变异的1.6%（R² = 0.016）。尽管偏移幅度较小，该变化仍对仅基于地球数据训练的模型产生影响：XGBoost在地球上的准确率从94.4%下降至轨道环境中的75.9%。相比之下，在四种重力域上联合训练的单一模型总体准确率达到96.3%，在各重力域上的准确率范围为95.1%至97.0%，且无需将重力作为输入特征。此外，该表示可缩减至40个特征，同时保持95.7%的准确率，XGBoost单次推理仅需0.14毫秒。上述研究结果表明，仅凭地球重力条件下的性能不足以验证触觉感知在空间机器人操作中的可迁移性，凸显了在训练与验证过程中考虑由重力引起的域偏移的必要性。

Authors: Oscar Martinez-Bernal, Mario Cavero-Vidal, Francesco Grella, Carol Martinez

Reliability-Aware Future Conditioning for Temporally Robust Robot Manipulation Manipulation

Robot manipulation Future conditioning Temporal robustness Reinforcement learning Video diffusion

简要说明：本文提出可靠性感知的未来条件（RAFC），通过估计生成视频片段的可靠性和候选偏好来增强机器人操作策略对时间错位的鲁棒性，仅从任务奖励学习，无需额外标注。在CALVIN和Franka机器人上，在人为和自然时间偏移下均显著提高了成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces Reliability-Aware Future Conditioning (RAFC), a method that improves robot manipulation policies' robustness to temporal misalignment in generated future video conditioning by estimating clip reliability and candidate preference, learned via task reward without extra labels. It demonstrates significant success improvements under imposed and natural timing shifts on CALVIN and a Franka robot.

Abstract: A generated video of a task the robot is about to perform is useful guidance only if it depicts the phase the robot is actually in. We show that temporal misalignment can turn a task-consistent generated future into actively harmful guidance. On CALVIN, a five-frame early shift nearly erases the benefit of generated futures, reducing success from 81.3% to 54.8% against 54.0% without futures; imposed timing shifts reduce it even further to 34.2%, 19.8 points below the future-free policy. We introduce Reliability-Aware Future Conditioning (RAFC), which treats this as a control problem rather than a generation problem. At every step, RAFC estimates how far to trust the received clip and which nearby temporal hypothesis to prefer, falling back toward a static branch when neither fits, and it learns both from task reward alone without shift labels or alignment supervision. RAFC sits on top of Future-Experience Conditioning (FEC), which builds the clip once from task grounding, a robot-free digital-twin rollout, and mask-free video diffusion. Under deliberately off-grid phase shifts and rate mismatch, RAFC substantially improves success under temporal mismatch. Candidate ensembling accounts for most of the recovery near alignment, while learned reliability adds a further 7.0 percentage points over uniform averaging of the identical candidate bank under off-grid shifts. The gain holds on the evaluated task sets and survives on a Franka under natural timing mismatch nobody imposed, where aggregate success rises from 26.7% to 56.7%. All resources will be made publicly available. https://future-condition.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：关于机器人即将执行的任务所生成的视频，只有当它描绘的是机器人当前所处的阶段时，才能作为有效的引导。我们发现，时间上的错位可能将任务一致的未来生成转变成有害的引导。在CALVIN上，仅五帧的提前偏移就几乎消除了生成未来的益处，使成功率从81.3%降至54.8%，而无生成未来时的基线为54.0%；人为施加的时间偏移进一步将成功率降至34.2%，比无未来策略低19.8个百分点。我们提出了可靠性感知的未来条件（RAFC），该方法将此问题视为控制问题而非生成问题。在每一步中，RAFC估计接收到的剪辑的可信程度以及应优先选择哪个邻近的时间假设，当两者均不匹配时则回退至静态分支，且其仅通过网络任务奖励进行学习，不需要偏移标签或对齐监督。RAFC构建于未来经验条件（FEC）之上，后者一次性从任务基础、无机器人数字孪生 rollout 以及无掩码视频扩散中构建剪辑。在刻意设置的偏离网格的相位偏移和速率失配下，RAFC显著提升了时间错位情况下的成功率。候选集成解释了接近对齐时的绝大部分恢复效果，而学习到的可靠性在偏离网格偏移情形下，相较于对相同候选库进行均匀平均，进一步增加了7.0个百分点的性能提升。该增益在评估任务集上保持稳定，并在Franka上在无人为施加的自然时间失配下依然有效，总体成功率从26.7%提升至56.7%。所有资源将公开提供。https://future-condition.github.io/。

Authors: Mohammad Khoshnazar, Mohammad Dehghani Tezerjani, Zhiyuan Gao, Deyuan Qu, Max Gandyra, Yanxiang Zhan, Mehreen Naeem, Andrew Melnik, Jeroen Schafer, Qing Yang, Michael Beetz

2DGS-Planner: Rasterization-based Path Planning in 2D Gaussian Splatting Map Other

2D Gaussian splatting path planning rasterization mobile robot navigation roadmap construction

简要说明：本文提出了2DGS-Planner，一种基于2D高斯泼溅地图光栅化的地面机器人路径规划器，相比于基线方法，在路图连通性、间隙估计和规划成功率方面有所提升。

TLDR: This paper introduces 2DGS-Planner, a path planner for ground robots that uses rasterization on 2D Gaussian splatting maps to improve roadmap connectivity, clearance estimation, and planning success compared to baselines.

Abstract: Gaussian splatting provides an explicit and efficiently rasterizable scene representation for robot navigation. However, individual Gaussian primitives may not reliably represent obstacles as they are jointly optimized through alpha-composited rendering from a finite set of reconstruction views. We propose 2DGS-Planner, a path planner for ground robots that reads planning-relevant geometry from a 2D Gaussian splatting (2DGS) map through rasterization, rather than treating individual Gaussian primitives as obstacles. During offline roadmap construction, multi-view attribution converts rendered normal dispersion into structural scores for non-ground disks supported by the reconstruction views. These scores guide adaptive node sampling on the ground. Path-aligned orthographic queries validate candidate edges, while cylindrical queries estimate local clearance fields that are cached on the edges. During online planning, graph search initializes a route, and path refinement reuses the cached fields while accounting for the robot's dimensions and ground constraints. Experiments demonstrate improved roadmap connectivity, more accurate clearance estimation, and higher planning success compared with the tested baselines. These results support rasterization as an effective geometric query interface for planning directly on Gaussian maps. Code and data are available at https://2dgs-planner.github.io/

摘要（中文）：高斯溅射为机器人导航提供了一种显式且高效可栅格化的场景表征方法。然而，由于单个高斯基元是通过有限重建视图的alpha合成渲染进行联合优化的，它们可能无法可靠地表示障碍物。我们提出2DGS-Planner，一种面向地面机器人的路径规划器，它通过栅格化从二维高斯溅射（2DGS）地图中读取与规划相关的几何信息，而非将单个高斯基元视为障碍物。在离线路标图构建阶段，多视图属性归因将渲染法向离散度转换为由重建视图支撑的非地面圆盘的结构评分。这些评分引导地面上的自适应节点采样。路径对齐的正交查询用于验证候选边，而圆柱查询则估计局部间隙场并缓存于边上。在线规划阶段，图搜索初始化路径，路径细化在考虑机器人尺寸和地面约束的同时复用缓存的间隙场。实验结果表明，与测试的基线方法相比，所提方法在路标图连通性、间隙估计精度和规划成功率方面均有提升。这些结果支持栅格化作为直接在高斯地图上进行规划的有效几何查询接口。代码和数据可在 https://2dgs-planner.github.io/ 获取。

Authors: Jiwon Park, Dong-Uk Seo, Hyun Myung

From Solo to Ensemble: A Hierarchical Framework for Composable Multi-Agent Human-Object Interaction Manipulation

multi-agent HOI hierarchical framework object-oriented action space skill distillation composable policies

简要说明：本文提出了一种分层框架，将基于物理的单一智能体人-物交互策略提炼为可复用的面向物体的运动技能，并由高层策略协调多个智能体，实现跨不同物体、交互类型和团队规模的可组合多智能体交互。

TLDR: This paper introduces a hierarchical framework that distills a single-agent physics-based human-object interaction (HOI) policy into a reusable Object-oriented Motion Skill, which is then frozen and coordinated by a high-level policy to enable composable multi-agent HOI across different objects, interaction types, and team sizes.

Abstract: Physics-based human-object interaction has achieved robust single-agent manipulation skills, yet extending them to multi-agent cooperative tasks remains challenging. Existing approaches typically adapt interaction policies through task-specific fine-tuning, which entangles low-level contact-rich execution with high-level coordination and limits reuse across object geometries, interaction types, and team sizes. We propose a hierarchical framework that converts a single-agent HOI policy into a reusable Object-oriented Motion Skill. Specifically, we reinterpret teacher rollouts as object-oriented action supervision by extracting short-horizon object-proxy motions from executed trajectories, and distill task-specific teachers into a low-level skill operating in an Object-oriented Action Space. For downstream tasks, the distilled skill is frozen as a reusable executor, while a high-level policy coordinates multiple agents by generating region-wise object-oriented actions conditioned on the shared object, task goal, agent states, and local manipulation regions. This formulation shifts multi-agent HOI learning from direct contact-rich full-body control to compact object-level proxy-motion coordination. Experiments on diverse HOI tasks show that the distilled Object-oriented Motion Skill supports robust proxy-motion execution and enables composable policy learning across different interaction types, object geometries, and team sizes.

摘要（中文）：基于物理的人-物交互已在单智能体操作技能上取得了稳健成果，但将其扩展到多智能体协作任务仍具挑战。现有方法通常通过任务特定的微调来适配交互策略，这使低层接触密集型执行与高层协调相互纠缠，限制了其在物体几何形状、交互类型及团队规模之间的复用性。我们提出一种分层框架，将单智能体人-物交互策略转化为可复用的面向物体的运动技能。具体而言，我们从教师策略的轨迹中提取短时程物体代理运动，将教师回放重新解释为面向物体的动作监督，并将任务特定教师策略蒸馏为在面向物体动作空间中运行的低层技能。对于下游任务，蒸馏后的技能被冻结为可复用的执行器，而高层策略通过基于共享物体、任务目标、智能体状态及局部操作区域生成区域级面向物体动作，来协调多个智能体。该形式将多智能体人-物交互学习从直接的接触丰富全身控制转变为紧凑的物体级代理运动协调。在多样的人-物交互任务上的实验表明，蒸馏得到的面向物体运动技能支持稳健的代理运动执行，并能跨不同交互类型、物体几何形状及团队规模实现可组合的策略学习。

Authors: Zekai Deng, Kangyi Chen, Ye Shi, Jingya Wang

YOCO: You Only Calibrate Once! Fast Mocap Calibration for Dexterous Teleoperation Manipulation

dexterous teleoperation hand pose estimation MANO HyperNet LoRA

简要说明：YOCO 是一种快速、少样本、无需微调的校准框架，通过条件化 HyperNet 预测冻结的 MANO 手部估计模块的 LoRA 风格更新，来纠正灵巧遥操作中的偏置手部姿态流。

TLDR: YOCO is a fast, few-shot, fine-tuning-free calibration framework that corrects biased hand-pose streams for dexterous teleoperation by conditioning a HyperNet to predict LoRA-style updates for a frozen MANO hand-estimation module.

Abstract: Dexterous teleoperation requires reliable human-hand state estimations. However, common low-cost motion-capture gloves and markerless trackers often exhibit biases that vary across users, glove fit, and recording sessions, degrading retargeting and demonstration quality. We present YOCO, a fast few-shot, fine-tuning-free calibration framework that corrects biased hand-pose streams from a small set of paired raw and target poses. Instead of optimizing a separate model for every operator or session, YOCO conditions a calibration HyperNet on the paired examples and predicts LoRA-style updates for a frozen MANO hand-estimation module, turning per-user calibration into a lightweight feed-forward adaptation step while preserving the geometric prior of MANO and the efficiency of a compact estimator. We train YOCO with synthetic drift augmentations on InterHand2.6M and evaluate on augmented InterHand sequences, offline real glove data, and dexterous teleoperation tasks. Across these settings, YOCO improves calibration efficiency, hand-state estimation quality and teleoperation performance compared with uncalibrated input and standard calibration baselines.

摘要（中文）：灵巧遥操作需要可靠的人手状态估计。然而，常见的低成本动作捕捉手套和无标记追踪器往往存在偏差，且这些偏差会因用户、手套适配度及记录会话的不同而变化，从而降低重定向和示教质量。我们提出了YOCO，一种快速、少样本、免微调的校准框架，可从少量成对的原始姿态与目标姿态中修正有偏的手部姿态流。YOCO并非为每位操作员或每次会话单独优化模型，而是将校准HyperNet以成对样本为条件，为冻结的MANO手部估计模块预测LoRA式更新，将每次用户的校准转化为轻量级的前馈自适应步骤，同时保留MANO的几何先验和紧凑估计器的高效性。我们利用InterHand2.6M上的合成漂移增强训练YOCO，并在增强的InterHand序列、离线真实手套数据以及灵巧遥操作任务上进行评估。在这些场景中，与未校准输入和标准校准基线相比，YOCO在校准效率、手部状态估计质量和遥操作性能方面均有所提升。

Authors: Yu Zhang, Yunqi Li, Yushi Du, Yi Ma, Yanchao Yang

Experience-Guided Initiation Search for Learned Skills in Skill Composition VLA

skill composition initiation search VLA policies behavior validation experience-guided

简要说明：EVIS 是一个框架，利用历史执行经验来优先排序和验证学习技能的起始配置，从而减少 VLA 策略技能组合中的目标环境查询。

TLDR: EVIS is a framework that uses historical execution experience to prioritize and validate initiation configurations for frozen learned skills, reducing target-environment queries in skill composition for VLA policies.

Abstract: Deploying frozen learned skills, such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, in new environments requires identifying initiation configurations that support reliable execution. In skill composition, an initiation configuration affects not only the current skill but also the physical state passed to subsequent skills, so successful execution of an individual skill does not necessarily imply successful completion of the composed task. Estimating target-specific capability through extensive rollouts is costly in real-world deployment, while directly reusing historical experience can be unreliable under environment changes. We propose EVIS, an Experience-Guided and Behavior-Validated Initiation Search framework for discovering reliable initiation configurations under limited target interaction. EVIS uses historical execution experience to prioritize promising candidates and target-environment behavior to validate whether they remain effective. We evaluate EVIS on single-skill and two-stage manipulation tasks with frozen VLA policies. EVIS reduces mean target-environment queries and improves reliable candidate discovery under small interaction budgets. These results show that combining historical guidance with target-side behavioral validation can reduce the interaction cost of deploying frozen learned skills in new environments.

摘要（中文）：在全新环境中部署冻结的学习技能（如视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略）时，需要识别能够支持可靠执行的初始配置。在技能组合中，初始配置不仅影响当前技能，还会影响传递给后续技能的物理状态，因此单个技能的成功执行并不一定意味着组合任务能够顺利完成。在真实世界部署中，通过大量 rollout 来估计目标特定能力成本高昂，而直接复用历史经验在环境变化下又可能不可靠。我们提出 EVIS——一种经验引导与行为验证的初始配置搜索框架，用于在有限的目标交互下发现可靠的初始配置。EVIS 利用历史执行经验对潜在候选配置进行优先级排序，并通过目标环境中的行为验证来确认其是否仍然有效。我们在冻结的 VLA 策略上，对单技能和两阶段操作任务进行了 EVIS 评估。EVIS 减少了平均目标环境查询次数，并在小交互预算下提升了可靠候选配置的发现效果。这些结果表明，将历史引导与目标侧行为验证相结合，能够降低在新环境中部署冻结学习技能所需的交互成本。

Authors: Qixuan Li, Yanhong Zhao, Jincheng Yu

Distributed Relative Localization for Homogeneous Multi-Robot Systems through UWB Ranging and Limited Communications RLRobot

distributed relative localization multi-robot systems UWB ranging LiDAR data association

简要说明：本文提出了一种面向同构多机器人系统的全分布式相对位姿估计方法，融合LiDAR、UWB测距和里程计，实现无需外部基础设施和大量通信的精确可靠队友定位。

TLDR: This paper presents a fully distributed relative pose estimation method for homogeneous multi-robot systems, integrating LiDAR, UWB ranging, and odometry to enable accurate and reliable teammate localization without external infrastructure or extensive communication.

Abstract: Accurate and reliable relative localization is crucial for multi-robot applications like exploration, search, and rescue missions. LiDAR-based solutions offer high accuracy in localizing surrounding objects; however, distinguishing homogeneous robots with similar appearances remains challenging due to the lack of distinctive identification features. In this paper, we propose a fully distributed relative pose estimation approach by integrating LiDAR, UWB, and odometry measurements, allowing each robot to accurately and continuously localize its teammates without external infrastructure. Specifically, potential anonymous teammate robot clusters from LiDAR scans are tracked by a dynamic tracker. We then identify teammate robots from these tracked anonymous clusters using a joint matching strategy, ensuring reliable data association between robots and clusters. Finally, by combining the corresponding LiDAR observations, UWB ranging, and odometry measurements, each robot precisely localizes others while minimizing data exchange. The system requires only odometry data exchange through onboard UWB, eliminating the need for additional communication infrastructure like WiFi routers or mesh networks. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and reliability of the proposed relative localization approach.

摘要（中文）：精确可靠的相对定位对于多机器人应用（如探索、搜索和救援任务）至关重要。基于激光雷达的解决方案在定位周围物体方面具有较高精度；然而，由于缺乏独特的识别特征，区分外观相似的同类机器人仍具挑战性。本文提出一种融合激光雷达、超宽带（UWB）和里程计测量的全分布式相对位姿估计方法，使每个机器人无需外部基础设施即可准确、连续地定位其队友。具体而言，来自激光雷达扫描的潜在匿名队友机器人聚类由动态跟踪器进行跟踪。随后，我们利用联合匹配策略从这些被跟踪的匿名聚类中识别队友机器人，确保机器人与聚类之间的可靠数据关联。最后，通过结合相应的激光雷达观测、UWB测距和里程计测量，每个机器人在最小化数据交换的同时精确定位其他机器人。该系统仅需通过机载UWB交换里程计数据，无需额外通信基础设施（如WiFi路由器或网状网络）。大量仿真和实际实验验证了所提相对定位方法的有效性和可靠性。

Authors: Zhiqiang Cao, Ran Liu, Billy Pik Lik Lau, Chau Yuen, U-Xuan Tan

SafeInferCom: Safe Inference-Time Compute via Verifier-Guided Mid-Generation Intervention for Robotic Task Planning Other

inference-time monitor verifier-guided intervention robotic task planning Large Reasoning Language Models error correction

简要说明：SafeInferCom 是一个验证器引导的框架，在大型推理语言模型的生成过程中进行监控和干预，以保留有效的中间计划并纠正错误，从而提高机器人任务规划的成功率和标记效率。

TLDR: SafeInferCom is a verifier-guided framework that monitors and intervenes in the mid-generation of Large Reasoning Language Models to preserve valid intermediate plans and correct errors, improving robotic task planning success and token efficiency.

Abstract: Large Reasoning Language Models (LRLMs) enable multi-step reasoning for robotic task planning, but continued reasoning can overwrite valid intermediate plans or leave constraint violations unresolved, reducing planning reliability and wasting inference-time computation. We develop an inference-time monitor that exposes and verifies intermediate plans without disrupting the original decoding trajectory. Building on this monitor, we propose SafeInferCom, a formal verifier-guided framework that preserves valid intermediate plans and directs error correction during generation. Experiments across multiple LRLMs and planning domains reveal reasoning-response inconsistency and limited self-correction under one-shot inference. SafeInferCom improves planning success and accelerates error correction relative to one-shot inference. When combined with iterative refinement, it further improves success while reducing token usage compared with refinement alone. We additionally evaluate SafeInferCom in VirtualHome and provide a real-world robotic-arm demonstration.

摘要（中文）：大型推理语言模型（LRLMs）能够实现机器人任务规划中的多步推理，但持续推理可能会覆盖有效的中间计划或遗留未解决的约束冲突，从而降低规划可靠性并浪费推理时的计算资源。我们开发了一种推理时监控器，能够在不断原始解码轨迹的前提下，暴露并验证中间计划。在此监控器的基础上，我们提出了SafeInferCom——一个形式化验证器引导的框架，用于保留有效的中间计划并在生成过程中引导错误修正。在多个大型推理语言模型及规划领域的实验中，我们发现了一次性推理下推理-响应不一致以及自我修正能力有限的问题。相较于一次性推理，SafeInferCom提升了规划成功率并加速了错误修正。当与迭代细化方法结合使用时，相较于仅使用细化方法，SafeInferCom在进一步提升成功率的同时减少了令牌使用量。此外，我们还在VirtualHome环境中评估了SafeInferCom，并提供了真实世界机械臂演示。

Authors: Weizhe Xu, Jialiang Fan, Mengyu Liu, Fanxin Kong

How Firm Should a Grasp Be? Manipulation

visuotactile grasp force control material property estimation parallel-jaw gripper simulation-to-real

简要说明：本文提出了一种在抓取过程中通过视觉触觉实时估计物体材料属性（质量、弹性、摩擦力）的方法，并利用这些估计来确定所需的最小抓取力。该方法在真实平行爪夹持器上对水果蔬菜数据集进行了验证，展示了柔和且自适应的抓取能力。

TLDR: This paper presents a visuotactile approach for estimating material properties (mass, elasticity, friction) in real time during grasping, using these estimates to determine the minimum required grasp force. The method is validated on a real parallel-jaw gripper with a dataset of fruits and vegetables, showing gentle and adaptive grasping.

Abstract: An ideal robot grasp is firm enough to securely handle an object, yet gentle enough to avoid damaging it. Achieving this balance requires knowledge of the object's material properties, such as its mass, elasticity, and surface friction. These properties, however, are seldom precisely known a priori. In this work, we propose a visuotactile approach to estimating material properties in real time, during the process of grasping. Our method uses these estimated properties to determine the minimum grasp force required to handle the object. We contribute a new dataset of real-world objects (fruits and vegetables) with measured physical properties (shape, mass, elasticity, and friction), which we use to construct our force estimation model via simulations. We experimentally validate our approach to grasp force control using a robot with a parallel-jaw gripper. We demonstrate our system's ability to gently grasp a wide variety of objects, in each case adapting to their unique physical properties.

摘要（中文）：理想的机器人抓取应当足够牢固以稳妥地操控物体，同时又要足够轻柔以避免对其造成损伤。实现这一平衡需要对物体的材料特性有所了解，例如其质量、弹性及表面摩擦力。然而，这些特性往往事先难以精确获知。在本项工作中，我们提出了一种在抓取过程中实时估算材料特性的视觉触觉融合方法。该方法利用估算出的特性来确定操控物体所需的最小抓取力。我们贡献了一个新的真实世界物体（水果与蔬菜）数据集，其中包含实测的物理特性（形状、质量、弹性和摩擦力），并基于此通过仿真构建了力估算模型。我们使用配备平行夹爪的机器人对所提出的抓取力控制方法进行了实验验证，展示了系统在适应各类物体独特物理特性的同时，能够轻柔地抓取多种物体的能力。

Authors: Matthew Beveridge, Shree K. Nayar

Demonstrating Arena 5.0: A Photorealistic ROS2 Simulation Framework for Developing and Benchmarking Social Navigation RLRobot

social navigation photorealistic simulation ROS2 NVIDIA Isaac Gym benchmarking

简要说明：Arena 5.0是一个开源的、基于ROS2的逼真社交导航仿真框架，集成了NVIDIA Isaac Gym，提供全面的基准测试，并支持可定制的场景生成。

TLDR: Arena 5.0 is an open-source photorealistic ROS2 simulation framework for social navigation, integrating NVIDIA Isaac Gym, providing comprehensive benchmarks, and enabling customizable scenario generation for robotics research.

Abstract: Building upon the foundations laid by our previous work, this paper introduces Arena 5.0, the fifth iteration of our framework for robotics social navigation development and benchmarking. Arena 5.0 provides three main contributions: 1) The complete integration of NVIDIA Isaac Gym, enabling photorealistic simulations and more efficient training. It seamlessly incorporates Isaac Gym into the Arena platform, allowing the use of existing modules such as randomized environment generation, evaluation tools, ROS2 support, and the integration of planners, robot models, and APIs within Isaac Gym. 2) A comprehensive benchmark of state-of-the-art social navigation strategies, evaluated on a diverse set of generated and customized worlds and scenarios of varying difficulty levels. These benchmarks provide a detailed assessment of navigation planners using a wide range of social navigation metrics. 3) Extensive scenario generation and task planning modules for improved and customizable generation of social navigation scenarios, such as emergency and rescue situations. The platform's performance was evaluated by generating the aforementioned benchmark and through a comprehensive user study, demonstrating significant improvements in usability and efficiency compared to previous versions. Arena 5.0 is open source and available at https://github.com/Arena-Rosnav.

摘要（中文）：基于我们前期工作的基础，本文介绍了Arena 5.0，这是我们用于机器人社交导航开发与基准测试框架的第五代版本。Arena 5.0提供了三项主要贡献：1) 完全集成NVIDIA Isaac Gym，实现逼真模拟和更高效的训练。它将Isaac Gym无缝整合进Arena平台，使得在Isaac Gym中能够使用现有模块，如随机化环境生成、评估工具、ROS2支持，以及规划器、机器人和API的集成。2) 对最先进的社交导航策略进行全面基准测试，在多样化的生成及定制化世界和不同难度级别的场景中进行评估。这些基准测试利用广泛的社交导航指标，对导航规划器进行了详细评估。3) 扩展的场景生成和任务规划模块，用于改进和可定制地生成社交导航场景，例如紧急和救援情况。平台性能通过生成上述基准测试以及全面的用户研究进行评估，结果显示与先前版本相比，在可用性和效率方面有显著提升。Arena 5.0为开源项目，可在https://github.com/Arena-Rosnav获取。

Authors: Volodymyr Shcherbyna, Linh Kästner, Duc Anh Do, Hoang Tung, Huu Giang Nguyen, Maximilian Ho-Kyoung Schreff, Tim Seeger, Eva Wiese, Ahmed Martban, Huajian Zeng, An Tran, Nguyen Quoc Hung, Jonas Kreutz, Vu Thanh Lam, Ton Manh Kien, Harold Soh

Higher-Order Action Supervision Makes A Strong Policy Class Other

higher-order action supervision imitation learning reinforcement learning continuous control robustness

简要说明：本文提出一种即插即用的损失方案，同时监督零阶和一阶动作，以提高策略的控制稳定性和鲁棒性，并在 OGBench 和 D4RL 上取得显著改进。

TLDR: This paper proposes a plug-and-play loss scheme that supervises both zeroth- and first-order actions to improve policy control stability and robustness in imitation and reinforcement learning, with theoretical guarantees and empirical gains on OGBench and D4RL.

Abstract: Modern data-driven decision-making methods, such as imitation learning (IL) and reinforcement learning (RL), have achieved great success in solving many complex tasks. However, these methods often suffer from serious control instability and robustness issues when applied in real-world applications such as robotics and autonomous driving, posing notable challenges for their practical deployment. We argue that this instability issue stems largely from their limitations in solely supervising and optimizing zeroth-order actions (i.e., the action labels), failing to account for higher-order action dynamics and temporal consistency. In this paper, we show that simultaneously supervising both zeroth- and first-order actions can dramatically enhance policies' performance and control robustness. To achieve this, we introduce a novel and elegant loss scheme supported by formal theoretical guarantees that can equip any off-the-shelf policy model (e.g., deterministic, stochastic, or flow policies) with the capability for higher-order action supervision, without requiring any structural modifications. Moreover, our proposed method can serve as a lightweight plug-and-play module that seamlessly integrates with a broad spectrum of existing offline RL frameworks. Extensive evaluations on OGBench and D4RL demonstrate that our approach yields substantial performance and robustness improvements across a wide range of continuous control environments. Notably, our method can also enhance policies' out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization capability in the challenging low-data regime, making it an ideal tool in tackling many real-world control problems.

摘要（中文）：现代数据驱动的决策方法，如模仿学习（IL）和强化学习（RL），在解决众多复杂任务方面已取得显著成功。然而，当这些方法应用于机器人技术、自动驾驶等实际场景时，往往面临严重的控制不稳定性和鲁棒性问题，这为其实际部署带来了显著挑战。我们认为，这一不稳定性问题主要源于其在监督和优化过程中仅关注零阶动作（即动作标签），而未能充分考虑高阶动作动态和时间一致性。在本文中，我们展示了同时监督零阶和一阶动作能够显著提升策略的性能和控制鲁棒性。为实现这一目标，我们提出了一种新颖且优雅的损失方案，该方案具有正式的理论保证，能够为任何现成的策略模型（例如确定性策略、随机策略或流策略）赋予高阶动作监督能力，而无需对其结构进行任何修改。此外，我们提出的方法可作为一种轻量级的即插即用模块，无缝集成到多种现有的离线强化学习框架中。在OGBench和D4RL上的广泛评估表明，我们的方法在各种连续控制环境中均带来了显著的性能和鲁棒性提升。值得注意的是，我们的方法还能够在具有挑战性的低数据场景下增强策略的分布外（OOD）泛化能力，使其成为解决许多实际控制问题的理想工具。

Authors: Peng Cheng, Yunxian Hou, Zhi Zhou, Qian Zhang, Chang Huang, Xianyuan Zhan

Distributed Relative Localization Based on Ultra-WideBand and LiDAR for Multi-robot with Limited Communication RLRobot

relative localization multi-robot UWB LiDAR subgraph matching

简要说明：本文提出一种基于UWB和LiDAR的多机器人分布式相对定位方法，通过公共子图匹配解决机器人的识别问题，适用于GPS受限和通信受限环境。

TLDR: This paper proposes a distributed relative localization approach for multi-robot systems using UWB and LiDAR, addressing robot identification via common subgraph matching in GPS-denied and communication-limited environments.

Abstract: Relative localization is crucial for a multi-robot system to collaboratively perform tasks, such as exploration and formation. However, this is highly challenging for homogeneous robots with similar appearance in GPS-denied and communication-limited environments. In this paper, we propose a fully distributed relative position estimation approach for a team of robots based on onboard UWB and LiDAR sensors, in which LiDAR is utilized to obtain the position of anonymous objects in Line-of-Sight (LOS), and UWB is used for ranging between robots. We construct two graphs, namely UWB connection graph and LiDAR connection graph, to represent the spatial relationship among objects (robots and obstacles) based on UWB and LiDAR measurements. Identification and relative position estimation are formulated as a common subgraph matching problem. A falsely-matched robot identification approach is designed to recognize the falsely-matched results caused by obstacle blockage in LiDAR field of view. These robots are then localized by leveraging the well-matched robots and the UWB ranging measurements in the UWB connection graph. We conducted experiments to evaluate the performance of our approach. The results show that the proposed approach is capable of achieving satisfactory positioning accuracy for a team of robots in a distributed manner with only exchanging limited information.

摘要（中文）：相对定位对于多机器人系统协作执行探索和编队等任务至关重要。然而，在GPS受限且通信受限的环境中，对于外观相似的同类机器人而言，这一任务极具挑战性。本文提出了一种基于机载UWB和LiDAR传感器的全分布式相对位置估计方法，其中LiDAR用于获取视线范围内匿名物体的位置，UWB用于机器人间的测距。我们构建了两个图，即UWB连接图和LiDAR连接图，分别基于UWB和LiDAR测量值来表示物体（机器人和障碍物）之间的空间关系。识别和相对位置估计被建模为一个公共子图匹配问题。我们设计了一种误匹配机器人识别方法，用于识别因LiDAR视野中障碍物遮挡而导致的误匹配结果。随后，通过利用良好匹配的机器人和UWB连接图中的UWB测距测量值，对这些机器人进行定位。我们开展了实验以评估所提方法的性能。结果表明，该方法能够在仅交换有限信息的情况下，以分布式方式为机器人团队实现令人满意的定位精度。

Authors: Zhiqiang Cao, Ran Liu, Billy Pik Lik Lau, Chau Yuen, U-Xuan Tan

Towards Path-Creative Navigation: Robot Navigation through Embodied Interaction VLN

Path-Creative Navigation embodied interaction mapless navigation traversability-aware decision vision-LiDAR-odometry

简要说明：本文提出了路径创造性导航（PCN），机器人通过具身交互（推动物体或结构、请求行人让路）恢复自由空间，并设计了一种无地图的视觉-激光雷达-里程计框架，决定何时及如何交互，在杂乱环境中实现了更高的任务完成率。

TLDR: The paper introduces Path-Creative Navigation (PCN), where a robot recovers free space by embodied interaction (pushing objects, articulated structures, or requesting pedestrians to move), and presents a mapless vision-LiDAR-odometry framework that decides when and how to interact, achieving higher task completion in cluttered environments.

Abstract: Autonomous navigation in cluttered and constrained environments typically assumes a fixed environment and searches only for paths within existing free space. However, a route can be blocked by an articulated structure, a movable object, or a pedestrian, and reaching the goal may therefore require appropriate embodied interaction with the environment. This paper formulates Path-Creative Navigation (PCN), a navigation paradigm in which the robot recovers free space by coordinating locomotion and embodied interaction, and addresses one class of PCN tasks with a mapless framework. The vision-LiDAR-odometry framework integrates local observations, obstacle geometry, and robot-state estimates through a unified navigation system, providing stable semantic and geometric information for navigation and interaction. The traversability-aware decision method utilizes visual and LiDAR distance information to determine whether a blockage is actionable and whether it can be safely bypassed, enabling the robot to interact only when necessary while supporting articulated structure pushing, movable object pushing, obstacle avoidance, and pedestrian requests. We design simulation scenarios and evaluate different methods in both simulation and two real-world tasks that cannot be completed by conventional navigation alone without embodied interaction. These results demonstrate that our framework achieves higher task completion than the baseline methods by coordinating navigation and interaction in cluttered and constrained environments. Code is available at:{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/path-creative-navigation/}.

摘要（中文）：在杂乱且受限的环境中进行自主导航，通常假设环境是固定的，并且只在现有自由空间中搜索路径。然而，一条路线可能会被铰接结构、可移动物体或行人阻挡，因此，要到达目标，可能需要机器人与环境进行适当的具身交互。本文提出了路径创造性导航（PCN）这一导航范式，在该范式中，机器人通过协调运动与具身交互来恢复自由空间，并针对一类PCN任务提出了一种无地图框架。该视觉-激光雷达-里程计框架通过统一的导航系统整合局部观测、障碍物几何信息和机器人状态估计，为导航与交互提供稳定的语义和几何信息。基于可通行性的决策方法利用视觉和激光雷达距离信息来判断障碍物是否可操作以及是否可以安全绕行，从而使机器人仅在必要时进行交互，同时支持铰接结构推拉、可移动物体推动、避障以及行人请求。我们设计了仿真场景，并在仿真和两个无法仅靠传统导航完成（必须依赖具身交互）的真实世界任务中评估了不同方法。结果表明，在杂乱且受限的环境中，我们的框架通过协调导航与交互，相比基线方法实现了更高的任务完成率。代码可在以下网址获取：{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/path-creative-navigation/}。

Authors: Haoyu Xi, Siwei Cheng, Xiangyuan Liu, Brenda Li, Wei Zhang

iAm.md: Robot Skill Self-Assessment through Agentic Introspection for Unknown Open-Vocabulary Domains VLA

agentic introspection skill self-assessment open-vocabulary semantic mapping grounding failure embodied task planning

简要说明：本文提出了 iAm.md，一种基于 Markdown 的标准化表示，结合开放词汇语义映射，使 TIAGo 等具身代理能够进行智能体自省和技能自我评估，确保生成的计划符合机器人实际能力和环境条件。

TLDR: This paper introduces iAm.md, a Markdown-based standardized representation combined with open-vocabulary semantic mapping to enable agentic introspection and skill self-assessment for embodied agents like TIAGo, ensuring generated plans are grounded in the actual robot's and environment's capabilities.

Abstract: Agentic AI based on Large Language Model generalization capabilities offers a wide range of potential applications, including planning for embodied tasks. For example, embodied agents based on Foundation models can generate plausible plans in autonomous robotics scenarios. Due to limited context windows or hallucinatory phenomena in the next-token prediction formulation, behaviors may be generated without establishing whether the deployed robot and the observed environment actually support the requested operation, in what we call a "grounding failure". Thanks to the recent improvements in reasoning capabilities of foundation models, autonomous robot behavior generation problem can be formulated as a code generation problem. We present iAm.md, a Markdown standard and generation framework, that allows anchoring this process in complementary forms of deployment evidence. Through open-vocabulary semantic mapping, we combine local vision-language detections and object segmentation and refer them to persistent object records in this intermediate standardized representation, allowing agentic introspection. We then study this new technique on a simulated TIAGo, on navigation-and-manipulation tasks, showing how this standardized representation jointly supports skill self-assessment and executable task generalization.

摘要（中文）：基于大型语言模型泛化能力的代理型人工智能具有广泛的应用前景，包括具身任务规划。例如，基于基础模型的具身智能体能够在自主机器人场景中生成合理的规划方案。然而，由于上下文窗口的限制或下一词元预测框架中存在的幻觉现象，智能体可能在未确认所部署机器人及观测环境是否真正支持所要求操作的情况下生成行为，我们将此称为“接地失败”。得益于基础模型推理能力的最新进展，自主机器人行为生成问题可被形式化为代码生成问题。本文提出iAm.md，一种Markdown标准及生成框架，能够将该过程锚定于多种互补形式的部署证据中。通过开放词汇语义映射，我们融合局部视觉-语言检测与对象分割，并将这些结果关联至该中间标准化表示中的持久化对象记录，从而实现代理型内省。随后，我们在模拟TIAGo平台上，针对导航与操作任务对该新技术进行研究，展示了该标准化表示如何联合支持技能自评估与可执行任务的泛化。

Authors: Vincenzo Guarino, Emanuele Musumeci, Vincenzo Suriani, Daniele Nardi

Higher-Order Morphology Priors for Quadruped Reinforcement Learning Under Actuator Degradation Locomotion

quadruped locomotion reinforcement learning actuator degradation Hodge-based message passing cell complex

简要说明：本文提出利用胞腔复形和霍奇消息传递的高阶形态先验用于四足机器人强化学习，在Unitree Go1上展示了对抗执行器退化的鲁棒性提升。

TLDR: This paper proposes higher-order morphological priors using cell complexes and Hodge-based message passing for quadruped reinforcement learning, demonstrating improved robustness to actuator degradation on the Unitree Go1.

Abstract: Actuator degradation turns quadruped locomotion into a coordination problem requiring joints to compensate for lost actuation. Prior work suggests that morphology-aware graph policies improve learning and generalization under body perturbations. We ask whether these benefits can be strengthened by explicitly modeling higher-order mechanical structure. We represent the Unitree Go1 as a cell complex with limb- and body-level rank-2 cells and apply Hodge-based message passing. Under degradation training, the node-edge-face Hodge actor achieves the highest return on unseen actuator degradations, with higher survival and lower velocity-tracking error. These results support higher-order morphology as a useful inductive bias for whole-body compensation under actuator degradation.

摘要（中文）：作动器退化将四足运动转化为一个协调问题，要求各关节补偿丧失的驱动能力。已有研究表明，形态感知图策略在身体扰动下能够提升学习效果与泛化能力。我们探讨这些优势是否能通过显式建模高阶机械结构得到进一步增强。我们将Unitree Go1表示为带有肢体级和躯体级二阶单元的胞腔复形，并应用基于Hodge的消息传递机制。在退化训练条件下，节点-边-面Hodge智能体在未见过的作动器退化场景中取得了最高回报，表现出更高的存活率与更小的速度跟踪误差。这些结果支持高阶形态作为作动器退化下全身补偿的有效归纳偏置。

Authors: Derek You, Zafir Shamsi, Keqin Wang, Christine Allen-Blanchette

Same Action, Different Outcome: Variability in Dynamic Cloth Manipulation Manipulation

dynamic cloth manipulation variability cloth simulators robot repeatability dataset

简要说明：本文系统量化了动态布料操作在重复相同轨迹时结果的变异性，跨越多个任务、布料和速度，并表明当前布料模拟器无法重现这种变异性。

TLDR: This paper systematically quantifies the variability of dynamic cloth manipulation outcomes when repeating identical trajectories, across multiple tasks, cloths, and speeds, and shows that current cloth simulators fail to reproduce this variability.

Abstract: Although cloth is known to exhibit different outcomes under repeated fast dynamic motions, even when the same trajectory is applied, this variability has not yet been systematically characterized. Quantifying it is essential to assess the reliability of learned manipulation policies and the extent to which simulation can reproduce real-world behavior. To study this, we execute the same trajectory ten times across four dynamic tasks, two of which are novel, each tested with three cloths of very different properties and at up to three execution speeds, with a total of 269 recorded rollouts. For all of them, we record small marker positions on the cloth and synchronized stereo camera. We then formalize different metrics to quantify variability, and our results show how it is significant in every test condition, in most cases one to three orders of magnitude above the repeatability inherent to the robot and sensing noise. Our results also show variability is driven mainly by the cloth physical properties but also grows with speed. By replaying all the rollouts in four calibrated modern cloth simulators, we show that none of them can reproduce the variability magnitude we observed in real cloth, nor its ordering. Together with our analysis, we publish the dataset with synchronized OptiTrack, vision and robot logs and their corresponding simulator twins.

摘要（中文）：尽管已知布料在重复快速动态运动下会表现出不同的结果，即使施加相同的轨迹，这种变异性尚未得到系统性的表征。量化这一变异性对于评估学习到的操作策略的可靠性以及仿真在多大程度上能够再现真实世界行为至关重要。为此，我们在四项动态任务中重复执行相同轨迹各十次，其中两项为新任务，每种任务使用三种物理特性差异显著的布料，并在最多三种执行速度下进行测试，总共记录了269次 rollout。对于所有测试，我们记录了布料上的小型标记点位置，并同步使用立体相机进行拍摄。随后，我们形式化了不同的度量标准来量化变异性，结果表明，在每种测试条件下，变异性均显著，大多数情况下比机器人和传感噪声固有的可重复性高出一到三个数量级。我们的结果还显示，变异性主要由布料的物理特性驱动，但也随速度增加而增大。通过在四个校准过的现代布料模拟器中重放所有rollout，我们表明没有任何一个模拟器能够再现我们在真实布料中观察到的变异性幅度及其排序。结合我们的分析，我们发布了包含同步OptiTrack、视觉和机器人日志及其对应模拟器双胞胎的数据集。

Authors: Mahed Dadgostar, Guillem Alenyà, Júlia Borràs

RiCo: Neural Simulation of Rigid-Body Interactions via Local Contact Reasoning WorldModel

rigid-body interactions local contact reasoning contact fidelity zero-shot generalization sim-to-real transfer

简要说明：RiCo提出了一种通过局部接触表面推理来模拟刚体相互作用的神经方法，在预测物体运动方面实现了更高的准确性和接触保真度，并具有零样本泛化和初步的仿真到真实迁移能力。

TLDR: RiCo introduces a neural simulation method for rigid-body interactions that reasons over sparse local contact surfaces, achieving higher accuracy and contact fidelity in predicting object motion, with zero-shot generalization and preliminary sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: Accurate simulation of rigid-body interactions is essential for predictive physical world models. Despite recent progress in modeling object dynamics, capturing how local contacts between surfaces shape object motion remains challenging. While end-to-end world models predict interactions across entire scenes or objects, in practice, rigid-body contact is inherently local, and only nearby surfaces can directly exchange contact forces. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Rigid-body Contact Reasoning (RiCo), which represents interactions between objects through sparse neighborhoods of contact surface points. RiCo combines each point's state with the relative geometry, motion, and physical properties of nearby surfaces, then reasons across the object's points to determine how these local contacts jointly affect its motion. By confining cross-object reasoning to nearby surfaces while propagating contact information within each rigid body, RiCo retains fine-grained interaction details without the cost of modeling every pair of scene points. Such properties enable RiCo a higher accuracy and contact fidelity. Experiments on MOVi-benchmark demonstrate that RiCo reduces 100-frame position and orientation errors by 31-35% and approximately 38%, respectively, compared with baselines. Moreover, RiCo achieves high contact fidelity, with ground-truth-relative penetration-time and mean-depth differences of 11.0% and 2.22 mm, respectively. RiCo further generalizes zero-shot from small-scale training scenarios to scenes containing 270 objects. Our real-world multi-ball collision experiments further provide preliminary evidence of sim-to-real transfer.

摘要（中文）：刚体相互作用的精确模拟对于构建预测性物理世界模型至关重要。尽管近期在物体动态建模方面取得了进展，但捕捉表面间局部接触如何塑造物体运动仍然具有挑战性。虽然端到端世界模型能够预测整个场景或物体间的相互作用，但在实际中，刚体接触本质上是局部的，只有邻近的表面才能直接交换接触力。基于这一观察，我们引入了刚体接触推理（RiCo），该方法通过接触表面点的稀疏邻域来表示物体间的相互作用。RiCo将每个点的状态与邻近表面的相对几何、运动及物理属性相结合，然后对物体各点进行推理，以确定这些局部接触如何共同影响其运动。通过将跨物体推理限制在邻近表面范围内，同时在每个刚体内部传播接触信息，RiCo在保留细粒度交互细节的同时，避免了建模所有场景点对的高昂成本。这些特性使RiCo具有更高的精度和接触保真度。在MOVi基准上的实验表明，与基线方法相比，RiCo将100帧的位置误差和姿态误差分别降低了31-35%和约38%。此外，RiCo实现了高接触保真度，与真值相比，穿透时间和平均深度的差异分别为11.0%和2.22毫米。RiCo还能从小规模训练场景零样本泛化至包含270个物体的场景。我们的真实世界多球碰撞实验进一步为仿真到现实的迁移提供了初步证据。

Authors: Ruixiang Ouyang, Guanren Qiao, Fansen Meng, Yueci Deng, Ruixing Jin, Kui Jia, Guiliang Liu

A Geometric Approach to Soft Actor-Critic with Zonotopes for Locomotion Learning Locomotion

Soft Actor-Critic Zonotopes Overestimation Bias Locomotion Learning Off-policy reinforcement learning

简要说明：GeZo-SAC 使用基于 zonotope 的评论家自适应控制过估计偏差，在 MuJoCo 基准上提升运动学习效果并降低执行器能耗。

TLDR: GeZo-SAC enhances SAC with zonotope-based critics to adaptively control overestimation bias, improving locomotion learning across MuJoCo benchmarks with reduced actuator effort.

Abstract: Off-policy actor--critic methods control overestimation bias by taking the minimum of two critics. This uses the same aggregation rule everywhere, regardless of how the critics disagree. We propose \textbf{GeZo-SAC}, which uses auxiliary geometric representations to adapt critic pessimism to the state and action. Alongside its scalar value, each critic predicts a set of generators defining a zonotope. Probing this zonotope along sampled directions provides a geometric width, "subtracted from each critic value as a pessimistic offset, and a measure of disagreement between the two critics, aggregated with log-sum-exp. This disagreement controls how the critics are combined, moving from a width-weighted average toward the usual minimum as disagreement increases. At inference, the deployed policy is an unmodified SAC actor, since the generators are used only on the critic side during training.Across four MuJoCo-v5 locomotion benchmarks and six off-policy baselines, GeZo-SAC achieves the highest mean return on Ant-v5 and Hopper-v5 and remains competitive with other methods on the remaining tasks. Our analysis further shows that GeZo-SAC achieves the lowest average actuator work and action effort per metre among the evaluated methods, while maintaining near-zero measured overestimation frequency across all four environments.

摘要（中文）：离策略演员-评论家方法通过取两个评论家的最小值来控制过估计偏差。这种方法在所有情况下都使用相同的聚合规则，而不考虑评论家之间的分歧程度。我们提出\textbf{GeZo-SAC}，该方法利用辅助几何表示来使评论家的悲观程度适应状态和动作。每个评论家在预测标量值的同时，还会预测一组定义zonotope的生成器。沿采样方向探测该zonotope可获得几何宽度，该宽度作为悲观偏移量从每个评论家值中减去，同时提供两个评论家之间分歧程度的度量，并通过log-sum-exp进行聚合。该分歧程度控制评论家的组合方式，随着分歧增大，从宽度加权平均逐渐过渡到常规的最小值操作。在推理阶段，所使用的策略是未经修改的SAC演员，因为生成器仅在训练期间用于评论家一侧。在四个MuJoCo-v5运动基准和六个离策略基线的对比中，GeZo-SAC在Ant-v5和Hopper-v5上取得了最高平均回报，并在其余任务上与其他方法保持竞争力。我们的分析进一步表明，在所评估的方法中，GeZo-SAC在所有四个环境中实现了最低的平均执行器做功和每米动作力度，同时保持了接近零的实测过估计频率。
