Authors: Panagiotis Roditis, Panagiotis P. Filntisis, Petros Maragos

Lamarck's Driving School: Discovering Autonomous Driving Training Strategies through Evolutionary Competition AutonomousDriving

Lamarckian evolution training strategy discovery bilevel optimization scenario distribution autonomous driving

简要说明：本文提出了一个拉马克进化框架，通过进化竞争来发现有效的自动驾驶训练场景分布，替代基于代理的指导，并展示了显著的性能提升。

TLDR: This paper introduces a Lamarckian evolutionary framework that discovers effective autonomous driving training scenario distributions through evolutionary competition, replacing surrogate-based guidance and demonstrating significant performance improvements.

Abstract: Autonomous driving capabilities depend strongly on the distribution of scenarios encountered during training. Existing methods commonly construct or dynamically adapt training scenario distributions using surrogate criteria such as realism, difficulty, or risk. However, these predefined surrogates may misrepresent training value, leading to inefficient use of training resources. To address this limitation, we propose a Lamarckian evolutionary framework that replaces surrogate-based guidance with competition among candidate distributions. We formulate training strategy discovery as a multi-stage bilevel optimization problem and use Lamarckian evolution algorithm to approximate its solution. At the outer level, Darwinian crossover, mutation, and selection explore the scenario distribution space; at the inner level, policy learning acquires new capabilities, and Lamarckian inheritance transfers them to subsequent stages, allowing scenario distributions and policy capabilities to co-evolve. The resulting evolutionary trajectories reveal recurring stage-wise regularities among high-value distributions, characterized by capability accumulation through stage-wise challenge rotation. We further distill these regularities into a lightweight, reusable Lamarckian Training Strategy. Experiments show that, compared with the baseline, the complete framework reduces performance loss by up to 25.07%, while the lightweight strategy still achieves a 19.13% reduction. These results demonstrate that evolutionary competition can both discover effective training strategies and reveal reusable stage-wise patterns in how the value of training distributions changes with policy capability. Code is available on GitHub.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶能力在很大程度上取决于训练过程中所遇到场景的分布。现有方法通常使用诸如真实性、难度或风险等替代标准来构建或动态调整训练场景分布。然而，这些预设的替代标准可能无法准确反映训练价值，从而导致训练资源的低效利用。为解决这一局限，我们提出了一种拉马克进化框架，用候选分布之间的竞争替代基于替代标准的引导。我们将训练策略发现形式化为一个多阶段双层优化问题，并采用拉马克进化算法来近似求解。在外层，达尔文式交叉、变异和选择探索场景分布空间；在内层，策略学习获取新能力，并通过拉马克式遗传将这些能力传递至后续阶段，从而使得场景分布与策略能力协同进化。由此产生的进化轨迹揭示了高价值分布中重复出现的阶段性规律，其特征为通过阶段性挑战轮换实现能力积累。我们进一步将这些规律提炼为一种轻量级、可复用的拉马克训练策略。实验表明，与基线相比，完整框架将性能损失最多降低25.07%，而轻量级策略仍可实现19.13%的降低。这些结果表明，进化竞争既能发现有效的训练策略，也能揭示训练分布价值随策略能力变化而变化的可复用阶段性模式。代码已在GitHub上公开。

Authors: Yichun Ye, He Zhang, Ye Tian, Jian Sun

CRISP: Fixing Flying Pixels in Latent LiDAR Generation via Diffusion Decoding WorldModel

diffusion decoder LiDAR generation flying pixels world model latent adapter

简要说明：CRISP 提出了一种带有支持掩码预测器的像素空间扩散解码器，用于修复潜在 LiDAR 生成中的飞点，在多个数据集上显著降低深度误差。

TLDR: CRISP introduces a pixel-space diffusion decoder with a support mask predictor to fix flying pixels in latent LiDAR generation, reducing depth errors across multiple backbones and datasets.

Abstract: Latent LiDAR pipelines suffer from flying pixels: convolutional VAEs blur sharp radial depth discontinuities, yielding edge depths that back-project to points floating between surfaces. We identify this as a major, directly correctable decoder bottleneck and introduce CRISP: a pixel-space diffusion decoder with a backbone-agnostic latent adapter, DiT-based denoiser, and support mask predictor. CRISP replaces video-VAE and LiDAR-native decoders alike while keeping the encoder and latent generator fixed. Across KITTI-360, SemanticKITTI, and nuScenes, replacing only the decoder reduces FSVD/FPVD by 50.5% on average across frozen backbones; for generic video VAEs, the reductions reach 71%/74%. On the LiDAR-native LiDM backbone, FRID drops by 71%, with the largest gains at depth discontinuities. In a pretrained LiDM world model, the same zero-shot replacement improves FSVD by 15.5%, narrowing the sim-to-real gap.

摘要（中文）：潜在激光雷达管线存在飞像素问题：卷积VAE会模糊尖锐的径向深度不连续处，致使边缘深度反投影后在表面之间产生漂浮点。我们将此识别为可直接修正的主要解码器瓶颈，并提出CRISP：一种像素空间扩散解码器，配备与骨干网络无关的潜在适配器、基于DiT的去噪器以及支撑掩码预测器。CRISP可替代视频VAE和激光雷达原生解码器，同时保持编码器和潜在生成器不变。在KITTI-360、SemanticKITTI和nuScenes数据集上，仅更换解码器即可在冻结骨干网络上平均降低FSVD/FPVD达50.5%；对于通用视频VAE，降幅分别可达71%和74%。在激光雷达原生的LiDM骨干网络上，FRID下降71%，其中深度不连续处的改善最为显著。在预训练的LiDM世界模型中，同样的零样本替换使FSVD提升15.5%，缩小了仿真与真实之间的差距。

Authors: Andrea Ceron, Michael Schmidt, Alvaro Marcos-Ramiro, Sebastian Schmidt, Benjamin Busam

WorldGuide: Goal-Directed Video World Model for Procedural Task Execution WorldModel

procedural video generation closed-loop task execution video world model goal-directed long-horizon

简要说明：WorldGuide 提出了一种用于程序性任务执行的闭环、目标导向的视频世界模型，其中规划器根据视频进度预测下一个原子动作，执行器生成相应的片段，从而实现自适应长视距生成。它还引入了一个大型基准，并展示了优于现有视频模型的任务成功率。

TLDR: WorldGuide introduces a closed-loop, goal-directed video world model for procedural task execution, where a planner predicts the next atomic action from video progress and an executor generates the corresponding clip, enabling adaptive long-horizon generation. It also introduces a large benchmark and demonstrates improved task success over existing video models.

Abstract: Video generators and video-based world models can synthesize plausible visual trajectories, but long-horizon procedural tasks require generation to adapt to what has actually been produced. A model must determine the next action from its generated state, execute that action, and recognize when the task is complete. Open-loop generation cannot adapt to execution outcomes, while existing closed-loop systems often rely on pretrained executors or indirect verification. This leaves a gap between deciding an action and successfully realizing it. We formulate procedural video generation as \emph{closed-loop task execution in visual world space} and introduce \textbf{WorldGuide}. Given only an initial image and a task goal, WorldGuide predicts an atomic action, generates its corresponding video clip, and uses the generated result to select the next action or terminate. The Planner and Executor are trained on the same step-level procedural demonstrations: the Planner learns to predict the next atomic action or task completion from visual progress, while the Executor is directly trained to realize the predicted actions. Hierarchical visual memory maintains state across long-horizon execution with bounded history token cost. Due to the lack of step-level action-video supervision for joint planner-executor training, we introduce \textbf{WorldGuide Bench}: approximately 59K step-annotated videos across 245 tasks and 27 procedural categories. WorldGuide achieves a 33.33\% Task Success on \textbf{WorldGuide-Bench}, compared with 29.90\% for the strong recent video model MiniMax-H3, even though MiniMax-H3 receives reference action plans, and achieves 47.69\% on \textbf{VideoCraft-Bench} compared with 32.73\% for MiniMax-H3 under goal-only conditioning. These results demonstrate the importance of coupling planning with learned execution for goal-directed procedural video generation.

摘要（中文）：视频生成器和基于视频的世界模型能够合成看似合理的视觉轨迹，但长周期程序性任务要求生成过程能够适应实际已生成的内容。模型必须根据其生成的状态决定下一个动作，执行该动作，并识别任务何时完成。开环生成无法适应执行结果，而现有的闭环系统往往依赖预训练的执行器或间接验证。这导致在决策动作与成功实现该动作之间存在差距。我们将程序性视频生成形式化为\emph{视觉世界空间中的闭环任务执行}，并提出了\textbf{WorldGuide}。仅给定初始图像和任务目标，WorldGuide预测一个原子动作，生成对应的视频片段，并利用生成结果选择下一个动作或终止任务。规划器（Planner）和执行器（Executor）在同一组步骤级程序性演示上进行训练：规划器学习根据视觉进度预测下一个原子动作或任务完成状态，而执行器则被直接训练以实现所预测的动作。分层视觉记忆以有限的历史令牌成本维持长时间执行过程中的状态。由于缺乏用于联合规划器-执行器训练的步骤级动作-视频监督，我们引入了\textbf{WorldGuide Bench}：约5.9万个步骤级标注视频，涵盖245个任务和27个程序性类别。WorldGuide在\textbf{WorldGuide-Bench}上实现了33.33\%的任务成功率，而近期强视频模型MiniMax-H3（即使接收了参考动作计划）为29.90\%；在仅以目标为条件的\textbf{VideoCraft-Bench}上，WorldGuide实现了47.69\%的成功率，而MiniMax-H3为32.73\%。这些结果证明了在目标导向的程序性视频生成中，将规划与学习到的执行相耦合的重要性。

Authors: Ankan Deria, Komal Kumar, Hisham Cholakkal, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Salman Khan

WOVEN: Weaving Visual World Modeling into Multimodal LLMs WorldModel

visual transition reasoning multimodal large language models visual world modeling transfer learning benchmark

简要说明：本文提出了WOVEN，一个用于多模态大语言模型视觉转换推理的基准和训练数据集，并证明在此共享能力上的训练能提升多种下游任务的表现，表明其可作为视觉世界建模的可复用基础。

TLDR: This paper introduces WOVEN, a benchmark and training dataset for visual transition reasoning in multimodal LLMs, demonstrating that training on this shared capability improves performance across diverse downstream tasks, suggesting a reusable primitive for visual world modeling.

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) struggle with spatial, embodied, physical, and temporal reasoning. We hypothesize that these failures reflect a shared deficit in visual transition reasoning, and test whether this capability can serve as a shared training primitive, one that different models can learn from different supervision sources and reuse across different tasks, with a systematic training recipe. Existing benchmarks document these deficits separately but do not support controlled comparisons across scenes, actions, and reasoning operations. We therefore introduce WOVEN, a training source and benchmark for visual transition reasoning that organizes transition supervision by scene, action, and reasoning type, using diverse, realistic rollouts from video-pretrained generative models: 36,076 examples across 20 scene types, 5 action types, and 8 reasoning types. We first evaluate 38 frontier MLLMs (e.g., GPT-5.4 and Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B) and find a substantial and systematic deficit: even the strongest models fall far below humans, and the failures recur across model families and persist with scale. We then train MLLMs at multiple scales on WOVEN and find that they learn a shared capability that transfers broadly: training subsets of only about 2,000 items each collectively improve 22 of 26 external benchmarks by up to 27.3 percentage points, and WOVEN data can replace 30-50% of a task's own training data with comparable accuracy. Controlled comparisons further yield a training recipe for visual world modeling, validated prospectively on held-out benchmarks: select supervision by the reasoning operation it teaches rather than by the actions, scenes, or domains it shows, and prefer larger changes to the visual state for robustness. Our work establishes visual transition reasoning as a reusable foundation for systematic visual world-model training in MLLMs.

摘要（中文）：多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在空间、具身、物理及时间推理方面存在明显不足。我们假设，这些失败反映出视觉转换推理能力上的共同缺陷，并检验该能力能否作为一种共享训练原语——即不同模型可从不同监督来源中学习，并跨任务复用，同时配合一套系统化的训练方案。现有基准分别记录了这些缺陷，但无法支持跨场景、跨动作及跨推理操作的可控比较。为此，我们引入WOVEN——一个面向视觉转换推理的训练资源与基准，依据场景、动作及推理类型对转换监督进行组织，并使用基于视频预训练生成模型生成多样且逼真的轨迹数据：涵盖20种场景类型、5种动作类型及8种推理类型，共36,076个样例。我们首先评估了38个前沿MLLM（如GPT-5.4和Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B），发现其存在显著且系统性的缺陷：即使最强的模型也远低于人类水平，且该缺陷在不同模型家族中反复出现，并随规模扩大而持续存在。随后，我们在多个规模上使用WOVEN训练MLLM，发现它们习得了一种可广泛迁移的共享能力：仅约2,000个样本构成的训练子集即可在26个外部基准中的22个上带来最高27.3个百分点的提升，且WOVEN数据可替代任务自身训练数据的30%–50%，同时保持相当的准确率。可控比较进一步提炼出一套面向视觉世界建模的训练方案，并在留出基准上进行了前瞻性验证：应依据推理操作而非动作、场景或领域来选择监督数据，并倾向于选择视觉状态变化更大的样本以增强鲁棒性。本研究确立了视觉转换推理作为MLLM中系统性视觉世界模型训练的可复用基础。

Authors: Zheyu Fan, Yue Zhang, Mingkai Deng, Kangrui Wang, Qineng Wang, Canyu Chen, Jie Hao, Xing Fan, Chenlei Guo, Eric P. Xing, Mohit Bansal, Manling Li

LIVIN: Benchmarking Spatial and Embodied Intelligence in Digital Twins of Lived-In Homes Other

digital twins embodied intelligence navigation loco-manipulation 3D reconstruction

简要说明：LIVIN 提出了一个基于30个真实居住房屋数字孪生的基准，采用人在环路的重建流程，并评估3D检测、重建、导航和移动操作，以凸显真实家庭环境中的挑战。

TLDR: LIVIN introduces a benchmark with digital twins of 30 lived-in homes, featuring a human-in-the-loop reconstruction workflow and evaluating 3D detection, reconstruction, navigation, and loco-manipulation to highlight challenges in realistic household environments.

Abstract: Realistic household simulation must capture not only diverse environments but also the lived-in object arrangements and spatial constraints that shape robot motion and interaction. Existing resources often trade off scale, real-world correspondence, and interaction readiness, leaving a gap in faithful, interactive replicas of how real homes are actually arranged. To this end, we introduce LIVIN, a benchmark for spatial and embodied intelligence built on digital twins of 30 diverse lived-in homes. These replicas preserve observed room layouts, furniture configurations, and everyday belongings. To construct them, we design a human-in-the-loop workflow comprising instance recognition, architectural reconstruction, and object generation and placement, with intermediate results reviewed and corrected by humans against the source observations at each stage. We evaluate four tasks in LIVIN: 3D detection, 3D reconstruction, navigation, and loco-manipulation. Our evaluations show that current methods remain challenged by the dense object arrangements, occlusions, limited free space, and constrained interaction regions found in realistic lived-in homes. We hope LIVIN will help advance embodied AI in real-world homes, from spatial understanding to robotic interaction, and ultimately bring embodied intelligence into everyday home environments.

摘要（中文）：现实的家庭模拟不仅要捕捉多样化的环境，还必须反映实际居住空间中的物体摆放和空间约束，这些因素直接影响机器人的运动与交互。现有资源往往在规模、真实世界对应性和交互就绪性之间权衡取舍，导致在忠实、可交互地复现真实家庭布局方面仍存在空白。为此，我们提出了LIVIN，一个基于30个多样化实际居住房屋数字孪生的空间与具身智能基准。这些复刻模型保留了观测到的房间布局、家具配置和日常物品。为构建这些模型，我们设计了一套人在回路的工作流程，包括实例识别、建筑结构重建以及物体生成与摆放，并在每个阶段由人工对照源观测结果对中间结果进行审核和修正。我们在LIVIN中评估了四项任务：三维检测、三维重建、导航和移动操作。评估结果表明，现有方法在面对真实居住房屋中密集的物体排列、遮挡、有限自由空间和受限交互区域时仍面临挑战。我们希望LIVIN能够推动具身智能在真实家庭环境中的发展，从空间理解到机器人交互，最终将具身智能带入日常家居场景。

Authors: Peijun Xu, Chuansen Nie, Yiyang He, Yinuo Bai, Jingyang Liu, Kuixiang Shao, Yuyang Jiao, Kuanhao Xia, Jiayi Zhu, Zitian Yang, Yanqi Zhang, Tianye Tan, Shuwei Di, Junyi Xu, Jingyi Yu, Jiayuan Gu

Learning to Retrieve: Internalizing Memory Retrieval for Video World Models WorldModel

video world models memory retrieval long-term consistency camera-conditioned retrieval 3D re-visibility

简要说明：本文提出学习检索（L2R），通过将模型的持久内部状态用作记忆，并用相机条件检索门来内化视频世界模型中的记忆检索，无需外部记忆系统即可提高长期场景一致性。

TLDR: This paper introduces Learning-to-Retrieve (L2R), a method that internalizes memory retrieval into video world models by using the model's persistent internal state as memory and a camera-conditioned retrieval gate, improving long-term scene consistency without external memory systems.

Abstract: Video world models aim to generate explorable, 3D-consistent scene videos conditioned on camera trajectories. Existing approaches often rely on external memory systems that explicitly retrieve previously observed content to mitigate scene drift during long-horizon generation. However, these auxiliary memory pathways operate outside the model's internal generative dynamics, preventing the model from intrinsically learning when and what historical information should be retrieved. We propose to internalize memory retrieval into the generation process, allowing retrieval to emerge as an intrinsic behavior of the video world model rather than relying on an external memory system. Based on this principle, we introduce \textbf{Learning-to-Retrieve (L2R)}, which repurposes the model's persistent internal state as a memory for historical context. A camera-conditioned retrieval gate selectively accesses relevant historical information from this state, determining \textit{what to retrieve}, while a retrieval trigger determines \textit{when to retrieve}. We further supervise the trigger with a 3D re-visibility signal, activating retrieval when previously observed content re-enters the current view while otherwise preserving the existing context. Together, these components enable the model to intrinsically acquire memory retrieval behavior and incorporate relevant historical observations into generation without a separate retrieval pathway. Across multiple base models and camera-revisit benchmarks, L2R improves long-term scene consistency while eliminating the need for an external memory bank or 3D conditions. https://jkhu29.github.io/l2r

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型旨在根据相机轨迹生成可探索的、三维一致性的场景视频。现有方法通常依赖外部记忆系统，在长时程生成过程中显式检索先前观测到的内容，以缓解场景漂移问题。然而，这些辅助记忆通路运行在模型内部生成动态之外，使得模型无法内在地学习何时应检索以及应检索哪些历史信息。我们提出将记忆检索内化到生成过程中，使检索行为成为视频世界模型的内在属性，而非依赖外部记忆系统。基于这一原则，我们引入了\textbf{学习检索（L2R）}方法，将模型的持久内部状态重新用作历史上下文的记忆。一个由相机条件控制的检索门从该状态中选择性地访问相关历史信息，决定\textit{检索什么}，而一个检索触发器则决定\textit{何时检索}。我们进一步利用三维重可见性信号对触发器进行监督，当先前观测到的内容重新进入当前视野时激活检索，否则保持现有上下文不变。这些组件共同使模型能够内在地获得记忆检索行为，并将相关历史观测融入生成过程，而无需单独的检索通路。在多种基础模型和相机重访基准测试中，L2R提升了长期场景一致性，同时消除了对外部记忆库或三维条件的依赖。https://jkhu29.github.io/l2r

Authors: JiaKui Hu, Tailai Chen, Yuqi Pan, Xuerui Qiu, Jialun Liu, Xiao Cao, Zhenxin Zhu, Guang Chen, Hangjun Ye, Bing Wang, Yanye Lu

Refine Connections, Close the Gap: A Reliable Enhancement Framework for Driving Scene Topology AutonomousDriving

topology enhancement driving scene topology connectivity reasoning topology score reliability denoising-based reconstruction

简要说明：本文提出TopoEnhance，一种基于去噪的自动驾驶拓扑增强框架，可提升车道与交通元素连接的准确性，改善连续与离散可靠性指标。

TLDR: This paper proposes TopoEnhance, a denoising-based framework for autonomous driving that enhances lane-element connectivity topology prediction, improving both continuous and discrete reliability metrics across baselines.

Abstract: In autonomous driving, understanding scene topology - the connectivity between lanes and traffic elements - is critical for safe path planning and motion control. While current methods excel at detecting individual map elements, their connectivity reasoning often falls short of its theoretical potential, leaving a significant performance gap relative to the theoretical upper-bound achievable given the underlying detections. Furthermore, the decision-ready topology graphs passed to downstream tasks often remain unreliable. Current approaches typically derive connectivity by thresholding continuous topology scores; however, these scores often fail to reflect the true logical likelihood of connectivity, resulting in false positives or missing connections. Existing benchmarks further overlook this issue by primarily evaluating continuous metrics, rather than assessing the discrete connectivity required for decision-making. To bridge these gaps, we propose TopoEnhance, a novel topology enhancement framework designed to unlock the latent potential of existing methods and improve the reliability of decision-ready topology. We formulate topology enhancement as a denoising-based reconstruction process, where the model learns to recover structural consistency from stochastically corrupted ground-truth graphs. This formulation enables the model to resolve logical inconsistencies and rectify unreliable connections, producing robust discrete topology graphs that closely approach theoretical maximum performance. Extensive experiments across different baselines show that TopoEnhance consistently improves both continuous topology metrics (TOP score), and discrete connectivity measured by our adapted Topology Jaccard Similarity (TJS) metric. As a flexible, source-agnostic framework, TopoEnhance delivers substantial gains across diverse state-of-the-art baselines without requiring retraining.

摘要（中文）：在自动驾驶领域，理解场景拓扑——即车道与交通元素之间的连通关系——对于安全的路径规划和运动控制至关重要。尽管现有方法在检测单个地图元素方面表现出色，但其连通性推理能力往往未能充分发挥理论潜力，与基于现有检测结果可实现的理论上界之间存在显著性能差距。此外，传递给下游任务的决策就绪拓扑图通常仍不可靠。现有方法通常通过对连续拓扑分数设定阈值来推导连通性；然而，这些分数往往无法反映连通性的真实逻辑可能性，从而导致误报或漏连。现有基准测试进一步忽视了这一问题，主要评估连续指标，而非评估决策所需的离散连通性。为弥合这些差距，我们提出了TopoEnhance，一种新颖的拓扑增强框架，旨在释放现有方法的潜在能力并提升决策就绪拓扑的可靠性。我们将拓扑增强形式化为一种基于去噪的重建过程，其中模型学习从随机扰动的真实标注图中恢复结构一致性。该形式化使模型能够解决逻辑不一致问题并纠正不可靠的连通关系，生成接近理论最大性能的鲁棒离散拓扑图。跨不同基线的广泛实验表明，TopoEnhance在连续拓扑指标（TOP分数）以及我们改编的拓扑Jaccard相似度（TJS）指标所衡量的离散连通性方面均持续提升。作为一个灵活且与数据源无关的框架，TopoEnhance在多种最先进基线上均带来了显著增益，且无需重新训练。

Authors: Xiaoqi Wang, Dingyi Zhaung, David Paz, Wenbin He, Yucai Bai, Peng Zhou, Rui Zhang, Jinhua Zhao, Liu Ren

CausalDreamer: Learning Predictive World Models with Latent Disentanglement WorldModel

world models latent disentanglement model-predictive planning robotics Dreamer

简要说明：CausalDreamer 提出了一种方法，将冻结的 Dreamer 4 视频分词器的潜在表示分解为可控/不可控和奖励相关/奖励不相关四组，并对预训练的动态模型进行微调以预测分解后的表示，从而提升在 MMBench2 任务上的模型预测规划性能和对操纵变体的鲁棒性。

TLDR: CausalDreamer proposes a method to factor a frozen Dreamer 4 video tokenizer's latent representation into controllable/uncontrollable and reward-relevant/reward-irrelevant groups, fine-tuning the pretrained dynamics model on this factored representation to improve model-predictive planning performance on MMBench2 tasks and robustness to manipulated variants.

Abstract: World models for control must capture which aspects of the environment respond to the agent's actions and which are relevant to reward. Generative world models such as Dreamer 4 consist of a video tokenizer, which encodes each frame into a latent, and a dynamics model, which is pretrained to predict future latents from past latents and actions. Yet the tokenizer is trained with a reconstruction objective, without action or reward supervision, so its latent provides no explicit mechanism to separate controllable, uncontrollable, reward-relevant, and reward-irrelevant information. We propose \textit{CausalDreamer}, which keeps the tokenizer frozen and re-encodes its latent into a factored representation of four groups along two axes: controllability, where only the two controllable groups receive the action, and reward relevance, learned by predicting the reward from the two reward-relevant groups. The pretrained dynamics model is then fine-tuned to predict the factored representation. We evaluate \textit{CausalDreamer} and the pretrained world model it starts from with model-predictive planning on 20 MMBench2 tasks: 10 clean tasks seen during training and 10 unseen tasks, of which 6 are manipulated variants of clean tasks with a changed background, object, or maze layout, and 4 are new environments. We normalize returns so that a policy taking uniformly random actions scores 0 and an expert scores 1. \textit{CausalDreamer} achieves a 14\% higher normalized score than the pretrained world model on the clean tasks (0.199 vs.\ 0.175) and a 25\% higher score on the manipulated variants (0.307 vs.\ 0.246), while neither model scores meaningfully above the random policy in the new environments. Additionally, our analysis shows that the factored representation separates reward-irrelevant changes, such as a changed background, from its reward-relevant groups.

摘要（中文）：用于控制的世界模型必须捕捉环境的哪些方面会响应智能体的动作，以及哪些方面与奖励相关。诸如Dreamer 4之类的生成式世界模型包含一个视频分词器，它将每一帧编码为潜在表示，以及一个动力学模型，该模型经过预训练，根据过去的潜在表示和动作来预测未来的潜在表示。然而，分词器是以重建目标进行训练的，没有动作或奖励的监督，因此其潜在表示缺乏显式机制来分离可控、不可控、奖励相关和奖励无关的信息。我们提出\textit{CausalDreamer}，它保持分词器冻结，并将其潜在表示重新编码为沿两个轴分为四组的因子化表示：可控性，其中只有两个可控组接收动作；奖励相关性，通过从两个奖励相关组预测奖励来学习。然后对预训练的动力学模型进行微调，以预测因子化表示。我们在20个MMBench2任务上评估了\textit{CausalDreamer}及其所基于的预训练世界模型，采用模型预测规划方法，其中包含训练中见过的10个干净任务和10个未见过的任务，后者包括6个通过改变背景、物体或迷宫布局得到的干净任务的操纵变体，以及4个新环境。我们将回报归一化，使得采取均匀随机动作的策略得分为0，专家得分为1。\textit{CausalDreamer}在干净任务上的归一化得分比预训练世界模型高出14\%（0.199对0.175），在操纵变体上的得分高出25\%（0.307对0.246），而在新环境中两种模型的得分均未显著高于随机策略。此外，我们的分析表明，因子化表示将奖励无关的变化（如背景改变）与其奖励相关组分离。

Authors: Prince Jha, Nils Lukas, Kun Zhang, Salem Lahlou

Uncertainty-Aware Optimization for Physics-Aware Highway Trajectory Prediction AutonomousDriving

trajectory prediction uncertainty quantification conformal prediction physics-aware autonomous driving

简要说明：本文提出了X-TRACK物理感知轨迹预测框架的不确定性感知扩展，建模偶然不确定性和认知不确定性，并应用共形预测生成校准的不确定性区域，用于高速公路驾驶。

TLDR: This paper proposes uncertainty-aware extensions of the X-TRACK physics-aware trajectory prediction framework, modeling aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties and applying conformal prediction to produce calibrated uncertainty regions for highway driving.

Abstract: Accurate trajectory forecasting and well-defined predictive uncertainty are crucial for reliable, safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving. Most trajectory prediction approaches provide point estimates only, while uncertainty-aware approaches typically quantify uncertainty only in the trajectory space. In physics-aware approaches, uncertainty in the predicted motion variables should be explicitly modeled and propagated through the vehicle dynamics. Otherwise, the resulting trajectory-space uncertainty may not fully reflect the variability introduced by the underlying motion prediction. Therefore, in this work, uncertainty-aware extensions of X-TRACK (X-TRACK-DE and X-TRACK-MCD), a physics-aware trajectory prediction framework, are proposed. The proposed framework predicts future vehicle motion variables and models both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties by propagating motion space uncertainty to trajectory space. Additionally, conformal prediction is applied to the trajectory space predictive covariance to construct uncertainty regions targeting a desired marginal coverage level. Evaluation on the highD dataset shows that X-TRACK-DE improves trajectory prediction accuracy over the deterministic baseline, while both uncertainty-aware variants provide predictive uncertainty that can be conformally calibrated to the desired marginal coverage level.

摘要（中文）：准确预测轨迹和明确预测不确定性对于自动驾驶等安全攸关应用至关重要。大多数轨迹预测方法仅提供点估计，而考虑不确定性的方法通常仅在轨迹空间中量化不确定性。在物理感知方法中，预测运动变量的不确定性应被显式建模并经由车辆动力学传播。否则，所得轨迹空间不确定性可能无法完全反映底层运动预测引入的变异性。因此，本文提出X-TRACK（一种物理感知轨迹预测框架）的不确定性感知扩展版本（X-TRACK-DE和X-TRACK-MCD）。所提框架预测未来车辆运动变量，并通过将运动空间不确定性传播至轨迹空间来同时建模偶然不确定性和认知不确定性。此外，将保形预测应用于轨迹空间预测协方差，以构建针对期望边际覆盖水平的不确定性区域。在highD数据集上的评估表明，X-TRACK-DE相比确定性基线提升了轨迹预测精度，而两种不确定性感知变体提供的预测不确定性可经保形校准达到期望的边际覆盖水平。

Authors: Aanchal Rajesh Chugh, Sebastian Dorn

Real-Time Motion Planning with Dynamic Hazards: Classical vs. Learning-Based Methods RLRobot

real-time motion planning dynamic hazards classical planning PPO stochastic dynamics

简要说明：该论文构建了一个统一基准，比较经典规划器与基于PPO的学习策略在动态危险场中的实时运动规划，发现随机障碍动态使学习方法的优势凸显。

TLDR: This paper presents a unified benchmark comparing classical planners and PPO-based learning policies for real-time motion planning in dynamic hazard fields, finding that stochastic obstacle dynamics shift the advantage to learning-based methods.

Abstract: We study real-time motion planning in dynamic hazard fields through a controlled comparison between classical planning and learning-based methods. Rather than introducing a new planner, we construct a unified benchmark in which representative classical and learning-based methods face the same environments, motion constraints, information assumptions, and evaluation metrics. The test environment consists of planar domains populated with rotating sprinkler-like hazards that generate time-varying forbidden regions via sweeping angular sectors. Our results show a clear regime shift. In deterministic environments, classical planners achieve near-perfect success and higher-quality paths, though sometimes at the cost of substantial planning or replanning time. Under stochastic obstacle dynamics, however, online search becomes strongly budget-sensitive: low budgets lead to frequent failure, while high budgets improve success at the cost of latency and longer trajectories. PPO-based policies, trained under the same scenario distribution, consistently outperform in latency, success rate, and path quality in these stochastic regimes. Overall, the results indicate that uncertainty in obstacle evolution, more than partial observability, is the dominant factor determining which planning paradigm is practically effective for the problem at hand.

摘要（中文）：我们通过对经典规划方法与基于学习的方法进行受控比较，研究了动态危险场中的实时运动规划问题。本文并非提出新的规划器，而是构建了一个统一的基准测试平台，使具有代表性的经典方法与学习方法面对相同的环境、运动约束、信息假设和评价指标。测试环境由含有旋转式喷头类危险源的平面区域构成，这些危险源通过扫掠角度扇形产生随时间变化的禁行区域。结果表明存在明显的范式转换：在确定性环境中，经典规划器能够实现接近完美的成功率和更高质量的路径，尽管有时需要付出可观的规划或重规划时间。然而，在随机障碍动态条件下，在线搜索对预算高度敏感：低预算导致频繁失败，而高预算虽能提升成功率，却以延迟增大和轨迹变长为代价。在相同的场景分布下训练的基于PPO的策略，在随机环境中持续在延迟、成功率和路径质量方面表现更优。总体而言，研究结果表明，障碍演化的不确定性（而非部分可观测性）才是决定哪种规划范式对当前问题实际有效的关键因素。

Authors: Eran Iceland, Alexander Tuisov, Oren Gal, Ariel Barel, Alfred M. Bruckstein

From Language to Motion: Task-Conditioned Focal-Stack Trajectory Integration for Microscopic Robots Manipulation

Task-Conditioned Trajectory Integration Focal-Stack Open-Vocabulary Perception Microscopic Robots Confidence Weighting

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于微型机器人的语义到物理框架，将任务语言映射为几何算子，利用冻结的开放词汇感知，并通过置信度加权整合焦平面轨迹，从而在不同语言、几何和聚焦条件下提高任务执行准确性和效率。

TLDR: The paper introduces a semantic-to-physical framework for microscopic robots that maps task language to geometric operators, uses frozen open-vocabulary perception, and integrates focal-plane trajectories via confidence weighting to improve task execution accuracy and efficiency under varying language, geometry, and focus conditions.

Abstract: Microscopic robots require accurate task geometry despite changes in language, parts, and focus. We present a semantic-to-physical framework that maps instructions to constrained geometric operators, reuses frozen open-vocabulary perception, and integrates locally reliable focal-plane trajectories by confidence weighting and dynamic programming. Calibrated multi-view geometry connects 2-D paths to physical execution. Prompt, unseen-part, and geometry reconfiguration tests yield 6.30-6.59-pixel RMSE. Relative to part-specific U-Net training with 20-100 labels, the proposed zero-new-label configuration takes 15 rather than 72-165 min. Across nine part-illumination conditions, trajectory-space integration reduces RMSE from 14.41 to 6.28 pixels (56.4%) and P95 error from 20.07 to 8.13 pixels (59.5%) compared with image-first multi-focus fusion. An ablation isolates the roles of confidence and path-wise selection. In representative robot experiments, target-region coverage improves from 83.5% to 92.9%. Dispensing provides a measurable physical trace, not a task-specific limitation of the method.

摘要（中文）：微型机器人需要在语言、部件及焦点变化的情况下仍能保持任务几何的准确性。我们提出了一种从语义到物理的框架，该框架将指令映射到受约束的几何算子，复用冻结的开放词汇感知，并通过置信度加权与动态规划整合局部可靠的焦平面轨迹。校准后的多视图几何将二维路径与物理执行相连接。提示、未见部件及几何重配置测试得到的均方根误差为6.30至6.59像素。相对于使用20至100个标签的部件特定U-Net训练，所提出的零新标签配置仅需15分钟，而非72至165分钟。在九种部件照明条件下，与图像优先的多焦点融合相比，轨迹空间整合将均方根误差从14.41像素降至6.28像素（降低56.4%），P95误差从20.07像素降至8.13像素（降低59.5%）。消融实验单独验证了置信度与路径选择的作用。在具有代表性的机器人实验中，目标区域覆盖率从83.5%提升至92.9%。点胶操作提供了可测量的物理痕迹，而非方法在特定任务上的局限性。

Authors: Junjie Xie, Chuxuan He, Junkai Huang, Heng Zhang, Angen Ye, Yujia Song, Yuqing Li, Pengsong Zhang, Dapeng Zhang

Sim-to-Real RL for ASVs using SysID Other

sim-to-real reinforcement learning autonomous surface vehicles system identification zero-shot transfer

简要说明：本文提出了一个用于自主水面航行器(ASV)的模拟器和训练流程，仅利用CAD模型和少量实地轨迹即可训练强化学习策略，并在BlueBoat上实现了路径跟踪和定位任务的零样本仿真到现实迁移。

TLDR: This paper presents a simulator and pipeline for training RL policies for Autonomous Surface Vehicles (ASVs) directly from CAD models and a few field trajectories, demonstrating zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on a BlueBoat for path following and station keeping.

Abstract: Autonomous Surface Vehicles (ASVs) operating in dynamic marine environments require robust control policies for tasks such as path following and station keeping, making reinforcement learning (RL) a promising alternative to classical controllers. However, existing ASV simulators rarely support parallel environments for RL training. Such existing simulators require accurate hydrodynamic modeling from computational fluid dynamics solvers or towing tank tests for setting hydrodynamic parameters to address the sim-to-real gap. To address these challenges, we present an ASV simulator and accompanying pipeline that enables training policies starting from unknown vehicle dynamics. Our framework uses only a CAD model and brief set of open-water field trajectories for approximating and refining both hydrodynamic and thruster parameters. Real-world deployments on a BlueBoat ASV demonstrate successful zero-shot sim-to-real transfer in path following and station-keeping tasks without prior hydrodynamic and propeller information.

摘要（中文）：自主水面艇（ASVs）在动态海洋环境中执行路径跟踪和定点保持等任务时，需要鲁棒的控制策略，这使得强化学习（RL）成为传统控制器的有前景的替代方案。然而，现有的ASV模拟器很少支持用于RL训练的并行环境。此类现有模拟器需要借助计算流体力学求解器或拖曳水池试验进行精确的水动力建模，以设定水动力参数，从而解决模拟到现实之间的差距。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种ASV模拟器及配套流程，支持从未知的艇体动力学出发训练策略。我们的框架仅利用CAD模型和一组简短的开放水域实测轨迹，即可近似并优化水动力和推进器参数。在BlueBoat ASV上的实际部署表明，在无需预先获取水动力和螺旋桨信息的情况下，该方法在路径跟踪和定点保持任务中实现了零样本模拟到现实的成功迁移。

Authors: Cody Sheltraw, Tsimafei Lazouski, Maani Ghaffari, Alan Papalia

Learning Which Correspondences to Trust: Confidence-Weighted Event-Camera Localization in LiDAR Maps Perception3D

event camera LiDAR localization confidence-weighted differentiable PnP pose estimation

简要说明：本文提出CELL，一种在LiDAR地图中基于置信度加权的事件相机定位方法，通过可微概率PnP端到端学习每个对应点的置信度，在M3ED和DSEC上提高了位姿精度。

TLDR: This paper introduces CELL, a confidence-weighted event-camera localization method in LiDAR maps that learns per-correspondence confidence end-to-end through a differentiable probabilistic PnP, improving pose accuracy on M3ED and DSEC.

Abstract: Localizing an event camera against a pre-built LiDAR map can be cast as dense optical-flow estimation between a rendered depth view and an event image, followed by a Perspective-n-Point (PnP) solver over the induced 3D-2D correspondences. Existing pipelines rely on geometric consensus during pose estimation, but do not explicitly model the reliability or pose informativeness, i.e., how strongly a correspondence constrains the camera pose, of individual correspondences. We show that the natural way to learn it -- using the per-correspondence error to constrain the learning of confidence -- suffers from a depth-dependent bias: small pixel errors reside predominantly at large depths and do not lead to high pose informativeness. Instead, in our method (CELL), we learn a per-correspondence confidence end-to-end through the pose, using a differentiable probabilistic PnP whose log-partition term encourages weight configurations that yield a better-constrained pose distribution. The learned confidence is used in three ways: (i) it reweights the flow supervision in a decoupled training scheme that keeps pose gradients out of the flow/edge backbone; (ii) it drives a probabilistic correspondence selection at test time; and (iii) together with the network's edge-probability it weights a final edge-matching refinement. We further design a partial-completion depth representation that adds signal without hallucinating across large gaps. On M3ED and DSEC our full system improves over the LEAR baseline on the majority of the evaluated sequences: it reduces the median translation error by up to 26.9% and the median rotation error by up to 15.8%.

摘要（中文）：将事件相机相对于预构建的LiDAR地图进行定位，可转化为渲染深度视图与事件图像之间的密集光流估计，随后通过由诱导的3D-2D对应点驱动的透视n点（PnP）求解器进行处理。现有流程在姿态估计中依赖几何一致性，但未显式建模各对应点的可靠性或姿态信息量，即对应点对相机姿态的约束强度。我们证明，自然的學習方式——利用每个对应点的误差来约束置信度的学习——存在深度相关偏差：小像素误差主要出现在大深度处，且不会带来高姿态信息量。相反，在我们的方法（CELL）中，我们通过姿态端到端地学习每个对应点的置信度，使用可微分的概率PnP，其对数配分项鼓励产生更优约束姿态分布的权重配置。学习到的置信度以三种方式使用：（i）在解耦训练方案中重新加权光流监督，使姿态梯度不进入光流/边缘主干网络；（ii）在测试时驱动概率性对应点选择；（iii）与网络的边缘概率共同加权最终边缘匹配精化步骤。我们还设计了一种部分补全深度表示，在不跨越较大间隙产生幻觉的情况下增加信号。在M3ED和DSEC数据集上，我们的完整系统在大多数评估序列上优于LEAR基线：中位平移误差最多降低26.9%，中位旋转误差最多降低15.8%。

Authors: Panagiotis Kiousis, Kuangyi Chen, Jun Zhang, Friedrich Fraundorfer

STAG: A Sparse Traversability-Aware Graph Representation from Grid-Based Costmaps for Robotic Navigation Other

sparse graph traversability costmap global planning robotic navigation

简要说明：STAG将稠密栅格成本图转换为稀疏的可通行性感知图，用于高效全局机器人导航，在保持合理路径质量的同时减少规划时间和内存。

TLDR: STAG converts dense grid-based costmaps into a sparse traversability-aware graph for efficient global robot navigation, reducing planning time and memory while maintaining reasonable path quality.

Abstract: Autonomous rovers navigating large unstructured environments need efficient global planning that accounts for terrain traversability. However, searching dense grid-based costmaps becomes computationally expensive as the mapped area grows. We introduce STAG, a Sparse Traversability-Aware Graph that converts costmaps into compact graphs. STAG combines a medial-axis topological backbone, representative nodes for homogeneous traversability regions, and transition nodes near strong traversability gradients. Edges encode geometry and traversability to account for path length and terrain difficulty. We compare A* on STAG and dense grids using synthetic cave maps, mine maps and the DARPA CERBERUS dataset. Across five benchmark categories comprising 203 map instances and 101,200 queries, STAG reduces median planning time by 3.4x to 9.9x and peak query memory by 2.1x to 15.4x, with median relative path-length differences of -2.9% and +7.6%. STAG offers a compact representation for global planning, trading dense-grid traversability optimality for faster, less memory-intensive search.

摘要（中文）：自主导航机器人在大型非结构化环境中作业时，需要一种能够考虑地形可通过性的高效全局规划方法。然而，随着地图面积的增大，在密集栅格代价地图上进行搜索的计算成本也随之显著上升。为此，我们提出STAG（稀疏可通过性感知图），一种将代价地图转换为紧凑图结构的方法。STAG融合了中轴拓扑骨干、同质可通过性区域的代表性节点，以及强可通过性梯度附近的过渡节点。边编码了几何信息和可通过性，以综合反映路径长度与地形难度。我们分别在合成洞穴地图、矿山地图以及DARPA CERBERUS数据集上，比较了A*算法在STAG和密集栅格上的表现。在涵盖203个地图实例、101,200次查询的五类基准测试中，STAG将中位规划时间降低了3.4倍至9.9倍，峰值查询内存减少了2.1倍至15.4倍，其中位相对路径长度差异分别为-2.9%和+7.6%。STAG为全局规划提供了一种紧凑的表示方式，以牺牲密集栅格的可通过性最优性为代价，换取更快、更节省内存的搜索过程。

Authors: Gabriel Manuel Garcia, Stéphanie Aravecchia, Miguel Angel Olivares-Mendez

Autonomous thermodynamic cycles via robotic mobility and sensing Locomotion

thermodynamic cycles robotic mobility spatial thermal gradients energy harvesting navigation strategy

简要说明：本文介绍了利用机器人移动性和感知能力在空间温度梯度中进行自主热力学循环的概念，并通过多稳态充气胶囊实验验证，同时优化了平衡运动成本与能量采集的移动路径。

TLDR: This paper introduces autonomous thermodynamic cycles that leverage robotic mobility and sensing to navigate spatial thermal gradients, experimentally realized with multistable gas-filled capsules and optimized via locomotion paths that balance motion cost and energy harvesting.

Abstract: Thermodynamic cycles are the foundation of energy conversion across natural and engineered systems, transforming heat into useful work. However, these cycles traditionally operate between fixed thermal reservoirs, restricting them to specific locations and temperature differences. Here, we introduce autonomous thermodynamic cycles enabled by robotic mobility and sensing, allowing robots to perform thermodynamic cycles by accessing spatially varying temperature fields. We experimentally realize this concept using multistable gas-filled capsules that circulate within the system across a thermal gradient. Our model reveals that rapid transitions in the capsules' energy states allow the system to operate as a mobile heat engine that harvests and stores energy. By linking the capsule-scale internal energy dynamics to the robot's large-scale navigation strategy, we optimize locomotion paths that balance motion cost and energy harvesting. These findings demonstrate that thermodynamic cycles can emerge when autonomous systems navigate their environments, offering an artificial analog of organisms that forage for energy across spatial resources.

摘要（中文）：热力学循环是自然与工程系统中能量转换的基础，将热能转化为有用的功。然而，这些循环传统上在固定的热库之间运行，使其局限于特定位置和温差条件。在此，我们提出由机器人移动性和感知能力驱动的自主热力学循环，使机器人能够通过访问空间变化的温度场来执行热力学循环。我们利用在系统内跨热梯度循环的多稳态充气胶囊，在实验中实现了这一概念。我们的模型揭示，胶囊能量状态的快速转变使系统能够作为移动热机运行，从而获取并存储能量。通过将胶囊尺度的内能动力学与机器人的大规模导航策略相耦合，我们优化了兼顾运动成本与能量采集的移动路径。这些发现表明，当自主系统在其环境中导航时，热力学循环可以自然涌现，为生物体跨空间资源觅食能量提供了一种人工类比。

Authors: Sofia Kuperman, Ezra Ben-Abu, Yaron Veksler, Anna Zigelman, Sefi Givli, Amir D. Gat

Neural Networks for Temporal Pattern Recognition and Dynamic Arm Gesture Speed Estimation for Robot Control Other

temporal pattern recognition gesture speed estimation skeletal keypoints recurrent networks robot control

简要说明：本文在时间模式识别任务上对神经网络架构进行基准测试，并将最优模型应用于从骨骼关键点估计动态手臂手势速度，以实现机器人控制，取得了较低的误差。

TLDR: This paper benchmarks neural network architectures on temporal pattern recognition tasks and applies top models to estimate dynamic arm gesture speed from skeletal keypoints for robot control, achieving low error rates.

Abstract: Deploying intelligent robotic systems that interact with humans through gestures requires neural networks capable of recognizing diverse temporal patterns. We present a systematic benchmark of ten abstract sequential tasks--five permutation-invariant (set) and five order-dependent (sequence) problems--evaluated across eighteen neural network architectures spanning recurrent, convolutional, attention-based, and set-function families. Beyond the core architecture-task grid, we explore numerous preprocessing and target-variable transformations, yielding more than 250 distinct experimental configurations. All variants are trained and tested under strictly identical conditions (fixed random seeds, shared hyperparameters, shared data splits) to ensure fair and reproducible comparison. Ranking across all ten tasks reveals four consistently top-performing architectures--BiGRU, TCN, Conv1D, and GRUReLU--all compact enough for real-time deployment (under 2,000 parameters in the benchmark setting). Based on this ranking, we apply three architecturally diverse top models (BiGRU, TCN, and GRUReLU) to a practical robotics problem: estimating the execution speed of dynamic arm gestures from skeletal keypoint sequences. Three speed interpretations (peak count, period time, and mean spike spacing) are evaluated on a custom dataset of eight traffic-related gesture classes comprising 256,710 frames recorded via OpenPose. The best configuration achieves a mean absolute error of 0.198 on the peak-count interpretation, corresponding to roughly 5% relative error, while the period-time interpretation reaches approximately 4% relative error, and the mean spike spacing interpretation approximately 8% relative error. These results demonstrate that neural networks can reliably estimate gesture speed from skeletal data, opening a path toward speed-aware gesture-controlled robotic systems.

摘要（中文）：部署能够通过手势与人类交互的智能机器人系统，需要能够识别多样化时间模式的神经网络。我们提出了一个系统化的基准测试，涵盖十个抽象序列任务——五个置换不变（集合）问题和五个顺序依赖（序列）问题——并在跨越循环、卷积、注意力机制和集合函数家族的十八种神经网络架构上进行评估。在核心架构-任务矩阵之外，我们还探索了多种预处理和目标变量变换，共产生超过250种不同的实验配置。所有变体均在严格相同的条件下（固定随机种子、共享超参数、共享数据划分）进行训练和测试，以确保公平且可复现的比较。对全部十个任务的排名显示了四个持续表现最佳的架构——BiGRU、TCN、Conv1D和GRUReLU——所有这些架构都足够紧凑，适合实时部署（在基准设置中参数少于2,000个）。基于这一排名，我们将三种架构各异的顶级模型（BiGRU、TCN和GRUReLU）应用于一个实际机器人问题：从骨骼关键点序列估计动态手臂手势的执行速度。在包含通过OpenPose记录的256,710帧、涵盖八个交通相关手势类别的自定义数据集上，评估了三种速度解释方法（峰值计数、周期时间和平均尖峰间距）。最佳配置在峰值计数解释上实现了0.198的平均绝对误差，对应约5%的相对误差；周期时间解释达到约4%的相对误差；平均尖峰间距解释约为8%的相对误差。这些结果表明，神经网络能够可靠地从骨骼数据估计手势速度，为朝向速度感知的手势控制机器人系统开辟了道路。

Authors: Milán Zsolt Bagladi, László Gulyás

A Reconfigurable Fabric Based Pneumatic Actuator with Button Fastened Constraint Modules for Multi Mode Actuation Manipulation

soft pneumatic actuator reconfigurable constraint fabric-based soft robot tactile sensor multi-mode actuation

简要说明：本文提出一种基于织物的可重构气动执行器，通过按扣固定的约束模块实现多种驱动模式（膨胀、收缩、弯曲、扭转）的快速切换，并集成可附着电容式触觉传感器，展示了多执行器软体机械臂在抓取中的原位运动重构。

TLDR: This paper presents a reconfigurable fabric-based pneumatic actuator that uses button-fastened constraint modules to switch between multiple actuation modes (expansion, contraction, bending, twisting) without redesign, and integrates attachable capacitive tactile sensors, demonstrating multi-actuator soft robotic arms for in situ motion reconfiguration in grasping.

Abstract: Soft pneumatic actuators are widely used in soft robotics. However, their actuation modes are typically fixed by internal chamber designs or reinforcements, making post fabrication reconfiguration difficult. This paper presents a reconfigurable fabric-based pneumatic actuator that enables rapid, tool free, and reusable switching among multiple actuation modes by attaching constraint fabric modules to a buttoned textile sleeve. By rearranging low-stretch constraint parts on a single actuator body, the proposed system realizes four actuation modes isotropic expansion, contraction, bending, and twisting without redesigning or disassembling the actuator.We further introduce an attachable capacitive fabric-based tactile sensor module that can be mounted at arbitrary locations on the actuator surface for task dependent contact sensing. Experiments demonstrated an elongation ratio of 1.2, a maximum bending angle of approximately 60 degrees, and a twisting angle of approximately 90 degrees at 24 kPa, while achieving blocking forces exceeding 10 N across all modes. The tactile sensor exhibited a monotonic, force-dependent increase in capacitance with low hysteresis (approximately 12%) and stable cyclic responses under preload. Finally, we constructed soft robotic arms composed of multiple actuators and demonstrated in situ motion reconfiguration for grasping by changing the attached constraint patterns. These results indicate that the proposed modular constraint and sensing framework improves the functional adaptability of fabric-based soft robots while preserving a simple, robust actuator structure.

摘要（中文）：软体气动执行器广泛应用于软体机器人领域。然而，其驱动模式通常由内部腔体设计或增强结构固定，导致制造后难以重新配置。本文提出了一种可重构的织物基气动执行器，通过将约束织物模块连接至带纽扣的纺织套管上，可实现多种驱动模式之间快速、免工具且可重复的切换。通过在单一执行器本体上重新布置低拉伸约束部件，所提出的系统实现了四种驱动模式——各向同性膨胀、收缩、弯曲和扭转——而无需重新设计或拆卸执行器。我们进一步引入了一种可附加的电容式织物触觉传感模块，该模块可安装在执行器表面的任意位置，用于任务相关的接触感知。实验表明，在24 kPa压力下，伸长率可达1.2，最大弯曲角约为60度，扭转角约为90度，同时所有模式下的阻断力均超过10 N。触觉传感器表现出随力单调增大的电容响应，迟滞较低（约12%），且在预载条件下具有稳定的循环响应。最后，我们构建了由多个执行器组成的软体机械臂，并演示了通过改变附加约束模式实现抓取过程中的原位运动重构。上述结果表明，所提出的模块化约束与传感框架提高了织物基软体机器人的功能适应性，同时保持了简单、稳健的执行器结构。

Authors: Kentaro Kimura, Hiroki Ishizuka, Yusuke Sakaue, Sei Ikeda, Osamu Oshiro

Skill-SLM: Agent Skill-driven Small Language Models for Reliable Robot Operation Other

small language models task decomposition skill orchestration context-free grammar robot operation

简要说明：Skill-SLM 将基于小语言模型的机器人操作重新定义为任务分解与技能组合问题，利用技能感知的上下文无关文法和 LLM 教师合成训练数据，在无人机和地面车辆上实现可靠操作。

TLDR: Skill-SLM reformulates SLM-driven robot operation as task-decomposition and skill-composition, using a skill-aware CFG and LLM teachers to synthesize training data, enabling reliable operation on UAVs and ground vehicles.

Abstract: Small language models (SLMs) have been increasingly adopted for onboard robot operation because they enable intelligent decision-making. However, existing approaches are mainly distillation-oriented and rely on enumerating representative task-solution pairs. This makes dataset construction difficult and limits generalization to diverse robot tasks whose possible forms grow rapidly. This paper proposes Skill-SLM, a framework that reformulates SLM-driven robot operation as a task-decomposition and skill-composition problem. Given a natural language task instruction, Skill-SLM decomposes the task into subtasks, selects appropriate skills from the skill library, and orchestrates the selected skills into executable robot operations. First, to support the skill-driven workflow, we propose a novel robot operational skill aware context-free grammar (CFG) to extract the skills required to accomplish tasks and build the skill library accordingly. Then, we configure LLM teachers to induce and synthesize training datasets for the SLMs, enabling SLMs to decompose tasks and orchestrate skills reliably. Additionally, we employ a progressive skill orchestration strategy to improve the reliability of skill implementation and overall robot operation. Experiments on UAV operation tasks indicate that Skill-SLM substantially outperforms distillation-oriented baselines, especially on unseen tasks that require generalization of capabilities. Additional experiments on ground vehicle tasks further demonstrate that Skill-SLM can be applied to different robot platforms.

摘要（中文）：小型语言模型（SLMs）因能实现智能决策，在机载机器人操作中的应用日趋广泛。然而，现有方法主要偏向蒸馏导向，依赖枚举代表性任务-解决方案对，这导致数据集构建困难，并限制了其对多种机器人任务的泛化能力，因为这些任务的可能形式正迅速增长。本文提出Skill-SLM框架，将SLM驱动的机器人操作重塑为任务分解与技能组合问题。给定一条自然语言任务指令，Skill-SLM将任务分解为子任务，从技能库中选取适当技能，并将所选技能编排为可执行的机器人操作。首先，为支撑技能驱动的工作流程，我们提出一种新颖的机器人操作技能感知上下文无关文法（CFG），用于提取完成任务所需的技能并据此构建技能库。随后，我们配置LLM教师模型来诱导并合成SLM的训练数据集，使SLM能够可靠地分解任务并编排技能。此外，我们采用渐进式技能编排策略以提升技能实施及整体机器人操作的可靠性。在无人机操作任务上的实验表明，Skill-SLM显著优于蒸馏导向的基线方法，尤其在需要能力泛化的未见任务上表现突出。地面车辆任务上的附加实验进一步证明了Skill-SLM可应用于不同机器人平台。

Authors: Wenhao Wang, Yanyan Li, Jiawei Yuan

DVD: Dynamic Vector Decoding for Efficient MLLM-based Perception Perception3D

MLLM perception 3D 2D efficient decoding

简要说明：DVD提出了一种动态向量解码方法，将2D和3D感知任务的表征统一为紧凑的1D token序列，在减少token开销和延迟的同时，在RefCOCO、KITTI和nuScenes等基准上提升了性能。

TLDR: DVD introduces a dynamic vector decoding method that unifies 2D and 3D perception task representations into compact 1D token sequences for MLLMs, reducing token overhead and latency while improving performance across benchmarks like RefCOCO, KITTI, and nuScenes.

Abstract: Multimodal large language models have made remarkable progress in bridging vision and language, facilitating various perception tasks essential for human-machine interaction, robotics, and autonomous driving. However, existing MLLM-based perception methods predominantly rely on text-based coordinate representation, which suffers from excessive token overhead, or fixed-range quantization, which suffers from range and precision constraints, especially for 3D domains with unbounded spatial range and high localization accuracy requirements. To address these challenges, we propose a dynamic vector decoding method named DVD, which unifies the representation of 2D and 3D perception tasks. Specifically, we first transform diverse perceptual representation (i.e., 2D bounding boxes, 2D masks, and 3D bounding boxes) into 1D vector sequences, which are then mapped to compact discrete tokens in the high-dimensional space. Then, a lightweight de-tokenizer enables seamless integration with MLLMs by decoding output tokens back to original 2D and 3D perceptual representations. Extensive experiments on 2D and 3D perception benchmarks including RefCOCO series, SUN-RGBD, KITTI, Hypersim, nuScenes demonstrate that DVD achieves superior performance in 2D and 3D tasks and reduces significantly the token overhead and inference latency. DVD provides an efficient and general framework for integrating perception capabilities into MLLMs, overcoming the inherent limitations of existing methods.

摘要（中文）：多模态大语言模型在连接视觉与语言方面取得了显著进展，推动了人机交互、机器人和自动驾驶等关键感知任务的发展。然而，现有的基于MLLM的感知方法主要依赖基于文本的坐标表示，这种方法存在过多的令牌开销问题，或采用固定范围量化，该方法在空间范围无界且定位精度要求高的三维领域面临范围和精度限制。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种名为DVD的动态向量解码方法，该方法统一了2D和3D感知任务的表示。具体而言，我们首先将多样化的感知表示（即2D边界框、2D掩码和3D边界框）转换为1D向量序列，然后将其映射到高维空间中的紧凑离散令牌。随后，一个轻量级的解码器通过将输出令牌解码回原始的2D和3D感知表示，实现与MLLM的无缝集成。在包括RefCOCO系列、SUN-RGBD、KITTI、Hypersim和nuScenes在内的2D和3D感知基准上的大量实验表明，DVD在2D和3D任务中均取得了优越的性能，并显著降低了令牌开销和推理延迟。DVD为将感知能力集成到MLLM中提供了一种高效且通用的框架，克服了现有方法的固有局限性。

Authors: Jinghua Hou, Zhe Liu, Hengshuang Zhao

What 30,000 Hours of Ego-centric Video Does Not Teach WorldModel

world models egocentric video object fidelity agent modeling humanoid modeling

简要说明：本文分析了扩展第一人称人类视频数据对世界模型的影响，发现在规模扩大时智能体建模显著提升，但物体动态建模滞后，并提出了一种监督方案来部分弥合这一差距。

TLDR: This paper analyzes the impact of scaling egocentric human video data for world models, finding that agent modeling improves dramatically but object dynamics lag behind, and introduces a supervision scheme to partially close this gap.

Abstract: World models offer a promising alternative to physics-based simulators, yet remain far from practical deployment. We ask how far scaling ego-centric human video takes them, using a dataset of 30,000 hours spanning over 1,000 scene types and 14,000 contributors. Rather than relying on opaque downstream metrics, we directly evaluate agent and object-interaction fidelity on a challenging out-of-distribution benchmark. Increasing training data by 100x improves both, but unevenly: the agent is modeled well, while object fidelity remains far lower and improves slowly. We show that the agent gains need not come from data, and a careful visual conditioning design saturates fidelity with a fraction of it, which lets us measure object fidelity on its own and discover its saturation point. We then introduce a supervision scheme that shifts capacity from scene appearance toward object dynamics, improving object fidelity though a substantial gap remains. Finally, our conclusions transfer to downstream humanoid modeling. Overall, our results suggest that scaling ego-centric data brings agent modeling close to its limit while leaving its effects on the world far behind, and that closing this gap will depend on how models are trained, not only on how much data they see.

摘要（中文）：世界模型为基于物理的模拟器提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但仍远未达到实际部署的水平。我们探究了扩展以自我为中心的人类视频数据能在多大程度上推动其发展，所使用的数据集包含3万小时、涵盖超过1000种场景类型和14000名贡献者。我们不在依赖不透明的下游指标，而是直接在一个具有挑战性的分布外基准上评估智能体与物体交互的保真度。将训练数据增加100倍能同时改善这两方面，但改善并不均衡：智能体被建模得很好，而物体保真度仍远为逊色，且提升缓慢。我们发现，智能体的增益未必来源于数据，精心设计的视觉条件控制只需使用其中一小部分数据即可使保真度饱和，这使我们得以单独衡量物体保真度并发现其饱和点。随后，我们引入了一种监督方案，将模型容量从场景外观转向物体动态，从而提升了物体保真度，尽管仍有显著差距。最后，我们的结论可迁移至下游的人形建模。总体而言，我们的结果表明，扩展以自我为中心的数据能使智能体建模接近其极限，但其对世界的影响却远远落后，而弥合这一差距将取决于模型的训练方式，而不仅仅是它们所观测的数据量。

Authors: Jiahua Dong, Anurag Bagchi, Yash Jangir, Muhammad Zubair Irshad, Sergey Zakharov, Martial Hebert, Homanga Bharadhwaj, Yu-Xiong Wang, Vitor Campagnolo Guizilini, Pavel Tokmakov

WorldCast: Distributed Multiplayer World Models WorldModel

distributed world model multiplayer generation state model video generation real-time scalability

简要说明：WorldCast 提出了一种分布式多人世界模型，每个玩家运行本地视频生成器和状态模型，仅交换状态信息，以实现可扩展、实时且一致的多视图世界生成。

TLDR: WorldCast presents a distributed multiplayer world model where each player runs a local video generator and state model, exchanging only state information to achieve scalable, real-time, and consistent multi-view world generation for gaming environments.

Abstract: Multiplayer world models must generate independently controlled views with consistent representations of both players and their shared environment. Most existing approaches coordinate multiple players through joint multi-view generation, whose cost grows with each additional player. We present WorldCast, a distributed multiplayer world model in which each player runs a local client comprising a video generator and a state model. Using recorded player positions and map geometry during training, the state model estimates the player's position from generated video and control inputs. Clients exchange player states and project them into camera-aligned player state fields that guide where and how other players are rendered. Shared scene state enables clients to reuse one another's generated observations to maintain consistent scene appearance across views. Experiments on Counter-Strike 2 demonstrate WorldCast's consistency, real-time performance, and distributed scalability. The camera-aligned player state field improves player rendering rates by over an order of magnitude over joint-generation methods, while shared scene state improves visual consistency over whole rounds. Each client runs in real time and exchanges only player and scene states, enabling scalable multiplayer generation without a centralized computational bottleneck. Image quality remains stable over hour-long rollouts.

摘要（中文）：多人世界模型必须生成独立控制的视图，同时保持对玩家及其共享环境的一致表征。现有方法大多通过联合多视图生成来协调多个玩家，其成本随玩家数量增加而增长。我们提出了WorldCast，一种分布式多人世界模型，其中每个玩家运行一个包含视频生成器和状态模型的本地客户端。在训练过程中，利用记录的玩家位置和地图几何信息，状态模型从生成的视频和控制输入中估计玩家的位置。客户端之间交换玩家状态，并将其投影到相机对齐的玩家状态场中，以引导其他玩家的渲染位置和方式。共享场景状态使客户端能够复用彼此生成的观测结果，从而在多个视图之间保持场景外观的一致性。在《反恐精英2》上的实验表明，WorldCast具有一致性、实时性能和分布式可扩展性。与联合生成方法相比，相机对齐的玩家状态场将玩家渲染速率提升了一个数量级以上，而共享场景状态则提升了整局游戏中的视觉一致性。每个客户端实时运行，仅交换玩家和场景状态，从而在不产生集中式计算瓶颈的情况下实现可扩展的多人生成。图像质量在长达一小时的滚动生成过程中保持稳定。

Authors: Ziyang Ye, Junchao Huang, Evelyn Zhang, Zhihao Xie, Ruicheng Zhang, Boyao Han, Litao Ban, Ziye Wang, Xinting Hu, Shaoshuai Shi, Zhuotao Tian, Li Jiang

FloorSAV: Elucidating Spatial Audio-Visual Context with 2D Floormap for AV-LLMs Other

spatial audio-visual reasoning 2D floormap AV-LLM egocentric video spatial reasoning benchmark

简要说明：FloorSAV 通过将空间音视频数据渲染为动态 2D 楼层平面图，并将其作为同步流注入音频-视觉大语言模型，以增强自我中心环境中的空间推理能力，并引入 SAVED-Bench 基准进行评估。

TLDR: FloorSAV renders a dynamic 2D floormap from spatial audio-visual data and injects it into audio-visual LLMs as a synchronized stream to improve spatial reasoning in egocentric environments, introducing SAVED-Bench for evaluation.

Abstract: While 3D spatial reasoning in dynamic egocentric environments is crucial for embodied intelligence, audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) lack explicit mechanisms to process and internalize global geometry directly from raw sensory streams. Existing approaches either require costly fine-tuning or underutilize the model's cross-modal reasoning capacities. In this paper, we propose FloorSAV, a novel framework that explicitly grounds spatial audio-visual context by rendering a dynamic 2D floormap. By integrating 3D point clouds, camera trajectories, spatial audio cues, and semantically grounded object landmarks, we inject this floormap into the AV-LLM as a synchronized stream with an egocentric video. AV-LLMs utilize their multi-modal capabilities to jointly reason over visual, auditory, and geometric cues in a single inference with floormap interpretation guidance. We further introduce SAVED-Bench (Spatial Audio-Visual Egocentric Benchmark with Dynamic Agents), constructing essential tasks of spatial capability in real-world scenarios: dynamic relativity, regional, and path reasoning QAs. FloorSAV improves AV-LLMs' spatial reasoning on various tasks from both SAVED-Bench and SAVVY-Bench. Studies with ground-truth floormaps demonstrate the substantial potential of FloorSAV with accurate spatial information.

摘要（中文）：虽然动态自我中心环境中的三维空间推理对于具身智能至关重要，但音视频大语言模型（AV-LLMs）缺乏直接从原始感官流中处理并内化全局几何信息的显式机制。现有方法要么需要昂贵的微调，要么未能充分利用模型的跨模态推理能力。在本文中，我们提出FloorSAV，一种新颖的框架，通过渲染动态二维楼层平面图来显式地锚定空间音视频上下文。通过整合三维点云、相机轨迹、空间音频线索以及语义化的物体地标，我们将该楼层平面图作为与自我中心视频同步的数据流注入AV-LLM。AV-LLMs利用其多模态能力，在单次推理中结合楼层平面图解释引导，联合推理视觉、听觉和几何线索。我们进一步引入SAVED-Bench（带动态智能体的空间音视频自我中心基准），构建了真实世界场景中空间能力的关键任务：动态相对性、区域和路径推理问答。FloorSAV提升了AV-LLMs在SAVED-Bench和SAVVY-Bench各项任务上的空间推理能力。基于真实楼层平面图的研究表明，FloorSAV在获取精确空间信息方面具有巨大潜力。

Authors: Kyeong-Rae Kim, Sungnyun Kim, Tae-Hyun Oh

World-Model Policy Arbiter for Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning WorldModel

world model goal-conditioned RL policy arbitration offline GCRL test-time framework

简要说明：该论文提出了世界模型策略仲裁器（WMPA），一种测试时框架，通过在世界模型中推出策略并用共享价值函数评估，从冻结的目标条件策略中选择最优策略，在OGBench上提高了成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces World-Model Policy Arbiter (WMPA), a test-time framework that selects among frozen goal-conditioned policies by rolling them out in a learned world model and evaluating with a shared value function, improving success rates on OGBench.

Abstract: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) has produced a diverse set of goal-reaching algorithms, yet no single algorithm performs best across environments, goals, and even different phases of the same task. Rather than deploying only the best-performing policy, we ask whether a set of frozen goal-conditioned policies can be used collectively as a portfolio, deciding at every state which policy should act. Choosing a policy at each state is not straightforward. The policies' own value functions cannot be compared directly: they may use different scales, and some policies have no value function. We need to judge each policy by the states it is likely to reach, even though we can execute only one policy at a time. We also need to avoid switching so often that control becomes unstable. To address these challenges, we introduce World-Model Policy Arbiter (WMPA), a test-time framework that, given a set of frozen policies as input, rolls out each frozen policy in a learned state-space world model, evaluates the imagined futures with a shared goal-conditioned value function, and executes the highest-scoring policy for a short commitment interval before the next round of arbitration (policy selection). WMPA assumes access to a bank of frozen goal-conditioned policies and requires neither policy retraining nor privileged task-specific knowledge. Under the official OGBench evaluation protocol on 18 state-based datasets spanning maze navigation as well as cube, scene, and puzzle manipulation, WMPA improves the macro-average success rate from the 44% achieved by the best policy selected per dataset to 58%, with statistically significant gains on 12 datasets. These gains include +33 percentage points on cube-double-play and +36 percentage points on scene-play.

摘要（中文）：离线目标条件强化学习（GCRL）已催生出一系列多样化的目标达成算法，然而，尚无单一算法能在所有环境、目标乃至同一任务的不同阶段中均表现最佳。与其仅部署性能最优的策略，我们提出能否将一组冻结的目标条件策略作为策略组合集体使用，在每个状态下决定由哪个策略执行动作。在每个状态下选择策略并非易事。各策略自身的价值函数无法直接比较：它们可能采用不同的尺度，且部分策略根本不具备价值函数。我们需要依据每个策略可能到达的状态对其加以评判，尽管同一时刻仅能执行一个策略。同时，我们还需避免因切换过于频繁而导致控制不稳定。为应对这些挑战，我们引入了世界模型策略仲裁器（WMPA），这是一种测试时框架，给定一组冻结策略作为输入，在所学状态空间世界模型中对每个冻结策略进行 rollout，使用共享的目标条件价值函数评估想象出的未来轨迹，并在下一轮仲裁（策略选择）之前，以较短承诺间隔执行得分最高的策略。WMPA 假设可访问一组冻结的目标条件策略库，既不需要策略重训练，也不需要特权任务专属知识。在官方 OGBench 评估协议下，涵盖迷宫导航以及立方体、场景和拼图操作等 18 个基于状态的数据集上，WMPA 将宏观平均成功率从按数据集挑选最优策略所达到的 44% 提升至 58%，在 12 个数据集上取得了统计显著的性能提升。这些提升包括在 cube-double-play 上增加 33 个百分点，在 scene-play 上增加 36 个百分点。
